raw.description:
Overview

The Lifeway Internship Program is a unique opportunity designed to provide college students and recent graduates with a valuable learning experience that fosters growth both professionally, personally, and spiritually. Our internships go far beyond "busy work"—you’ll engage in meaningful projects, gain hands-on experience, and be empowered to make an impact. Interns at Lifeway receive professional development, have opportunities for exposure to senior leaders, and benefit from mentoring relationships with experts in their chosen field.

Job Overview

This internship involves developing market research and strategy skills while helping promote Lifeway Adult Bible studies and craft marketing messaging for New Year campaigns aimed at the discipleship leader in churches. You will complete a competitive analysis or dig into customer data by segment and church size, then recommend strategy and campaign ideas to the team.

Internship Program Details & Requirements

  • Compensation: Lifeway’s summer internship program offers a competitive hourly pay rate, and all necessary equipment is provided.
  • Work Schedule: Interns work an average of 32 hours per week, with core workdays from Tuesday to Thursday. The expectation is that the internship is the primary focus during working hours.
  • Program Duration: June 7 - August 11, 2027 (11 weeks). Interns must commit to participating in the entire program.
  • Eligibility: Candidates must be enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate program and have completed at least two years of study by the internship start date. Recent graduates (December 2026 or May 2027) are also eligible.
  • Development Opportunities: Weekly professional development sessions are provided, including specialized training, mentorship, and leadership development.
  • Remote Structure: This is a remote position in the U.S., with required in-person attendance for orientation (June 7 - 11, 2027) and end-of-summer presentations (August 9-11, 2027) in Nashville. Travel costs for these events are covered by Lifeway.
  • Application Deadline: Applications are due by December 31, with interviews beginning as soon as possible. Selections are finalized by April 1.

Explore our culture further at team.lifeway.com/culture-code

This is a remote position based in the contiguous 48 United States with occasional travel to Nashville for in-person team gatherings.

Responsibilities

  • Live out Lifeway’s mission and values, showing deep commitment to Kingdom work
  • Assist with planning, scheduling and execution of marketing campaigns.
  • Complete competitive analysis of how other publishers promote backlist Bible study titles.
  • Analyze customer data by segment and church size to learn when and what each size buys.
  • Develop targeted messaging and product recommendations for a New Year campaign.
  • Recommend a marketing strategy to better uplift Lifeway Adult titles.
  • Provide administrative support to the Lifeway Adult Marketing team.
  • Overnight travel for Orientation, and Final Presentation weeks

Qualifications

Education

Currently pursuing a bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing or a related field (rising junior or senior, recent graduate, or enrolled graduate student), required

Skills, Knowledge, & Experiences, required

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment

Actively involved in an evangelical Christian church

Skills, Knowledge, & Experiences, preferred

• Experience in market research and formulating marketing plans

• Familiarity with Lifeway

raw.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
raw.excerpt: About Kinaxis Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career?
raw.description:
About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in the US or Canada.

About the team

At Kinaxis, our Talent Acquisition team plays a critical role in enabling business growth by ensuring we attract, engage, and hire exceptional talent across the organization. We're looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner to support our global Sales organization. This role goes beyond traditional recruiting. You will serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders, helping shape talent strategies, anticipate future hiring needs, and build strong talent pipelines that allow the organization to move quickly as priorities evolve. Success in this role requires deep partnership with Sales leaders, strong business acumen, and the ability to build relationships with candidates long before a requisition is opened. You will develop a deep understanding of Kinaxis, our market, and our talent landscape, providing leaders with insights and recommendations that support growth and long-term workforce planning.

What you will do

Strategic Business Partnership

  • Build trusted relationships with Sales leaders and act as a strategic advisor on talent needs, workforce planning, and hiring strategy.
  • Develop a strong understanding of Kinaxis' business priorities, growth objectives, and evolving talent requirements.
  • Influence and guide hiring decisions through market insights, talent intelligence, and recruiting expertise.
  • Partner with leaders to identify future talent needs and proactively develop strategies to address them.

Talent Pipeline Development

  • Create and maintain robust pipelines of high-caliber talent aligned to current and anticipated business needs.
  • Continuously engage passive candidates and nurture long-term relationships within key talent markets.
  • Develop talent communities that allow the business to respond quickly to changing priorities and growth opportunities.
  • Conduct ongoing talent mapping and market research to identify key talent pools and competitive trends.

Full-Cycle Talent Acquisition

  • Lead end-to-end recruitment efforts across a variety of Sales functions and levels.
  • Deliver an exceptional candidate experience throughout the hiring journey.
  • Guide leaders through interview design, assessment, selection, and offer stages.
  • Effectively manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of quality and responsiveness.

Market Intelligence & Talent Strategy

  • Monitor external talent market trends and provide insights to business leaders.
  • Use recruiting data and hiring metrics including pipeline health, speed, quality, and representation to diagnose challenges, advise leaders, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance talent attraction strategies, employer branding efforts, and recruiting processes.
  • Share competitive intelligence related to talent availability, market conditions, and hiring practices.

What we are looking for

  • Significant experience in talent acquisition, recruiting, or talent advisory roles, preferably supporting commercial organizations in a high-growth environment.
  • Proven ability to build credibility and influence senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong sourcing, talent engagement, and relationship-building capabilities.
  • Experience developing proactive talent pipelines and long-term recruiting strategies.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and adapt quickly as business priorities shift.
  • Strong business acumen and curiosity, with the ability to understand organizational goals and align talent strategies accordingly.
  • Excellent communication, consultation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proficiency with applicant tracking systems, candidate relationship management tools, sourcing platforms, and recruiting analytics, with the ability to use technology to build pipelines and manage hiring activity effectively.

What Success Looks Like

  • Sales leaders view you as a trusted advisor and strategic partner.
  • High-quality talent pipelines exist ahead of hiring demand.
  • Hiring teams are able to move quickly when priorities shift because talent relationships have already been established.
  • Recruiting strategies evolve alongside business objectives and market realities.
  • Candidate and hiring leaders experiences reflect Kinaxis's commitment to excellence.
  • Talent acquisition is seen as a proactive driver of growth rather than a reactive service function.

Mid-Senior level - #Intermediate

Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis: Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:

  • Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)
  • Flexible work options
  • Physical and mental well-being programs
  • Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
  • Mentorship programs, training, and career development
  • Recognition programs and referral rewards
  • Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at

Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at . This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

raw.description:
Company Overview

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

Be part of a team that makes a real difference.

Job Description

The Senior Project Manager is a seasoned, experienced professional who leads distinct, well-defined projects within the Genex PMO from initiation through delivery. This fully qualified, journey-level role coordinates cross-functional teams — across Product, Engineering/IT, Operations, Client Services, Finance, and external partners — to bring specific projects to completion on time and within budget.

Working on problems of diverse scope, the Senior Project Manager demonstrates sound judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions and resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This role operates with little day-to-day supervision, receives general instructions on new assignments, and networks with senior internal and external personnel to manage competing interests and deliver measurable outcomes that support Enlyte’s mission to drive brighter outcomes for all.

Project Leadership & Delivery

  • Own end-to-end delivery of one or more distinct projects, each with a clear beginning and end, coordinating the associated workstreams and resources
  • Define and maintain detailed project plans, milestones, dependencies, and RAID logs
  • Translate requirements into clear execution plans, performing feasibility and needs/impact assessments
  • Ensure projects are delivered on agreed scope, timelines, budget, and quality standards

Governance

  • Run effective project cadence meetings and decision forums, keeping teams aligned on priorities, risks, and decisions
  • Provide clear, concise project status reporting to stakeholders and senior leadership
  • Surface risks early, manage trade-offs, and recommend options
  • Document key decisions, scope changes, and acceptance criteria

Execution

  • Manage scope, budget, risk, and dependencies across teams with competing priorities
  • Monitor the change control process and track progress against the plan
  • Confirm readiness at major milestones, including testing, UAT, and go-live
  • Coordinate issue resolution across internal teams, vendors, and clients
  • Maintain momentum and accountability without adding unnecessary process or overhead

Collaboration

  • Partner with functional managers, business owners, project managers, and technical leads
  • Network with senior internal and external personnel in own area of expertise
  • May act as a team lead, coordinating the activities of other project contributors
  • Foster strong working relationships across matrixed teams and external partners

Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of related experience managing distinct projects end-to-end
  • A full understanding of project management discipline with demonstrated ability to resolve a wide range of issues
  • Demonstrated experience operating in matrixed environments with multiple stakeholders
  • Strong command of Waterfall, Agile, or hybrid delivery methodologies
  • Proven ability to manage scope, risk, dependencies, and change effectively
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including status reporting to senior stakeholders
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Engineering, Finance, or a related field
  • PMP certification

Preferred

  • Postgraduate coursework
  • Experience in SaaS or technology-enabled services environments, ideally within healthcare, insurance, or workers’ compensation
  • Familiarity with tools such as Confluence, Wrike, Azure DevOps, MS Project, SharePoint, or Salesforce

Benefits

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $80,500 - $105,000 annually, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.

The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and underrepresented minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Job Title: Medical Writer

Department: Study Set Up

Location: Remote East Coast | Must Sit in East Coast

Hours Per Week: 40 hours

Schedule: Days, Monday – Friday


SUMMARY

The Medical Writer is responsible for interpreting complex clinical study protocols and other medical/scientific documentation to prepare and coordinate laboratory specification and study‑specific medical/technical documents for ACM Global Laboratories. They will partner with internal departments in the development, drafting, review, editing, and finalization of documents used to conduct clinical studies.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the development, revision, and maintenance of complex clinical study and amendments in accordance to standard operating procedures (SOPs) and regulatory requirements.
  • With support of a mentor, work on the development, revision, and maintenance of high profile and expedited complex study documents and amendments in accordance to SOPs and regulatory requirements.
  • Responsible for authoring and finalizing global lab specification documents (GLSD) and other related documents, as needed.
  • Interpret, understand, and contribute to the scientific details of the protocol/technical documentation; identify and resolve gaps to ensure client satisfaction.
  • Serve as a subject-matter expert (SME) for medical documentation utilized throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Lead, initiate, and manage multiple rounds of internal and external document review.
  • Liaise and drive timely collaboration between key stakeholders to ensure technical documentation meet high quality standards and aligns with business process.
  • Participate in client interactions during study start-up activities and/or during study amendment process.
  • Review of low to medium complexity GLSD in accordance to SOPs and Quality Assurance processes.
  • With support of a mentor, work on the review of high complexity GLSD in accordance with SOPs and Quality Assurance processes.
  • Lead the development, revision, and maintenance of lab manuals in accordance to SOPs and regulatory requirements.
  • Review lab manuals to ensure alignment with SOPs and Quality Assurance processes.
  • Resolve challenges and build consensus between all cross-functional groups and collaborators in a timely manner.
  • Maintain a general working knowledge of Food & Drug Administration (FDA), Medical & Healthcare Regulatory Agency (MHRA), New York State Department of Health (NYSDOH), Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH and other pertinent regulations.
  • Demonstrate initiative in professional self-development to improve job performance to maintain relevant working knowledge of clinical trials.
  • Resolve queries for complex studies by using knowledge of regional differences and internal ACM processes for low and medium complexity GLSD and understanding of department responsibilities.
  • Perform other duties and/or tasks as assigned.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • BA/BS, or equivalent experience in scientific field
  • 1 yrs clinical trials or other laboratory experience required

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Applied knowledge of routine document content preparation, including the use of style guides, medical dictionaries, regulatory guidance documents, and templates
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and desktop publishing or word processing
  • Education in medical or technical writing
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to effectively influence others, work in a team environment, and collaborate across lines of business and functions
  • 1+ years’ experience drafting clinical trials documentation

EDUCATION:

LICENSES / CERTIFICATIONS:

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Sedentary - Sedentary roles are primarily office-based and require prolonged sitting (67–100% of the workday) with minimal physical effort and lifting limited to under 10 lbs. Fine motor skills are necessary for computer work, writing, and telephone use, supported by clear visual and auditory ability. Cognitive and emotional demands are high due to extended concentration, frequent interruptions, independent decision-making, and information processing. Although physical exposure is low, administrative areas within healthcare environments may occasionally involve contact with infectious agents. Some roles may require flexible hours, TB screening, or a valid driver’s license.

For disease specific care programs refer to the program specific requirements of the department for further specifications on experience and educational expectations, including continuing education requirements.

Any physical requirements reported by a prospective employee and/or employee’s physician or delegate will be considered for accommodations.

PAY RANGE:

$31.00 - $39.00

CITY:

Rochester

POSTAL CODE:

14624

The posted pay range is a good faith representation of potential base pay for this position. It may be modified in the future and eligible for additional pay components. Individual annual salaries/hourly rates could vary based on position details and FTE. Pay is determined by considering factors including, but not limited to, experience, relevant qualifications, specialty, internal equity, locations, and contracts.

Rochester Regional Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, predisposing genetic characteristics, marital or familial status, military or veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

About CORA Banking & Financial Services Group:

CORA Banking & Financial Services Group is a division of CORA Group, part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), the world’s most prolific acquirer of vertical market software businesses. We buy and hold software companies that serve banks, credit unions, lenders, collection agencies and enterprise financial institutions, and we never sell them. Our focus areas are core and digital banking, payments, lending and credit, debt collection and recovery, risk and compliance, and financial operations and analytics. PhoenixWorx, acquired from Finastra in 2026, anchors the group alongside a growing portfolio including WebRecon and CORA Loyalty. We give founders a permanent home for their business, their people and their customers, and we give our team the chance to learn acquisitions inside the Constellation model, disciplined pricing, long-term ownership, and a seat at the table on every deal.

Job Profile (Location – USA/Canada, flexible):

Title: M&A Associate

Location: USA or Canada, flexible

Reports to: Vice President, M&A

Start: January 2027

The Associate builds and works our acquisition pipeline. You identify and research software businesses in our verticals, open relationships with founders and owners, qualify opportunities against our investment criteria, and bring the ones that fit to our twice-weekly deal review with a clear thesis. You own a defined territory of accounts, keep it current in Salesforce, and are measured on the quality of the conversations you create and the deals you move to an offer. You’ll learn how a Constellation acquirer screens, prices and buys software businesses, with a path to the modelling and deal-execution side as you progress.


What you’ll do:


  • Own a territory of target accounts across core and digital banking, payments, lending, debt collection and recovery, risk and compliance, and loyalty; research, prioritise and work it systematically.
  • Reach out to founders and owners by phone, email and in person; hold roughly five to ten substantive founder conversations a week once ramped.
  • Qualify opportunities against our criteria (revenue scale, recurring revenue, vertical fit, geography) using our screening tools, and log every interaction in Salesforce to CSI standards.
  • Write a one-page thesis for each opportunity you advance and present it at deal review.
  • Nurture long-cycle relationships with owners who aren’t ready to sell yet.
  • Support conference and event work: pre-show target lists, meeting booking, on-site coordination and post-show follow-up.
  • Work with the Senior Associate and VP on the early stages of modelling and diligence as opportunities progress.
  • Keep your pipeline current in our deal-workflow system.

Qualifications

Required:


  • 2 to 4 years in business development, sales development, corporate development, investment banking analyst work, or a research or sourcing role at an acquirer.
  • Demonstrated comfort with outbound outreach and high-volume relationship building; you’re not put off by cold calls.
  • Ability to read a software company quickly: what it does, who it sells to, how it makes money, whether it fits.
  • Strong written and verbal communication; you’ll be the first voice many founders hear from us.
  • Organised and disciplined about CRM hygiene and follow-up.
  • Eligible to work in Canada or the United States.

Preferred:

  • Exposure to B2B software, fintech, banking or collections.
  • Salesforce experience.
  • Basic financial literacy (recurring revenue, EBITDA, margins) and an interest in moving toward M&A execution.
  • A second language relevant to our markets.

Compensation and benefits:

  • Base salary within the posted range, set by experience and location.
  • MBO bonus tied to qualified founder conversations and opportunities advanced to an approved offer, with a quality condition so volume alone doesn’t pay.
  • Health, dental and vision benefits; retirement plan with employer match (RRSP in Canada, 401(k) in the US); paid vacation and personal days.
  • Remote work; Toronto office presence expected one to two days a quarter for Toronto-based hires.
  • Training in Constellation’s acquisition model and a defined path to Senior Associate, M&A.
  • Travel: approximately 20%, primarily to industry conferences and trade shows across North America, with occasional travel to meet target companies alongside the VP.

Business Unit:

CORA M&A

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

40

Number of Openings Available:

1

Worker Type:

Regular

More About Jonas Software:

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

The pay range for this position is $105,000 to $115,000 annually plus 10% bonus. Please note that the pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. raw.excerpt: Overview TISTA Science and Technology Corporation is seeking an experienced Product Owner / Product Manager to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Healthcare Environment and Logistics Management (HELM) program.
raw.description:
Overview

TISTA Science and Technology Corporation is seeking an experienced Product Owner / Product Manager to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Healthcare Environment and Logistics Management (HELM) program.

The Product Owner / Product Manager will lead product ownership, backlog management, and application delivery for the Strategic Equipment Planning Guide – Enterprise Equipment Request (SEPG-EER), a .NET-based application hosted within the VA Azure Government environment.

This position serves in a combined Product Owner and Product Manager capacity, overseeing Agile delivery, monthly software releases, production application support, stakeholder coordination, and long-term application lifecycle planning.

The SEPG-EER application supports VA enterprise equipment planning and request management. The selected candidate will work closely with VA stakeholders, Scrum Masters, developers, testers, and technical leadership to ensure reliable application performance, timely delivery of enhancements, and alignment with program objectives.

At TISTA, you’ll do meaningful, mission-driven work that improves lives alongside teammates you trust and leaders who are transparent and supportive. We invest in your learning and internal mobility so you can build a career that keeps advancing. We’re proud to serve and hire Veterans, and we put people first in everything we do.

TISTA associates enjoy above Industry Healthcare Benefits, Remote Working Options, Paid Time Off, Training/Certification opportunities, Healthcare Savings Account & Flexible Savings Account, Paid Life Insurance, Short-term & Long-term Disability, 401K Match, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Paid Holidays, Military Leave, and much more!


Responsibilities

Product Ownership and Agile Delivery

  • Own, maintain, and prioritize the product backlog based on business priorities, stakeholder requirements, and technical dependencies.
  • Collaborate with VA stakeholders to define product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Lead backlog refinement and support sprint planning, reviews, and Planning Interval (PI) activities.
  • Partner with the Scrum Master and development team to establish achievable sprint commitments and delivery objectives.
  • Balance new enhancements, production defects, technical debt, and operational requirements.
  • Ensure completed deliverables meet established acceptance criteria and business expectations.

Release and Application Management

  • Oversee monthly application releases, patches, and associated deployment activities.
  • Coordinate release schedules, dependencies, risks, and production readiness.
  • Facilitate Change Control Board (CCB) approvals and deployment coordination.
  • Support automated regression testing and quality assurance activities.
  • Monitor production issues and coordinate timely resolution with technical teams.
  • Maintain release documentation and communicate implementation schedules to stakeholders.

Stakeholder and Program Management

  • Serve as a primary liaison between VA business stakeholders, technical teams, and program leadership.
  • Provide regular updates regarding product delivery, milestones, risks, issues, and dependencies.
  • Coordinate cross-functional activities to ensure alignment with program priorities.
  • Maintain project schedules, documentation, status reports, and operational records.
  • Support governance activities and ensure appropriate management of project information within SharePoint and other collaboration platforms.

Compliance and Risk Management

  • Track and coordinate remediation of Section 508 accessibility findings.
  • Support security compliance activities and resolution of identified vulnerabilities.
  • Coordinate with technical and security teams to maintain compliance with VA requirements.
  • Identify and proactively manage project risks, dependencies, and delivery challenges.
  • Support applicable federal IT governance and change management processes.

Application Lifecycle Planning

  • Support long-term application planning and modernization initiatives.
  • Coordinate application transition and retirement activities as VA implements its enterprise asset management solution.
  • Identify dependencies, operational impacts, and transition requirements.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to support continuity of operations throughout application lifecycle changes.

Qualifications

  • Minimum five years of experience in software product ownership, product management, or IT project management within Agile development environments.
  • Demonstrated experience owning, managing, and prioritizing software product backlogs.
  • Experience developing user stories, defining acceptance criteria, and managing product requirements.
  • Experience working with Agile Scrum teams and participating in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release planning activities.
  • Proficiency with Jira and Confluence for Agile project tracking, backlog management, and documentation.
  • Experience managing production applications, software releases, deployment coordination, and change control processes.
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile delivery methodologies.
  • Experience managing project schedules, risks, issues, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Experience coordinating software testing, production defect resolution, and application enhancements.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, testers, Scrum Masters, cybersecurity teams, and business stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing status reports and presenting updates to leadership.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and independently coordinate product delivery activities.
  • Experience maintaining technical documentation, project records, and release management materials.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM), Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Project Management Professional (PMP), or PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP) certification.
  • Experience supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Defense Health Agency (DHA), or other federal healthcare IT programs.
  • Familiarity with ASP.NET MVC, .NET Framework, and enterprise application environments.
  • Understanding of Microsoft SQL Server 2019, SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), and Power BI.
  • Experience supporting applications hosted within Microsoft Azure Government.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow, GitHub, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, or similar enterprise development and collaboration tools.
  • Knowledge of federal IT security requirements, Authority to Operate (ATO), and Risk Management Framework (RMF) processes.
  • Familiarity with the VA Technical Reference Model (TRM).
  • Understanding of Section 508 accessibility requirements and remediation processes.
  • Experience supporting application modernization, migration, transition, or retirement initiatives.
  • Familiarity with enterprise asset management systems or healthcare technology management applications.
  • Active or recent VA background investigation and identity credential.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Clearance:

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Tier 2 / Moderate Risk Public Trust background investigation and VA identity credential.

Location:

  • Remote within the United States, subject to VA approval.

Pay Range:

  • The suggested pay for this position ranges from $86,000 to $102,000 annually.
  • The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.
  • Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as bonuses.

raw.description:
Introducción

En Servitalent, consultora especializada en la selección de talento para el sector industrial, seleccionamos a un/a Business Development Manager para un fabricante de panadería con larga trayectoria y líder en su país de origen que ha decidido crecer a lo grande.

La compañía tiene un plan para multiplicar su tamaño en los próximos años, acaba de ampliar su capacidad de producción y ha elegido España como mercado prioritario dentro de su ambicioso plan de crecimiento internacional que tiene a Francia como su siguiente foco. Le falta la persona que lo haga realidad.

Tu misión es construir ese mercado. Decidirás a qué puertas llamar, sentarás a los compradores de la gran distribución frente a un producto que se distingue en el lineal y convertirás su interés en referencias. Y no empiezas en blanco: hay cuentas activas y contactos de ferias esperando a alguien que los haga crecer.

Si sabes abrir cuentas en centrales de compra y quieres que tu trabajo se note en los resultados desde el primer año, esta es tu oportunidad para dejar huella en un proyecto que está empezando.

Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades

  • Abrir puertas: Trazar el mapa de centrales de compra y llegar a quienes deciden en productos de panadería y congelados.

  • Poner el producto a prueba: Organizar pruebas y degustaciones y convertirlas en referencias.

  • Negociar y cerrar: Preparar propuestas y acordar condiciones, con la dirección a tu lado.

  • Hacer crecer lo que ya hay: Desarrollar las cuentas activas y dar seguimiento a los contactos de ferias.

  • Estar donde se decide: Representar a la compañía en ferias del sector y visitar tiendas para ver cómo rota el producto.

  • Ser la voz del mercado: Trasladar lo que piden compradores y consumidores al equipo de producto y participar en el lanzamiento de la marca en España.

  • Abrir el siguiente mercado: Participar en la entrada en otros mercados europeos cuando España esté en marcha, con Francia como siguiente etapa.

  • Medir: Mantener el CRM al día y anticipar la evolución de las ventas.

Qué estamos buscando

a. Educación

No se exige una titulación concreta. Lo que cuenta es tu recorrido comercial y tu conocimiento del canal.

b. Experiencia

  • Al menos cinco años en venta B2B.

  • Experiencia comercial en alimentación vendiendo a gran distribución. Conoces sus canales, sus centrales y cómo se consigue una referencia.

  • Has abierto cuentas nuevas, además de gestionar cartera.

  • Se valora especialmente la experiencia en pan. También encajan perfiles de bollería, pastelería, masas congeladas, congelados salados, pan envasado o de compras en cadenas de distribución.

c. Herramientas

CRM para el seguimiento comercial y las previsiones.

d. Idioma

Español nativo o bilingüe e inglés de nivel avanzado. El francés es un plus.

e. Skills

  • Iniciativa: Generas tus propias oportunidades.

  • Negociación con compradores exigentes.

  • Autonomía y constancia para trabajar inicialmente en formato home-office, sin equipo a cargo y con alta independencia.

  • Organización y foco en resultados.

  • Residencia en España y disponibilidad para viajar por España, a otros mercados europeos y a la sede central.

Qué ofrecemos

  • Retribución: Fijo de 50.000 a 70.000 € brutos anuales, más comisión sobre ventas. Lo que vendes se nota.

  • La dirección a tu lado: Reporte directo a la Dirección General, formación y acompañamiento personal desde el primer día, y decisiones rápidas.

  • Un producto en el que creer: Calidad diferencial que se defiende sola en una degustación.

  • Capacidad para crecer: Una planta recién ampliada, preparada para servir lo que vendas.

  • Influencia real: Tu visión del mercado pesa en el desarrollo de producto y en el lanzamiento de la marca.

  • Recorrido: El puesto crece con la expansión a otros mercados.

  • Día a día: Teletrabajo desde España, con preferencia por Barcelona o su área, coche, gastos de la actividad y formación en fábrica.

Por qué postularse

Pocas veces se puede construir un mercado desde el principio con el respaldo de una compañía consolidada, un producto con argumentos y la dirección implicada en cada paso. Aquí tu trabajo tendrá nombre propio.

Servitalent gestiona el proceso con total confidencialidad. Primero hablarás con nuestro equipo, que te contará quién es la compañía, y después con su dirección.

Si encajas en el perfil, inscríbete y nos pondremos en contacto contigo.

About Us

Bonterra exists to propel every doer of good to their peak impact. We measure that impact against our vision to increase the giving rate as a percentage of GDP from 2% to 3% by 2033. We know that this goal is lofty, but we are confident that the right technology and expertise will strengthen trust in the sector, allowing the social good industry to accelerate growth and reach peak impact. Bonterra's differentiated, end-to-end solutions collectively support a unique network of over 20,000 customers, including over 16,000 nonprofit organizations and over 50 percent of Fortune 100 companies. Learn more at bonterratech.com.

About the Role

Who We Are:

Are you a passionate innovator looking to harness the power of technology to do more good? You've come to the right place. At Bonterra, our purpose is to power those who power social impact. To that end, we serve the people who make social good possible—the doers behind the scenes across nonprofits, public agencies, corporations, philanthropic organizations, and foundations.


As the second-largest and fastest-growing social good software company in the world, Bonterra brings together leading solutions from CyberGrants, EveryAction, Network for Good, Social Solutions, and their respective entities. By bringing our intuitive technology and expertise together, Bonterra will enable unprecedented connectivity between social good organizations and their community of supporters and constituents. This will reshape philanthropic giving, empower digital transformation, and bring the social good sector the technology it needs to accelerate lasting social change.


We are a globally distributed team with team members across the US, Mexico, and beyond. This is a fully remote position based in Mexico. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Mexico.

What You'll Do:

As a Staff Accountant supporting the Accounting team, you will own aspects of tax-related accounting and general ledger-related activities ranging from proper application of U.S. GAAP for accounting transactions, preparing GL account reconciliations, participating in monthly close, and providing financial reporting. You will collaborate closely with US-based stakeholders across Finance, AP, AR, and other departments, with all communications conducted in English. This role operates on a US-based accounting calendar; extended availability is expected during month-end, quarter-end, and annual close periods. The ideal candidate has excellent problem-solving and communication skills and enjoys working in a challenging and complex environment.

In this role, you will:

General Ledger & Close Activities

Qualifications:

  • Licenciatura en Contaduría (CPA equivalent) required; candidates with active CPA certification or equivalent Mexican credential (Contador Público Certificado) strongly preferred
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant accounting experience

  • Superior attention to detail and commitment to handling confidential information with integrity and discretion
  • Core working hours align with US Central or Eastern time zones — overlap of at least 6 hours with US business hours required; extended availability expected during close periods

Our Culture

raw.description:
Overview

TISTA Science and Technology Corporation is seeking an experienced Scrum Master – Healthcare Technology and Asset Management (HTAM) to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Supply Chain Management Development Security Operations (SCM DSO) program within the Healthcare Environment and Logistics Management (HELM) product line.

The Scrum Master will facilitate Agile delivery, coordinate cross-functional teams, remove impediments, and support continuous improvement across multiple healthcare technology and asset management initiatives.

This position will primarily support the Strategic Equipment Planning Guide – Enterprise Equipment Request (SEPG-EER) Cloud application, while also providing Scrum Master support for Maximo Enterprise Asset and Work Management (EAWM) and Enterprise Asset Management/Computerized Maintenance Management System (EAM/CMMS) data migration activities.

SEPG-EER supports VA medical centers in planning, budgeting, and requesting medical equipment, including maintaining rolling five-year equipment plans. The application operates within VA's Azure cloud environment and follows a monthly release schedule supported by automated regression testing.

The selected candidate will work within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) Agile Release Train (ART), collaborating with Product Owners, development teams, testers, technical leadership, and VA stakeholders to ensure effective sprint execution, release readiness, and coordination of dependencies across multiple teams.

At TISTA, you’ll do meaningful, mission-driven work that improves lives alongside teammates you trust and leaders who are transparent and supportive. We invest in your learning and internal mobility so you can build a career that keeps advancing. We’re proud to serve and hire Veterans, and we put people first in everything we do.

TISTA associates enjoy above Industry Healthcare Benefits, Remote Working Options, Paid Time Off, Training/Certification opportunities, Healthcare Savings Account & Flexible Savings Account, Paid Life Insurance, Short-term & Long-term Disability, 401K Match, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Paid Holidays, Military Leave, and much more!


Responsibilities

  • Facilitate Agile Scrum ceremonies, including daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives across assigned HTAM teams.
  • Provide Scrum Master support for SEPG-EER Cloud, Maximo EAWM, and EAM/CMMS data migration initiatives.
  • Coordinate Agile delivery activities across multiple teams to ensure alignment with program objectives, sprint commitments, and release schedules.
  • Prepare teams for quarterly Planning Interval (PI) Planning activities, including capacity planning, feature readiness, dependency identification, and risk assessment.
  • Participate in Scrum of Scrums, Agile Release Train (ART) synchronization meetings, and coordination activities with the Release Train Engineer.
  • Support SEPG-EER's monthly release cycle, including sprint scope management, regression testing coordination, release readiness reviews, and Change Control Board (CCB) approvals.
  • Collaborate with Product Owners to balance production defects, user-reported issues, planned enhancements, and technical debt within sprint commitments.
  • Coordinate with testing teams to ensure automated regression testing is incorporated into release readiness and Definition of Done requirements.
  • Track Section 508 accessibility findings, coordinate remediation activities, and monitor outstanding issues through resolution.
  • Maintain visibility of data migration activities, dependencies, and cutover tasks associated with Maximo EAWM and AEMS/MERS legacy system transitions.
  • Track assigned migration tasks, ownership, timelines, and progress toward enterprise asset management modernization objectives.
  • Coordinate with shared services teams, including cybersecurity, testing, and architecture, to ensure required support aligns with sprint schedules.
  • Maintain accurate Jira boards, sprint backlogs, story estimates, dashboards, and Agile reporting artifacts.
  • Monitor Agile delivery metrics, including team velocity, sprint commitment completion, carryover work, and delivery predictability.
  • Facilitate team discussions regarding sprint performance, delivery challenges, and continuous improvement opportunities.
  • Identify, document, escalate, and track impediments affecting sprint execution and team productivity.
  • Coordinate resolution of cross-team dependencies and escalate unresolved blockers through appropriate Agile Release Train channels.
  • Collaborate with Product Owners and VA stakeholders to maintain refined, prioritized, and appropriately estimated backlogs at least two sprints ahead.
  • Coach development teams, Product Owners, and stakeholders on Scrum principles, SAFe practices, and Agile delivery methodologies.
  • Support effective sprint scope management and ensure urgent or unplanned work follows established intake and prioritization processes.
  • Facilitate collaboration among distributed teams working in fully remote environments.
  • Coordinate with other HTAM Scrum Masters to align cross-team dependencies, PI Planning inputs, and shared delivery objectives.
  • Support stakeholder communications regarding sprint progress, delivery risks, dependencies, and release readiness.
  • Maintain Agile documentation, team working agreements, retrospective outcomes, and continuous improvement action items.
  • Promote Agile best practices, team accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement across assigned initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Minimum six years of professional experience serving as a Scrum Master supporting software development teams.
  • Demonstrated experience independently facilitating Scrum ceremonies across multiple consecutive sprint cycles.
  • Experience working within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) Agile Release Train, including participation in at least one Planning Interval (PI) Planning event.
  • Strong understanding of Agile Scrum methodologies, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and continuous improvement practices.
  • Hands-on experience using Jira to manage Agile boards, sprint backlogs, filters, dashboards, and Agile reporting.
  • Experience using Confluence or comparable collaboration and documentation platforms.
  • Experience supporting distributed software development teams in fully remote environments.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Teams or comparable virtual collaboration tools.
  • Experience collaborating with Product Owners, developers, testers, technical leadership, and business stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify, escalate, and resolve impediments affecting Agile delivery.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional dependencies and managing competing priorities across technical teams.
  • Understanding of Agile delivery metrics, including velocity, sprint commitments, carryover, and delivery predictability.
  • Experience facilitating effective team communication, conflict resolution, and collaborative decision-making.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and facilitation skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with technical teams, business stakeholders, and customer leadership.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple Agile delivery activities while maintaining team alignment and accountability.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience serving as Scrum Master for applications in production sustainment with established monthly or quarterly release schedules.
  • Experience supporting software development teams that utilize automated regression testing and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure-hosted web applications and Power BI reporting environments.
  • Experience supporting capital planning, budgeting, equipment procurement, or healthcare technology management initiatives.
  • Experience tracking and coordinating remediation of Section 508 accessibility findings.
  • Experience supporting enterprise data migration, legacy system modernization, or application cutover activities.
  • Familiarity with enterprise asset management and maintenance platforms, including IBM Maximo, Nuvolo, or ServiceNow EAM.
  • Experience simultaneously supporting two or more Agile teams.
  • Experience supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Defense Health Agency (DHA), Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), or other federal healthcare IT programs.
  • Experience facilitating remote PI Planning sessions, retrospectives, and collaborative workshops using Mural or Miro.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow, Smartsheet, Jira Align, or comparable enterprise collaboration tools.
  • SAFe Advanced Scrum Master (SASM) certification.
  • SAFe Agilist (SA) or SAFe Practitioner (SP) certification.
  • ICAgile Certified Professional in Agile Coaching (ICP-ACC) certification.
  • PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP) certification.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Four additional years of professional experience in Scrum Master responsibilities or Agile delivery may substitute for the bachelor's degree.

Required Certification:

  • SAFe Scrum Master (SSM) or Certified Scrum Master (CSM) certification.
  • Professional Scrum Master I (PSM I) certification is accepted as an equivalent qualification.

Clearance:

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a VA Tier 2 / Moderate Risk Public Trust background investigation and VA Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credential.
  • Must meet the VA residency requirement of residing in the United States for at least three of the previous five years.

Location:

  • Remote within the United States.

Pay Range:

  • The suggested pay for this position ranges from $90,000 to $155,000 annually.
  • The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.
  • Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as bonuses.

Architect the Future of Global Logistics: Mid-Level Backend Software Engineer (Java)

Ready to build the single source of truth that powers global supply chains? Join Trimble Transportation and Transporeon to modernize mission-critical data platforms, consolidate complex legacy systems into a unified real-time engine, and shape high-impact backend architecture from day one—all from the comfort of your home office.

About Us:

Trimble is an industrial technology company connecting the digital and physical worlds to transform how the world works across transportation, construction, and geospatial industries. Within Trimble, Trimble Transportation and Transporeon (a Trimble Company) power the largest global freight network—connecting shippers, retailers, carriers, and logistics providers through intelligent SaaS, real-time visibility, and connected supply chain workflows worldwide.

What Makes This Role Great:

As part of the Master Data Management team within the Common Transport Platform Department, you will help modernize our mission-critical platform—the organization’s Single Source of Truth for customer data.

All Transportation and Logistics products rely on this platform, making data accuracy and availability vital. We are consolidating fragmented legacy records into a unified "Golden Record" to deliver clean, real-time data via event streams and APIs, migrating systems while keeping operations seamless.

We need a product-minded engineer who looks beyond ticket specifications to lead technical discovery and collaborate with stakeholders. You will help shape solutions, migrate legacy sources, and build resilient, high-availability backend services.

Key Exciting Responsibilities


  • Lead technical and product discovery, driving initiatives end-to-end from initial problem framing and architecture design to final delivery.
  • Architect and build scalable, high-availability backend services that consolidate fragmented customer records into a unified, real-time Golden Record.
  • Partner directly with business stakeholders, product managers, and peer engineering teams to challenge assumptions and shape impactful platform solutions.
  • Take full lifecycle ownership of your services across design, development, testing, deployment, observability, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Champion engineering excellence by ensuring high test coverage, reliable CI/CD pipelines, and strong security compliance across distributed teams.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of professional experience developing production backend services using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot (with Maven or Gradle).
  • Proven expertise designing REST APIs and event-driven architectures utilizing tools like Kafka and NoSQL databases such as MongoDB.
  • Strong product sense and stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and align technical and non-technical partners.
  • Hands-on experience building modular, cloud-native services using modern DevOps and observability stacks (such as Docker, Kubernetes, Azure, and Datadog).
  • Practical experience leveraging AI tools and autonomous coding agents across the software development lifecycle, paired with professional fluency in English.
  • A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

Tech Stack


  • Core: Java, Spring, Spring Boot, MongoDB (NoSQL), Kafka (event-driven integrations), Datadog (monitoring & observability), REST APIs.
  • Secondary / Ecosystem: Python, PostgreSQL (or other RDBMS), Azure (or similar cloud platforms), Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Argo CD.

Bonus Points For


  • Prior experience working with business-critical systems, massive data volumes, or Master Data Management (MDM) platforms, as well as authentication/authorization services and API gateways.

Logistics: Location: Spain, Portugal, or Hungary (remote)


Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact.We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.


  • You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide. Our impact is tangible, from connected machines that save fuel to data-driven insights that reduce waste.
  • Collaborate with like-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging. We're a company of "visionary pragmatists" who think boldly and build things that work.
  • Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self-authored," empowering proactive "doers."

Backend Software Engineer, Java Developer, Spring Boot, Kafka, MongoDB, Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, Master Data Management, REST APIs, Remote Software Engineer


How to Apply: Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on one of the Apply buttons located in this posting.

Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.

At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

raw.description:
About Us:

Proofpoint is a global leader in human- and agent-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple: safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.

How We Work:

At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values:

Bold in how we dream and innovate

Responsive to feedback, challenges and opportunities

Accountable for results and best in class outcomes

Visionary in future focused problem-solving

Exceptional in execution and impact

The Technical Account Manager (TAM) is a strategic customer advisor and business outcome leader who partners with enterprise customers to drive measurable security value and cyber resiliency. This is a senior, consultative role that operates at the intersection of technology and business strategy—engaging at the CISO and executive level while maintaining the technical depth necessary to guide complex Proofpoint deployments.

The TAM serves as a trusted executive consultant, proactively identifying strategic risks, architecting adoption and value realization plans, and coaching customers on aligning Proofpoint capabilities to their broader security and business frameworks. While the role has evolved to lead with strategic advisory, a strong technical and security software foundation remains essential.

Successful candidates will bring executive presence, commercial acumen, and a proven track record of driving customer outcomes at the enterprise level—combined with deep experience in Linux, messaging, and cloud security environments. Above all, they will have a passion for ensuring a top-quality customer experience.

Your Day-to-Day

Strategic & Advisory (~50%)

  • Drive business outcomes aligned to customer security and organizational goals, ensuring measurable ROI across the Proofpoint investment.
  • Serve as a strategic risk advisor—proactively identifying and mitigating renewal, adoption, and security posture risks before they impact the customer.
  • Act as an executive consultant—building trusted relationships at CISO/VP level, delivering strategic insights and forward-looking recommendations.
  • Architect adoption and value realization plans that ensure customers maximize the full breadth of their Proofpoint deployment.
  • Coach customers on cyber resiliency strategy—aligning Proofpoint capabilities to their broader security framework and organizational risk tolerance.
  • Lead executive business reviews and strategic planning sessions, articulating security value in business terms.

Technical & Operational (~50%)

  • Maintain technical expertise across the Proofpoint platform—staying current on product capabilities, integrations, and roadmap.
  • Understand the customer’s unique security goals, business requirements, network configuration, and Proofpoint deployment; proactively make recommendations to improve security posture and system performance.
  • Act as a technical advocate to manage and monitor interactions with the Proofpoint technical support team, proactively escalating issues and feature requests.
  • Conduct proactive health checks and provide system performance recommendations aligned to the customer’s deployment.
  • Provide insight on industry trends, the security landscape, best practices, and product roadmaps affecting the customer’s business.
  • Assist customers with setting goals and success criteria for their Proofpoint deployment, and provide reports to track key metrics and progress.
  • Conduct weekly status calls, monthly management calls, and periodic executive-level business reviews.

Qualifications:

Strategic & Business Competencies

  • Proven ability to drive measurable business outcomes for enterprise customers—translating technical capabilities into tangible security and business value.
  • Executive presence and demonstrated experience engaging at C-suite and VP level, including CISOs, CIOs, and business unit leaders.
  • Strategic risk assessment and advisory experience—ability to identify adoption gaps, renewal risks, and security posture vulnerabilities proactively.
  • Strong commercial acumen—solid understanding of ARR, renewals, customer lifetime value, and the commercial dimensions of customer success.
  • Experience building and executing customer success and adoption strategies at scale.
  • Ability to translate technical capabilities into business value narratives tailored to executive audiences.

Technical Foundation

  • Extensive industry experience in a client/professional services, sales engineering, senior support engineering, IT operations management, or senior engineer role with exposure to multiple technology areas.

raw.title: Senior Software Engineer / Solutions Architect
raw.excerpt: Remote, Philippines Salary: 45k - 72k Experience: 3-7 Yrs Degree: Minimum Bachelor/Preferred Masters Shift: • U.
raw.description:
Remote, Philippines
Salary: 45k - 72k
Experience: 3-7 Yrs
Degree: Minimum Bachelor/Preferred Masters

Shift:

  • U.S. Eastern Time: 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM

  • Philippine Time:

    • 8:00 PM – 6:00 AM (during U.S. Daylight Saving Time)

    • 9:00 PM – 7:00 AM (during U.S. Standard Time)

Looking for Builders, Not Passengers

Most engineers are given maps.

We are looking for someone who creates the roadmap.

We are building an AI company at speed. The kind where the architecture decisions made in the next 12–18 months will define our company for the next decade.

This role is not for someone who wants a comfortable sprint cycle.

It’s for someone who wants to build systems that matter, someone who is comfortable assembling parts of an airplane while the airplane is in the air.

We are looking for a Driven and Talented Software Engineer who can operate with the ownership, speed, and sound judgment of a leader.

Someone who doesn’t wait to be pointed at problems.
Someone who hunts them and solves them graciously.

The Work

You won’t be maintaining legacy systems.

You’ll be building the core systems that drive change and impact a significant number of extremely reputable and large businesses.

That means:

  • Designing architecture that scales before the scale exists

  • Turning ambiguous ideas into production systems quickly

  • Shipping fast while protecting the parts that cannot break

  • Making technical decisions with long half-lives

You will have real ownership of critical infrastructure, product, and platform decisions.

When something blocks progress, you remove the blocker.

No drama. Just velocity.

The Kind of Engineer Who Thrives Here

This role is intentionally polarizing.

You’ll probably thrive here if:

  • You build things because you can’t help yourself

  • You care deeply about craft, performance, and elegant systems

  • You move faster than most teams while maintaining high standards

  • You learn new domains faster than most people can Google them

  • You default to ownership instead of permission

You likely have at least one project where:

  • you built something that was technically extremely difficult from scratch

  • people now depend on it

  • and you did it mostly because you wanted to see if it was possible

You have very high standards.

For your code.

For your thinking.

And especially for yourself.

 

What This Is Not

This is not:

  • a maintenance role

  • a Jira-ticket factory

  • a place to hide behind processes

  • an environment tolerant of mediocre engineering

We are building with controlled velocity:

Fast without being sloppy.

Ambitious without being reckless.

 

The Upside

If you are the right person, this will be one of the most leveraged periods of your career.

You’ll get:

  • Ownership over systems that matter

  • A small team of other high-agency builders

  • Real influence on product and architecture

  • Equity that actually means something if we win

  • A front-row seat to building an AI company’s new products from the ground up

 

The Filter

This role is not for everyone.

Most engineers prefer clear maps and tickets, predictable scope, and stable systems.

If reading this made you feel slightly uncomfortable and excited at the same time, you are probably the kind of builder we are looking for.

Job Summary

The Centralized Financial Services Officer - Packaging assists in the collection of documentation for financial aid applications along with answering questions by making outbound calls, taking inbound calls and responding to emails for both new and continuing students regarding their funding. Reporting into the Director of Centralized Packaging, the Centralized Financial Services Officer is responsible for the submission of completed Financial Aid files for review and approval. In addition, the Centralized Financial Services Officer is available to assist and support Campuses directly with questions in the event clarification is needed for students.

Key Responsibilities

  • Answers student inquiries via all forms of communication (i.e. email, inbound and outbound calls, etc.) encompassing a multitude of areas such as; Title IV funding, campus-based aid, VA funding, verification, payment plans, state grants, and other financial aid questions.

  • Provides excellent customer service and administrative support to students and customers.

  • Assist students in the completion of required financial aid documents such as the Master Promissory Note and Entrance Counseling and other related documents.

  • Ensure students' understanding of the responsibilities and obligations tied to student loan repayment.

  • Ensures all documentation received is properly notated in required systems.

  • Prepares and maintains accuracy of student financial aid files.

  • Verifies student eligibility for Title IV funding.

  • Ensure timely submission of students' financial aid file upon completion of required documentation.

  • Communicate with campus regarding student financial aid eligibility and documents needed for certification of Title IV funding.

  • Other duties as assigned by leadership.

  • High School Diploma or equivalent minimum

  • 1+ years of experience in accounting, banking or customer service related field

Experience and Education Preferred

  • 3+ years of experience preferred in Financial Aid or Title IV in a post secondary institution

  • Previous experience using CampusVue preferred
