raw.excerpt: The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech.
raw.description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

The Role

The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

The Role:

As a Sr Principal Enterprise Solution Consultant, you will partner with AspenTech teams during the sales cycle to lead in consultative discovery process with customer executives, craft a vision and roadmap of a solution that addresses customer requirements, identifying differentiated value capture potential, and propose an implementation/sustainment program for that solution. This involves maintaining a keen understanding of the AspenTech product strategy, value enablers, professional services and partner execution capabilities, and sales pipeline to drive opportunities where AspenTech solutions can bring significant business value to our customers and to AspenTech.

The Sr Principal Enterprise Solution Consultant is responsible for delivering a comprehensive solution vision, compelling business cases based on AspenTech products and work collaboratively with sales teams to close major transactions. He/She needs to demonstrate deep knowledge of the solutions and offerings and be capable of working independently as well as leading the designing of a complete digitalization roadmap with high-quality solutions based on the full offering of AspenTech. He/She is expected to drive transformational results with significant business outcomes for customers.
This is a customer-facing role that requires highly motivated individuals with excellent business, industry and technical knowledge along with strong consultative and communication skills to position AspenTech solutions and services with our customers.

We are looking to hire a Sr Principal Enterprise Solution Consultant to join our Planning & Scheduling Solution Consulting team in Europe. The team is tasked with supporting the sales process with knowledge of AspenTech products and services, value definition and industry vertical knowledge as well as developing and maintaining key relationships with AspenTech's clients and prospects. The candidate will be responsible for working with our sales account managers and the technical community among our clients. The successful candidate must have strong business acumen and customer interaction skills. The role requires the ability to understand customer challenges and industry drivers, formulate potential solutions from Aspen's portfolio, build and justify the business case for client investment, and provide support to the direct sales force in the sales process.

Your Impact

  • Determine and understand prospective client’s critical business needs using strong knowledge of the Process Industries, trends and best practices.
  • Develop a comprehensive Solution Vision, a Digitalization roadmap and Value proposition that leverages the complete offering of AspenTech Solutions and that best matches with the customer priorities and business potential.
  • Accountable to consult with customers and advise on the relevant AspenTech solutions, services and establish a credible value proposition.
  • Be a trusted advisor and work with customer senior executives to influence and agree on an Execution Plan and Win the business.
  • Lead value-discovery customer sessions, assessing customer needs, and developing solutions working with other subject matter Solution Consultants and cross-functional teams.
  • Develop and execute strategies and plans together with the sales teams and help to qualify business opportunities, to identify key customer technical challenges, and to develop solutions to meet the business needs.
  • Work with the Sales Team to best position the Value and Differentiation of the AspenTech solution and to navigate customers’ key stakeholders, decision makers and the political environment.
  • Work with Partners, Implementation Providers, Consultants, and the Customer Ecosystem to maximize the Value derived from AspenTech solutions.
  • Actively engage with other junior Solution Consultants to provide mentorship to develop those individuals into higher levels of competencies, especially in consultative selling acumen and industry knowledge areas.

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering or relevant technical subject preferred.
  • 12-15 Years’ experience in a consultant, partner, pre-sales, professional services consultant type of role.
  • Excellent consultative and collaboration skills with proven experience in presenting, advising and achieving buy-in from senior executives (managers, directors, VPs, and CXOs).
  • Strong knowledge of the Process Industries to be able to discuss credibly the key industry trends, challenges and opportunities as well as being able to benchmark where the specific customer is versus peers.
  • Outstanding problem-solving and analytical skills to convert customer needs into comprehensive solution visions, value propositions and execution plans positioning the value of the complete AspenTech portfolio leading to major transactions.
  • Experience working with sales teams, solutions consultants and services engineers jointly driving major engagements leading to large transactions.
  • Demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to build strong industry relationships.
  • Balance of business and technology acumen, including ability to articulate high-level technical solutions to business problems and the differentiated value those solutions can provide.
  • Understanding of one or more of the following functions in the processing industry: Manufacturing Execution System, Real Time/Historian database, Advanced Process Control, Process Engineering, Asset Performance Management, or Supply Chain Management and Optimization.
  • High degree of intellectual curiosity and ability to learn and apply new concepts and technologies in a wide variety of disciplines.
  • High energy with a positive disposition. Comfortable working in fluid, fast paced environments. Self-starter.
  • Adept at identifying improvement and growth opportunities, building inter-organizational interlock, and overcoming resistance to change.
  • Excellent English language verbal and writing skills.
  • Regional travel up to 50% on average.

At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Job Description Summary

If you can put your keen legal mind to work analyzing, managing and resolving insurance coverage and claims, we want to know more about you! Working on our team offers the opportunity to be involved in settling litigated and non-litigated claims of high complexity and severity in terms of exposure and coverage.

As a Claims Consultant, you'll investigate, evaluate and negotiate claims to successful resolution. This role supports the management liability and specialty lines of business, including errors and omissions, directors and officers and employment practices liability among others. You will have high monetary authority and minimal direction, with direct supervision only when needed, as well as considerable latitude in determining objectives and approaches to assignments. We will count on you to collaborate and provide insight to our business partners on claims and policy wording questions and maintain, develop and influence relationships with customers and business partners.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Investigates and evaluates coverage, liability and damages to set an appropriate claim strategy, settlement and file reserves within approved claims authority.

  • Provides timely and appropriate evaluation of claims to identify and manage reserves in compliance with company standards.

  • Delivers outstanding customer service and satisfaction through effective interactions with insured, agents and legal counsel.

  • Provide feedback on claim trends and development. Provide input to underwriters on review of potential and existing insured’s claim experience.

  • Assists in developing, coaching, training and mentoring of individual team members.

  • Maintains current knowledge of applicable lines of insurance, insurance regulations, court decisions which may impact the claims function, current guidelines and policy changes and modifications. This may require attending various seminars and training sessions.

  • Contributes to a collaborative environment by consistently demonstrating teamwork, high motivation, positive behavior and effort to achieve goals and objectives.

  • Acts as a subject matter authority in a particular line of business or risk.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Claims Director, Freedom Specialty, or Associate Vice President

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: College degree preferred. Juris Doctorate desired.

License/Certification/Designation: Associates must acquire the required Federal and/or state licenses/registrations within the time period designated by the business unit. Additional licenses/registrations may be required when new products and services are implemented. If an associate fails or is unable to acquire required licenses/registrations within the designated time period, the associate will be ineligible to continue in the position.

Experience: Appropriate claims handling experience in specific line of business typically acquired through more than five years of experience. Demonstrated experience handling higher severity and/or complex claims and litigation required. Proven experience analyzing and handling complex coverage issues.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Specific and extensive knowledge in a particular line of business and/or additional education may be required by the hiring business unit. In-depth knowledge of the insurance industry, claims and the insurance legal and regulatory environment. Demonstrates aptitude in evaluating, analyzing and interpreting information; demonstrates expertise in particular line of business; excellent analytical skills; excellent written and verbal communication skills; the ability to multi-task; excellent time management and organizational skills; ability to work independently; ability to effectively and efficiently manage all responsibilities; ability to direct attorneys in claims and litigation management; ability to effectively present information to senior leaders, claimants and customers.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and HR Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates the Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Not Eligible (Exempt)

This position will report to the Director, Safety and Loss Control.


Are you a Referral?

If you know a current Encova Insurance associate and would like to apply as a referral, please encourage them to submit your referral information before you submit your application. You will receive an email with a direct URL link to the Job Posting of interest. Applying through this URL link will create your referral relationship for our Talent Acquisition Team.

Unique residence requirements are listed in each job posting, please review closely for details.

Encova is only able to employ associates who reside and work within specific U.S. states. Our current policies are based on the laws in states in which we are registered for payroll. Our current footprint includes:

Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin.



JOB OBJECTIVE:

The Safety and Loss Control Consultant conducts loss analysis and research prior to conducting on-site occupational safety and loss prevention surveys to assess the policy holder's safety efforts and to detect occupational safety hazards to employees. The Safety and Loss Control Consultant prepares and submits reports of findings to management and makes recommendations to management to correct hazards and safety and loss control program needs. This position also participates in management training programs; researches literature, laws, standards and technical developments in the field of safety and loss control and provides the Underwriting Department with risk assessments in support of underwriting determinations.


The Consultant works with standard to large accounts and accounts that present more complex hazard and safety issues. The Consultant may mentor and provide guidance to Safety and Loss Control Trainees as needed. The Consultant participates in training sessions for policyholders in conjunction with Senior Safety and Loss Control Consultants. This requires a vast working knowledge and experience with all aspects of loss control regarding all property and casualty coverages written by Encova:

• General and Products Liability

• Workers’ Compensation

• Property
• Auto/Fleet

• Risk Improvement

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
1. Consults with policy holders to improve the occupational safety programs and performance leading to a safer and healthier workplace.
2. Provides underwriters with information concerning the level of safety of policy holders
3. Evaluates policy holder safety programs and work sites for hazardous conditions
4. Conducts simple Industrial Hygiene testing.
5. Researches literature, standards, laws, and rules to provide policy holders with effective solutions.
6. Develops cost effective methods to correct hazardous conditions.
7. Analyzes loss information to determine accident trends and provide policy holders with effective solutions.
8. Provides underwriting with accurate and timely reports on the hazards and the effectiveness of controls and the willingness of the policy holder to comply with recommendations to control hazards.
9. Keeps underwriting apprised of any changes in hazards or exposures through copies of reports to policy holders and special reports to underwriting.
10. Responds to requests from policy holders, underwriters, and other agencies in a timely fashion regarding safety issues.
11. Communicates ideas and issues with management to reach successful agreement through innovation, creativity, and compromise.
12. Provides leadership and motivation of the support staff to achieve loss control goals and objectives.

OTHER FUNCTIONS:
1. Nonessential function: other duties as assigned.


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:
• Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university required. Preferably in safety, industrial hygiene, engineering or related field.
• Preference may be given to applicants with master's degree in Safety or Industrial Hygiene from an accredited college or university.
• Preference may be given to applicants with two years of full-time or equivalent part-time paid occupational safety management or occupational safety management consulting experience in industry or insurance.
• Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH), Certification as an Associate in Risk Management (ARM), Associated Safety Professional (ASP) are preferred.
• Knowledge of the various core elements within the occupational safety and industrial hygiene process.
• Knowledge of effective safety program management.
• Knowledge of risk management as it relates to safety and industrial hygiene as an overall function of business in planning, leading, and directing its operations.
• Knowledge of workers' compensation laws, policies and rules, as well as understanding of the principles of insurance and risk management.
• Basic understanding of guaranteed cost, deductibles, retrospective rating plans and the impact of accident prevention on each plan.
• Knowledge of the rating systems, methods of calculating experience modification factors and the elements of each formula.
• Understanding of the U. S. Department of Labor Bureau of Labor Statistics loss information, formulas and principles of calculating incidence rates for policy holders.
• Knowledge of basic business financial principles to analyze cost effectiveness and return on investment of recommended solutions to hazards and exposures.
• Ability to make sound judgments and work independently, and to establish and maintain effective working relationships with other policy holders, policyholders, regulatory agencies, and labor communities.
• Working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
• Ability to compile, analyze, and report on findings.
• Knowledge of Federal OSHA MSHA, DOT and NFPA standards.
• Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing.
• Ability to safely operate a motor vehicle.

• Must hold a valid driver’s license.

Encova Insurance makes every effort to reasonably accommodate disabilities to permit performance of the essential functions and candidates who need such accommodation are encouraged to seek it. It provides an accurate overview of the work and skills needed to perform this position. Join us to discover a work experience where you can learn and grow to your fullest potential.

What you can expect from us

Property Description

Davidson Hospitality Group is a dynamic and innovative hospitality management company that is constantly seeking top talent to join its team. With its headquarters located in the heart of the hospitality industry in Atlanta, Georgia, Davidson Hospitality Group is a leader in hotel and resort management, providing comprehensive and results-driven services to a diverse portfolio of properties across the United States. As a job applicant, you can expect to work in a collaborative and supportive environment that encourages creativity, growth, and professional development. With a strong commitment to excellence in guest service, employee engagement, and financial performance, Davidson Hospitality Group offers a rewarding and fulfilling career path for individuals who are passionate about the hospitality industry. Whether you are seeking a corporate role in operations, sales and marketing, revenue management, finance, human resources, or other areas, Davidson Hospitality Group offers a wide range of career opportunities for motivated and talented individuals. Join the team at Davidson Hospitality Group and be a part of a dynamic and growing organization that is dedicated to delivering exceptional hospitality experiences.

Overview

Bring Hospitality Brands to Life Through Storytelling

Are you the person who spots a social media trend before it goes viral? Do you love creating content that inspires people to travel, dine, and experience unforgettable destinations?

Davidson Hospitality Group is seeking a creative, strategic, and results-driven remote Social Media Manager to join our growing Marketing & Communications team. In this role, you'll help shape the online presence of some of the most exciting hotels, resorts, and restaurants across the country by creating engaging content, building online communities, driving audience growth, and helping generate revenue through innovative social media strategies.

As the day-to-day client lead for SocialLite, Davidson's in-house social media agency, you'll collaborate with hospitality leaders and marketing teams to tell compelling stories that capture attention, inspire engagement, and elevate our brands.

If you're passionate about hospitality, digital marketing, content creation, influencer partnerships, and social media strategy, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Do

Develop & Execute Social Media Strategies

  • Collaborate on social media strategies for hotels, resorts, and restaurants across the Davidson portfolio.
  • Build and manage cohesive monthly content calendars aligned with brand objectives and business goals.
  • Identify emerging social media trends, platform updates, and opportunities to maximize reach and engagement.

Create Engaging Content

  • Develop channel-specific content for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.
  • Create compelling posts, stories, reels, and campaigns that increase brand awareness, audience engagement, and revenue opportunities.
  • Design and edit social media graphics using Canva while maintaining brand standards and visual consistency.
  • Source, organize, and manage user-generated content (UGC), securing permissions and maintaining a robust content library.

Grow Communities & Build Engagement

  • Actively engage with audiences through comments, messages, and community management initiatives.
  • Foster authentic connections with guests, customers, influencers, and brand advocates.
  • Develop promotions, sweepstakes, collaborations, and social campaigns that increase audience growth and participation.

Lead Influencer & Partnership Initiatives

  • Identify, cultivate, and manage strategic influencer relationships that align with brand goals.
  • Negotiate and coordinate influencer partnerships while tracking performance and return on investment.
  • Create innovative collaboration opportunities that drive visibility and measurable business results.

Analyze Performance & Share Insights

  • Monitor, analyze, and report on social media performance metrics and KPIs.
  • Deliver actionable insights and recommendations based on engagement, audience growth, reach, and conversion data.
  • Present social media results, industry trends, and strategic recommendations during monthly client meetings.

Why Davidson Hospitality Group?

At Davidson Hospitality Group, we believe exceptional guest experiences begin with exceptional people. As one of the nation's leading hospitality management companies, we manage an impressive portfolio of hotels, resorts, and restaurants across the country.

When you join Davidson, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Work with iconic hospitality brands and unique independent properties.
  • Collaborate with talented marketing and hospitality professionals.
  • Influence social media strategy across a diverse portfolio of destinations.
  • Grow your career with an organization committed to innovation, creativity, and professional development.
  • Make a measurable impact on how guests discover and engage with our brands.

Ready to turn great hospitality stories into unforgettable social experiences? Apply today and help shape the digital voice of Davidson Hospitality Group.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional social media management experience, preferably within an agency, hospitality, travel, lifestyle, food & beverage, or related environment.
  • Proven experience managing multiple social media accounts across major platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and LinkedIn.
  • Strong understanding of social media strategy, content marketing, audience development, and community management.
  • Experience using Sprout Social or similar social media management platforms.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, storytelling, and communication skills.
  • Experience presenting social media performance metrics and recommendations to senior leaders or clients.
  • Video editing experience, particularly for short-form content and Reels.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Ability to travel occasionally as business needs require.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Public Relations, or a related field.

Preferred Characteristics

  • Passion for hospitality, travel, restaurants, and guest experiences.
  • Creative thinker with an entrepreneurial mindset and a willingness to test new ideas.
  • Naturally curious and always ahead of emerging social media trends.
  • Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Driven to build a long-term career with a growing hospitality organization.

Benefits

Davidson Hospitality Group is an award-winning, full-service hospitality management company overseeing hotels, restaurants, dining and entertainment venues across the US. A trusted partner and preferred operator for Hilton, Hyatt, Kimpton, Marriott, and Margaritaville, Davidson offers a unique entrepreneurial management style and owners’ mentality that provides the individualized personal service of a small company, enhanced by the breadth and depth of skill and experience of a larger company. In keeping with the company’s heritage of delivering value, Davidson is comprised of four highly specialized operating verticals: Davidson Hotels, Pivot, Davidson Resorts and Davidson Restaurant Group.

In keeping with the company’s heritage of delivering value to its owners and team members, Davidson offers a rich benefit program with a variety of benefits designed to enrich the lives and well-being of our team members and their families.

  • Multiple Tiers of Medical Coverage
  • Dental & Vision Coverage
  • 24/7 Teledoc service
  • Free Maintenance Medications
  • Pet Insurance
  • Hotel Discounts
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Paid Time Off (vacation, sick, bereavement, and Holidays).
  • 401K Match

Working at Davidson is like nowhere else. It’s less of a job, more of a calling. It’s part career, part revolution. Because whatever you do here, you play a part in helping redefine the way quality hospitality is delivered to our guests, our clients, our partners, and each other.EOE AA- Minorities/Females/Vet/Disability/Gender Identity/Sexual OrientationDavidson Hospitality is a drug free workplace. We’ve managed to maintain a small company feel with the stability and resources of a much larger one. We fully believe in the flexibility of a remote workplace. Employees are trusted to manage their time and get things done independently. We believe that egos and politics need to be checked at the virtual door. raw.description:
On behalf of DataTech Client #1, SD Solutions is looking for a talented Technical Project Manager to lead client implementations of a product, a Master Data Management (MDM) platform that runs inside each client's own Databricks workspace and cloud environment.

You will own delivery from kickoff to go-live: planning the work, coordinating Frisco Analytics engineers with client data, security, and business teams, and keeping everyone clear on status, risks, and decisions. Because the platform is deployed in the client's environment, much of the work is shared with client teams, so clear and steady communication matters as much as technical fluency in this role.

SD Solutions is a staffing company operating globally. Contact us to get more details about the benefits we offer.

Responsibilities:

Delivery and planning

  • Run two to three concurrent product implementations end to end: scope, plan, schedule, budget, and go-live.
  • Break each engagement into workstreams such as environment setup, source system onboarding, match tuning, data steward enablement, and production cutover.
  • Track milestones, dependencies and resourcing, and fix slippage early rather than reporting it late.
  • Manage scope and change requests through a clear, documented process.

Client and stakeholder coordination

  • Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for client sponsors, data owners, platform administrators, and business data stewards.
  • Coordinate the work clients own in their own environment, such as Databricks workspace access, Unity Catalog permissions, and cloud infrastructure, so it lands on time.
  • Facilitate decisions on match rules, confidence thresholds, and steward review workflows, and record who decided what and why.
  • Lead steering committee meetings and executive readouts.

Security and compliance support

  • Work with Frisco Analytics and product teams to support client security reviews and due diligence questionnaires during onboarding.
  • Ensure implementation team members follow the access, data handling, and confidentiality requirements that apply to client engagements.
  • Route security incidents or concerns to the right owners promptly.

Team leadership

  • Coordinate a delivery team of data engineers and consultants without direct reporting authority.
  • Run sprint ceremonies, stand-ups and retrospectives, and keep project tooling and documentation current.
  • Capture lessons learned to improve Frisco Analytics' implementation playbook.

How you'll communicate

Strong communication is the core skill of this role. You will be the person clients and engineers rely on to know where things stand and what happens next.

  • Translate between audiences. Explain entity matching, golden records, and access permissions to business sponsors in plain language and turn business needs into clear requirements for engineers.
  • Write clearly. Produce concise status reports, RAID logs, decision records, meeting notes, and project plans that a busy executive can scan in two minutes.
  • Run focused meetings. Set agendas, keep discussions on track, close with owners and dates, and send follow-ups the same day.
  • Deliver hard news early. Raise risks, delays, and scope issues directly, with options and a recommendation, before they become surprises.
  • Listen and ask good questions. Uncover unstated requirements, client constraints, and concerns from security and governance teams.
  • Hold firm, kindly. Push back on scope creep and unrealistic dates while keeping the relationship strong.
  • Present with confidence. Lead steering committees, demos, and executive readouts for client leadership.

Requirements:

  • 4 to 7 years of experience in project management, with at least 3 years managing client-facing technical or data projects.
  • A track record of delivering data platform, data integration, analytics, or enterprise software implementations on time and within budget.
  • Working knowledge of cloud data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake or similar) and at least one major cloud provider (AWS or Azure).
  • Understanding of data concepts such as data quality, data governance, role-based access control, and handling of personal data (PII).
  • Comfort with both Agile and Waterfall delivery, and the judgment to blend them for a client's needs.
  • Excellent written and verbal English, with examples of client-facing reports, presentations, or executive updates you have owned.
  • Experience with project tooling such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or MS Project.
  • A bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, business, or equivalent experience.

Advantages:

  • Experience implementing Master Data Management (MDM), entity resolution, or customer 360 solutions.
  • Hands-on familiarity with Databricks Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, or Databricks workflows.
  • Exposure to AI or machine learning features in enterprise software, including how to explain human review and auditability to clients.
  • Experience supporting client security reviews, vendor due diligence, or compliance requirements such as SOC 2.
  • A PMP, PMI-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or similar certification.
  • Consulting or systems integrator background, working across several clients at once.

About the company:

A Databricks-native SaaS platform built to consolidate enterprise data into a single AI-ready layer. The product covers three domains: master data management (MDM), relationship graphs, and product information management (PIM) — all governed and deduplicated via LLMs and running natively on the Databricks Lakehouse.

By applying for this position, you agree to the terms outlined in our Privacy Policy. Please take a moment to review our Privacy Policy , and make sure you understand its contents. If you have any questions or concerns regarding our Privacy Policy, please feel free to contact us.

raw.description:
AI Solutions Architect / Copilot Developer

Human-centered problem-solving meets Microsoft AI technology

Role Overview

We're looking for someone who thinks like a strategist, debates like a philosopher, and builds like an engineer. This role sits inside our AI Solutions Group, where the individual will need to reason clearly about ambiguous problems, build consensus among stakeholders, and translate that thinking into working solutions on the Microsoft Power Platform.

You'll partner directly with clients to figure out where AI can provide tangible improvements, gather and interpret requirements (even when clients aren't sure what they need), build solutions using Power Platform tools, help test and validate what you've built, and keep it optimized over time. This role is about people, logic, and persuasion as much as it is about implementation.

Why This Role Is Different

We believe the core skills for working effectively with AI aren't primarily technical. They're:

  • Creative problem solving: finding non-obvious paths through ambiguous, messy, or "less than optimal" situations
  • Strategic thinking: seeing the whole system, not just the ticket in front of you
  • Logic and structured reasoning: the same discipline that makes a good philosopher makes a good prompt engineer and a good solution architect
  • Communication and diplomacy: building consensus among stakeholders with competing priorities, teaching non-technical teams, and handholding through change

If you have a background in philosophy, strategy consulting, teaching, mediation, debate, logic, systems thinking, or similar disciplines, and you're excited by AI tools, we want to talk to you, even if your technical resume looks nontraditional.

What You'll Actually Do

With Clients

  • Act as a trusted advisor: ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, and help clients articulate problems they haven't fully defined yet
  • Build consensus across stakeholders with different, sometimes conflicting, priorities. This is often the hardest part of the job
  • Teach and support end users through change, including patient handholding for less AI-fluent teams
  • Translate business problems into technical requirements, and technical constraints back into plain language

Building the Solution

  • Design and develop solutions in Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot Studio, and related Power Platform tools

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to present to and persuade skeptical or non-technical audiences
  • Diplomacy and consensus-building, with comfort navigating disagreement without avoiding it
  • A genuine curiosity about AI and a track record of picking up new tools quickly

Technical qualifications:

Preferred:

Work Environment

This is a strategic development role on a high-performing team helping organizations reimagine how they work with AI, using Microsoft Power Platform, Copilot, Claude, and beyond. The technology moves fast, and we have a need for people who can think clearly, communicate persuasively, and navigate ambiguity with grace. If that's you, let’s talk.

Role Overview

The Manufacturing Process Engineer will work closely with Product Design, Manufacturing Engineering, contract manufacturers, and equipment suppliers to develop robust, scalable, and cost-effective manufacturing processes for high-volume consumer electronics products.

The role will support the full product development lifecycle, from early product architecture and design decisions through process development, equipment qualification, factory implementation, and mass production readiness.

Key Responsibilities

  • Influence product definition and architecture selection through early Design for Manufacturing engagement with Product Design teams.
  • Develop manufacturing processes across areas including precision electronic assembly, automation, sealing, adhesive application, metal fabrication and finishing, injection molding, and leak testing.
  • Lead the specification, design, prototyping, fabrication, validation, and implementation of manufacturing processes, fixtures, and equipment.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing partners and equipment suppliers to develop robust and scalable production solutions.
  • Improve manufacturing efficiency, flexibility, and scalability through workflow analysis, capacity planning, space optimization, and equipment layout.
  • Identify, evaluate, and introduce new manufacturing processes, technologies, and equipment.
  • Support process qualification, factory implementation, and production ramp.
  • Drive improvements in manufacturability, yield, cycle time, quality, and production efficiency.
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, technical program management, or related roles.
  • Experience leading the specification, development, and implementation of manufacturing fixtures, equipment, and process flows.
  • Experience collaborating with design teams early in the hardware lifecycle to incorporate Design for Manufacturing principles.
  • Experience with high-volume, high-precision consumer electronics is highly preferred.
  • Experience with NX or other CAD tools is a plus.
  • Familiarity with DOE, GRR, tolerance analysis, and statistical analysis.
  • Experience working with geographically distributed teams and Asia-based manufacturing partners.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, technical program management, or related roles.
  • Experience leading the specification, development, and implementation of manufacturing fixtures, equipment, and process flows.

  • Experience with high-volume, high-precision consumer electronics is highly preferred.
  • Experience with NX or other CAD tools is a plus.
  • Familiarity with DOE, GRR, tolerance analysis, and statistical analysis.
  • Experience working with geographically distributed teams and Asia-based manufacturing partners.

We’re looking for an ambitious Director of Service Desk and Service Management to provide strategic leadership across our Service Desk and Service Management functions and to lead their modernisation, using AI and automation to transform how we support our colleagues and customers.

This is a senior technology leadership role with responsibility for setting the direction of critical IT services, leading senior service teams and ensuring our services are resilient, efficient, secure and focused on delivering excellent outcomes for our customers. You will play a central part in shaping how AI-enabled service management is adopted across Capita.

You’ll shape the strategy and operating model for the function, using data and insight to improve performance, drive standardisation, automation and continuous improvement, and ensure our services evolve alongside changing customer and technology needs, including the move towards intelligent self-service, virtual agents and proactive support.

Alongside operational leadership, you’ll have significant responsibility for financial performance, governance, security and risk, while building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Capita.

This is an opportunity for an established IT Services leader to influence at a senior level while leading a large and important area of our technology organisation.

Job title:

Director Service Desk & Service Management

Job Description:

Essential:

  • Significant senior leadership experience within IT Service Management and Service Desk environments, with accountability for large-scale technology services, operational performance and service improvement
  • Extensive knowledge of ITSM technologies and methodologies, including platforms such as ServiceNow or BMC and disciplines including Incident, Change, Problem, Capacity and Major Incident Management
  • Experience of introducing AI, automation or intelligent self-service into IT service operations, with an understanding of the security, data privacy and governance considerations involved

In addition, you will also have:

  • Experience leading senior managers and developing high-performing service organisations
  • Strong commercial and financial management experience, including accountability for budgets, cost management and service performance
  • Experience developing technology or service strategies, operating models and improvement roadmaps
  • Experience using data, management information and performance insight to improve service delivery
  • A strong understanding of IT service governance, operational risk, security and compliance
  • Experience of working with senior and executive stakeholders and influencing across a complex organisation
  • The ability to balance strategic leadership with accountability for day-to-day operational performance
  • Up-to-date knowledge of technology, service-management trends and emerging opportunities, including AI, automation and AIOps
  • Experience of improving customer and colleague experience through self-service, omnichannel support and proactive service

Key responsibilities:

  • Providing strategic leadership and direction across Service Desk and Service Management
  • Developing and delivering a roadmap for AI-enabled service management, including virtual agents, intelligent triage, knowledge automation and predictive insight
  • Modernising service platforms, tooling and processes to reduce manual effort, ticket volumes and cost to serve
  • Embedding responsible AI governance, including security, data privacy and human oversight, across the function
  • Improving colleague and customer experience through omnichannel, self-service and proactive support
  • Setting a clear vision, strategy, objectives and roadmap aligned to wider technology and business priorities
  • Leading and developing Heads of Service Lines, building capability and succession across the function, including the skills needed for an AI-enabled service organisation
  • Ensuring day-to-day service operations are effective, resilient and aligned to customer requirements
  • Using data, insight and performance reporting to identify challenges, opportunities and priorities for improvement
  • Driving consolidation, standardisation, automation and continuous service improvement
  • Developing cost-effective delivery models aligned to business strategy and industry good practice
  • Taking accountability for the financial performance of the business area and providing clear reporting through governance forums
  • Building effective relationships with senior stakeholders across Technology, the wider organisation, customers and partners
  • Acting as a senior escalation point for Service Desk and Service Management
  • Ensuring appropriate operational, security, risk and compliance governance is embedded across the function
  • Supporting audits and ensuring services operate in line with relevant security policies and controls
  • Ensuring the function remains responsive to emerging technologies, market developments and changing business requirements
  • Leading change and adoption so that colleagues understand and are confident using new tools, AI and ways of working

You’ll create a clear strategic direction for IT Services, modernising how we deliver support and embedding AI and automation, while ensuring strong and predictable operational performance.


Success will mean delivering resilient and effective services, improving customer and colleague outcomes, strengthening governance and financial performance, and building a service organisation that continuously evolves. It will be measured through outcomes such as ticket deflection through self-service and automation, faster time to resolution, higher user satisfaction and lower cost to serve.


You’ll also develop strong leadership capability across your teams, ensuring colleagues understand the strategy, are empowered to deliver against it and have opportunities to develop.


What’s in it for you?

  • 💻 Home based
  • 💰 Competitive salary and bonus
  • 🌴 23 days’ holiday, rising to 27 (pro rata) – plus the option to buy more after qualifying period
  • ❤️ Paid volunteering day with a charity of your choice
  • 🍼 Generous family leave policies – including 15 weeks’ fully paid maternity, adoption, and shared parental leave
  • 🚴‍♀️ Cycle2Work scheme, pension, life assurance, and more

What we hope you’ll do next:

Choose ‘Apply now’ to fill out our short application, so that we can find out more about you.

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. As part of our strategic goals, we are focused on accelerating gender and ethnic representation in leadership roles. We warmly encourage applications from women and individuals from Black, Asian, and other ethnic minority backgrounds.

We’re an equal opportunity and Disability Confident employer, which means we recruit and develop people based on their merit and passion. We’re committed to providing an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment process and working environment for everyone. If you need the job description or application form in an alternative format (such as large print or audio), or if you’d like to discuss other changes or support you might need going forward, please email and we’ll get back to you.

For more information about equal opportunities and process adjustments, please visit the Capita Careers website.


AI & Fair Recruitment at Capita
At Capita, we use technology, including AI-enabled tools, to help us manage applications consistently and fairly. These tools support our recruitment teams, they do not make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by a trained member of our Talent Acquisition team, and all decisions are made by people. If you need any adjustments during the process, we’re here to support you.

How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process
To help us deliver a fair, consistent and efficient recruitment experience, Capita uses AI-assisted technology at some stages of the process. These tools simply help us organise and assess information, they do not replace human judgement. All decisions are made by our recruitment team and hiring managers. If you have any questions or need adjustments, please let us know and we’ll be happy to support you.

raw.description:
Role Title: Contracts Attorney

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (US Based)

micro1 is engaging Contracts Attorneys to contribute to a confidential project at the intersection of law and AI. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. The work draws directly on day-to-day commercial contracting practice: reviewing agreements, marking up drafts, and applying company policy positions the way in-house counsel would.

Scope of Work

  1. Review and redline commercial agreements, including MSAs, NDAs, DPAs, and similar documents, in accordance with established playbooks and policies.
  2. Analyze drafts to identify key issues and determine applicable company positions and acceptable fallback outcomes.
  3. Draft clear, reasoned written explanations detailing the rationale behind each redline or revision.
  4. Apply advanced contract drafting, negotiation, and technology transactions knowledge to real-world legal documents.
  5. Collaborate with the project team to ensure consistency of standards and interpretations throughout the engagement.
  6. Maintain meticulous attention to detail and uphold high standards of legal writing and contract review quality.
  7. Work independently within a remote, deadline-driven project environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school and active bar admission in a U.S. jurisdiction.
  2. Minimum of 4 years' experience in transactional practice at a law firm or as an in-house attorney, focusing on contract drafting, review, and negotiation.
  3. Deep familiarity with commonly negotiated commercial provisions, such as limitation of liability, indemnification, confidentiality, and data protection.
  4. Proven ability to synthesize complex legal concepts and deliver clear, actionable written analyses.
  5. Demonstrated sound judgment and a high level of accuracy in contract review and interpretation.
  6. Expertise in technology transactions considered a strong plus.
  7. Adaptability and drive to contribute to a high-impact, innovative legal project in a confidential setting.

raw.description:
Role Title: General Counsel

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

Job Summary:We are seeking seasoned General Counsels for a part-time role at the forefront of legal AI. This opportunity is for elite lawyers who want to help shape how advanced AI is trained, evaluated, and applied in real-world legal work, especially those who have deep experience with drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and redlining within the tech field.

In this role, you will review, assess, and contribute to contract redlining workflows used to train and evaluate state-of-the-art AI models. Your work will directly improve how these systems identify risk and interpret contract language to create tools with improved precision and legal judgment.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Perform simulated contract negotiations and redlining exercises.
  2. Review and assess AI responses to contract scenarios, providing expert feedback to improve model performance and output precision.
  3. Create objective evaluation frameworks and grading criteria to assess AI performance on contract tasks with rigor and consistency.
  4. Collaborate with product and research teams to refine data, guidelines, and best practices for AI-driven contract review solutions.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  1. Minimum of 3 years of in-house experience focused on technology transactions, particularly negotiating MSAs, NDAs, ISDAs and DPAs.
  2. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with meticulous attention to detail.
  3. Strong analytical capabilities and ability to translate legal expertise into actionable feedback for AI systems.
  4. Demonstrated commitment to innovation at the intersection of law and technology.
  5. Experience working with cross-disciplinary teams in fast-paced environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Prior exposure to AI, legal tech, or training initiatives.

Why Join:

  1. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of law and technology.
  2. You will help define how AI is developed for a new generation of legal practitioners.
  3. You will apply your experience in a high-impact research environment.

Compensation Structure:

Compensation is task-based, meaning experts are paid per completed task that meets the project specifications. The average handling time (AHT) is approximately 3.5 hours per task, and the effective hourly rate will depend on the number of tasks completed and successfully signed off.

raw.description:
Ciklum is looking for a Lead Delivery Manager to join our team full-time in India.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Lead Delivery Manager, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.

Client builds infrastructure for payments across global markets. Its modular, flexible, and scalable technology enables leading companies to accept next-generation payments, provide a wide range of payout options, and leverage capabilities across card issuing, banking, risk, and fraud management services.

We are building an AI-assisted engineering playbook and delivering the consolidation of legacy acquiring, clearing and settlement platforms onto a modern .NET, Python and Azure based core, with strong emphasis on integration, quality engineering, performance and secure, PCI-compliant delivery.

Responsibilities:

  • Participate in pre-sales and support the creation of delivery proposals that align with client needs and Ciklum’s capabilities
  • Coordinate team ramp-up and onboarding, ensuring alignment with recruitment and delivery setup
  • Apply and maintain delivery best practices in tools, processes, and communication flows (e.g. using PRODIGY templates)
  • Monitor changing client requirements and raise improvement opportunities or service adjustments to senior delivery leads
  • Build effective working relationships with client counterparts to support project execution and day-to-day coordination
  • Define and manage project scope, deliverables, timelines, and resources
  • Estimate, plan, and adjust project activities from initiation through completion, ensuring milestones are met
  • Monitor and support team performance to ensure motivation, accountability, and delivery consistency
  • Track and report project progress, risks, and financials to internal stakeholders and clients using established tools and processes
  • Prepare and present project documentation, including reports, dashboards, and meeting materials
  • Proactively identify and escalate risks or blockers, collaborating with relevant stakeholders to develop solutions
  • Contribute feedback and suggestions to improve internal processes, tools, and delivery practices across the organization

Requirements:

  • 2–4 years of experience in IT project delivery, coordination, or team management
  • Experience managing or coordinating teams of up to 20 FTEs
  • Exposure to scope control, scheduling, and team coordination
  • Solid understanding of Scrum, Kanban, and general Agile delivery lifecycles
  • Familiarity with contract types (SOW, MSA) and how they affect delivery terms
  • Working knowledge of software development lifecycle and ability to monitor delivery progress (e.g. Scrum burndown chart, Gantt diagram)
  • Comfortable with delivery tooling (JIRA, Confluence, etc.)
  • Working knowledge of team ramp-up, resourcing plans, and staffing
  • Basic financial literacy, including gross margin, rate cards, headcount allocation, and budget forecasting
  • Able to communicate with technical and non-technical stakeholders effectively
  • Intermediate English (B2+) for written and verbal communication
  • Bachelor’s/Master's in IT, Business, or a similar field
  • Agile certification recommended (Scrum Master or ICAgile)
  • Foundations in project management methodologies (PMI CAPM or similar) are a plus

What’s in it for you?

  • Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
  • Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
  • Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
  • Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
  • Care: We’ve got you covered with company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial & legal consultations

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

We are hiring a Member Appeals & Grievance Analyst at BCBST!

In this role, you will review and process appeals and grievances submitted by members and providers, ensuring timely and accurate resolution in compliance with CMS and Medicare guidelines. You will evaluate cases, determine appropriate next steps, and manage multiple priorities while meeting required turnaround times.

You’ll play a critical role in maintaining regulatory compliance, improving member experience, and supporting high-quality outcomes through detailed case analysis and effective use of digital tools to drive efficiency.

To be successful in this role, in addition to the core job requirements, you'll bring strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a customer-focused approach. You will be a strong candidate if you have knowledge of Medicare and CMS regulations, as well as experience with the appeals and grievance process.

A clinical background or prior experience in a healthcare setting (preferred) will further strengthen your candidacy. Additionally, you should demonstrate strong data entry accuracy and case management skills, along with experience using or enthusiasm for leveraging AI tools (e.g., Copilot) to improve workflow efficiency.

We foster a culture where innovation is encouraged. That includes using AI enabled tools responsibly to support everyday work — guided by proven workflows, templates, and policies. As roles become more advanced, we expect employees to leverage AI more broadly to transform how we serve members.

Note

  • This is a fully remote role with a 40-hour work week, with flexibility.
  • This role requires working some weekends and holidays in rotation.
  • Sponsorship is not available for this role

Job Responsibilities

  • Documenting and investigating the substance of the appeal, grievance, or complaint and the action taken, including any aspects of clinical care or reimbursement issues involved.
  • Notifying involved parties of the outcome of a review (i.e. approval and/or denial of an appeal, grievance or complaint), including CMS and the member or appellant of the resolution of all CMS complaints in the appropriate timeframes as set forth by the applicable regulatory rules and regulations.
  • Providing excellent customer services to members, provider and CMS.
  • Maintaining knowledge of and adhering to CMS regulations and guidelines affecting the appeal/grievance/complaint process.

Job Qualifications

Education

  • Associates degree or equivalent work experience required

Experience

  • 2 years - Customer service and/or claims experience

Skills\Certifications

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint)
  • Proficient oral and written communication skills
  • Proficient interpersonal and organizational skills
  • Ability to work independently under general supervision and collaboratively as part of a team in a fast paced environment
  • Capacity to solve problems and manage multiple assignments with critical deadlines; including analyzing claims, medical records & documents pertinent to the case review
  • Knowledge of CMS regulations and guidelines related to appeals, grievances and complaints

1

raw.description:
Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Lifestyle

We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. As a member of HARMAN Lifestyle, you connect consumers with the power of superior sound.

  • Contribute your talents to high-end, esteemed brands like JBL, Mark Levinson, Roon, Revel, Denon, and Bowers & Wilkins

  • Unite your passion for audio innovation with high-tech product development

  • Create pitch-perfect, cutting-edge technology that elevates the listening experience

About the Role

HARMAN's Software Experiences Business Unit (SEBU) builds software products that connect people to music. Our portfolio includes Roon, the leading music library management and playback platform for audiophiles, alongside new music products currently in development.

In this role you will help our product teams understand the people we build for. You will run competitive and user research across music discovery, streaming, and short-form content, sit inside the day-to-day work of a product team, and bring back the language, habits, and unmet needs of a younger audience in a form the team can act on.

This is a paid internship, and you will work as a member of the team rather than an observer. Length of the internship is dependent on when your new hire onboarding happens, but a typical program is 12-weeks. You will join standups and reviews, own your own research threads, and present what you learn directly to the people making product decisions.

How You'll Make An Impact

  • Work as an embedded member of the team: join standups, design and product marketing discussions and product reviews, and contribute ideas as a working member of the group.

  • Track and analyze competitors and adjacent products to identify feature gaps, emerging trends, and unmet needs in the category.

  • Maintain a competitive tracker the team can use week-to-week, covering feature releases, notable launches, and shifts in how competitors position themselves.

  • Recruit and interview users in the 16 to 25 age range, with support from the product and marketing teams, to surface authentic language, listening habits, and unmet needs around music discovery and sharing.

  • Support structured usability and concept testing on new features and prototypes: help run sessions, capture qualitative and quantitative feedback, and turn it into concrete recommendations the team can act on within a development sprint.

  • Investigate how the target audience responds to curation and algorithmic recommendation, and feed what you find into feed and curation discussions.

  • Study visual and interaction trends across music, social, and related apps, and share what you find so our product and design teams stay current with what feels credible to a Gen Z audience.

  • Listen to public conversation about products in our category across Reddit, Discord, TikTok comments, and app store reviews, and flag the themes worth the team’s attention.

  • Support user feedback programs alongside the community and R&D teams: help draft survey questions, track incoming feedback and bug reports, and keep a running log of recurring themes.

  • Keep the research repository usable: tag and organize interview notes, clips, and findings so the team can still find them after the internship ends.

  • Summarize findings regularly into short internal documents the team can act on week to week, and deliver a final write-up and presentation pulling together the full 12 weeks of insight.

  • Own one self-directed project: define a question about the product with your manager, run the research, and present your recommendation to the team.

What Makes You A Strong Fit

  • Must be currently enrolled in a Bachelor's Degree program or higher at an accredited institution having completed your Sophomore year or later, taking at least one class in the semester/quarter before participation in the internship program, and returning to school for at least one semester upon completion of the internship program

  • Must have a cumulative 3.0 GPA

  • Preferred degree program in business, marketing, design, human-computer interaction, communications, music business, or a related field.

  • Genuine curiosity about consumer products and how people find, share, and talk about music.

  • Strong written communication: able to turn messy notes into a short, clear document that someone else can act on without a walkthrough.

  • Comfort talking to people you do not know, running an interview, and asking the follow-up question rather than accepting the first answer.

  • Organized and self-directed, able to manage several research threads at once with light supervision in a remote environment.

  • Comfortable working with survey results and simple data sets, and willing to report what the findings actually show, including when they are inconvenient.

  • Hands-on familiarity, as a user, with the platforms where music culture happens, including TikTok, Instagram, Discord, Reddit, and the major streaming services.

  • Discretion with confidential product, partner, and roadmap information.

Bonus Points if You Have

  • Prior internship, coursework, or project experience in user research, product management, marketing, or design.

  • Practical exposure to research methods such as interviews, surveys, or usability testing.

  • Experience building an audience or creating content on a social platform, or moderating an online community.

  • Working knowledge of tools such as Figma, Notion, and survey or analytics platforms.

  • Fluency with AI tools and a habit of using them to work faster and better: synthesizing interview notes, drafting research summaries, and speeding up desk research.

  • A personal stake in music: musician, DJ, playlist curator, writer, or active participant in a scene.

Things To Know

  • This role allows for remote work and a candidate can be located anywhere in the United States.

  • This position allows for up to 20 hours per week, constituting a Part-Time Internship. Flexibility for more working hours is at the discretion and ability of the business unit.

  • Successfully complete a background investigation and drug screen as a condition of employment (post-offer).

What You Can Expect

  • Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)

  • Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs

  • Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being

  • An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development

Pay Transparency

Freshman: $19.00

Sophomore: $21.00

Junior: $23.00

Senior: $24.00

Master: $28.00

Dependent on the internship offered, pay is based on factors, including without limitation, the applicant's level of education and business need.

Benefits

HARMAN is interested in your health and wellbeing and offers benefits designed to support your wellbeing. Benefits and perks may vary depending on the nature of your relationship with HARMAN, and may include paid sick leave and medical benefits.

About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology
Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.
Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.
If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!

Important Notice: Recruitment Scams

Please be aware that HARMAN recruiters will always communicate with you from an '@harman.com' email address. We will never ask for payments, banking, credit card, personal financial information or access to your LinkedIn/email account during the screening, interview, or recruitment process. If you are asked for such information or receive communication from an email address not ending in '@harman.com' about a job with HARMAN, please cease communication immediately and report the incident to us through: .


You Belong Here

HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.
HARMAN is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. HARMAN strives to hire the best qualified candidates and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse marketplaces and communities of our global colleagues and customers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.HARMAN attracts, hires, and develops employees based on merit, qualifications and job-related performance.()

HARMAN is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process, please contact us at . Requests will be considered on a case-by-case basis in accordance with applicable law.

raw.description:
About Us

Chess.com is one of the largest gaming sites in the world and the #1 platform for playing, learning, and enjoying chess.

We are a team of 600+ fully remote people in 60+ countries working hard to serve the global chess community. We are here to support 250M+ chess players worldwide with the best possible product, content, and tools to serve the community!

We are a tech company. A gaming company. A content company. And we do it all with passion and commitment to the game. Above all we prize our mission-driven, flat, life-celebrating, no-corporate culture, and we look forward to meeting you and learning more about what you can bring to the team.

About the Role

The Security Engineer plays a critical role in protecting our technology infrastructure and maintaining the security posture of our gaming platform. This position exists to proactively identify, assess, and mitigate security vulnerabilities while serving as a trusted security advisor to engineering teams across the organization. The role directly impacts our ability to safeguard user data, maintain platform integrity, and ensure secure development practices are embedded throughout our product development lifecycle.

This position is essential for building and maintaining robust security defenses in a fast-paced, remote-first technology environment where security expertise must be seamlessly integrated into daily engineering operations and strategic decision-making processes.

What you'll do

  • Lead vulnerability management program by triaging, reproducing, and assessing security vulnerabilities submitted through Bug Bounty programs, working directly with engineering teams to prioritize and remediate discovered security gaps
  • Conduct comprehensive threat modeling by collaborating with engineering teams to analyze proposed solutions, ensuring designs meet security industry standards and identifying potential attack vectors before implementation
  • Manage security incident response by reviewing penetration testing results and SIEM reports, translating technical findings into actionable remediation tasks, and tracking resolution progress through completion
  • Optimize security infrastructure by applying updates to Web Application Firewalls (WAF) and other security systems, ensuring configurations align with current threat landscape and organizational needs
  • Drive security tool evaluation and implementation by researching, evaluating, and recommending security software solutions, attending vendor demonstrations, and leading procurement processes from requirements gathering through deployment
  • Provide security consultation and guidance by serving as subject matter expert to development teams, ensuring security best practices are integrated into software development lifecycle and architectural decisions
  • Maintain security awareness and documentation by communicating security updates, progress reports, and recommendations to stakeholders through established channels and maintaining current security policies and procedures

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related technical field, or equivalent professional experience
  • Minimum 3+ years of professional experience specifically in web application security
  • Demonstrated expertise with security testing tools such as Burp Suite or equivalent web request analysis and tampering tools
  • Strong written communication skills in English with ability to clearly explain technical security concepts to diverse audiences
  • Experience working effectively in fully distributed/remote team environments
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with engineering and development teams

Preferred Skills and Qualifications

  • Previous hands-on experience managing or participating in Bug Bounty programs
  • Programming experience in PHP or JavaScript
  • Experience with penetration testing methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SIEM platforms and security monitoring systems
  • Familiarity with Web Application Firewall (WAF) configuration and management
  • Understanding of secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices
  • Experience with Jira or similar project management and issue tracking systems
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in a flat organizational structure
  • Passion for continuous learning and staying current with evolving security threats and technologies

About the Opportunity

  • This is a full-time opportunity
  • We are 100% remote (work from anywhere!)

---

You can learn more about us here:

  • Chess Is For Everyone!
  • Our Values

This is a remote position.

Channel Partner – School Education Programs | IMAV Learning Academy
Location: Pan-India
Engagement: Partnership, 100% commission
Who can apply: Individuals and companies
About IMAV
IMAV Learning Academy is a fully online, live-taught EdTech company delivering NEP 2020-aligned AI, Coding, Robotics and IoT education to CBSE/ICSE/IGCSE schools, Grades 3–12.
The opportunity
We are looking for partners who already have access to school decision-makers. You introduce IMAV, and we do the technical work. Earn 10% commission on the total deal value (base fees, excluding taxes) for every school you bring to closure, across all IMAV programs, small and big.

Ideal partners

  • Book distributors and publication houses supplying schools
  • School ERP, CRM, LMS and other school-technology companies
  • Uniform, stationery, lab and infrastructure suppliers
  • Education consultants and individuals with direct principal or management access

Requirements

How it works

  1. You open the door. Contact the school and pitch the programme outline.
  2. We take it forward. Once the school is interested, our team runs the technical demo and covers course details, curriculum and pricing, and works to close from our end.
  3. You push the decision. School administrations take time. You follow up and keep the decision moving until it is signed.
  4. You get paid. 10% of the base fee, excluding taxes, as per the partner agreement.

What we provide

  • Pitch deck and programme outline
  • Live demos by our team
  • Course and curriculum details for all programs
  • Dedicated point of contact for your leads

What we expect

  • Existing relationships with schools
  • Active follow-up, since we do not chase leads for you
  • Sharing school details before you pitch, so we can register your lead

Benefits

What this is not
This is a pure commission arrangement, with no salary, retainer or allowance. If you are looking for fixed income, this is not for you.
How to apply
Answer all screening questions in the form. Incomplete applications are not reviewed.
