Votre rôle

Digital Services France (DSF) crée une nouvelle Direction nommée Direction Digital, Data et IA (DDIA), en charge de porter la stratégie, le portfolio d'offres, les opérations mutualisées et la performance économique des activités Digital, Data et IA de DSF (à l’exception des activités Microsoft portées par la Direction Expertime). Cette direction est composée d’environ 330 salariés en France, au Maroc et à l’Ile Maurice.

Dans le cadre de cette création, nous recrutons le/la directeur(ice) de cette direction, rattaché au directeur de Digital Services France et membre du CODIR de DSF. Dans un marché en tension mais porté par l'accélération de l'IA agentique, vous avez pour mission de redynamiser la stratégie DDIA, de structurer une gouvernance claire et lisible, et de porter le retour à une croissance profitable et durable de ce périmètre.

Missions principales

Stratégie, portfolio et gouvernance :

  • Définir et faire évoluer la stratégie DDIA (axes de développement, choix de partenaires stratégiques) en cohérence avec la stratégie globale de DSF ;
  • Structurer le portfolio d'offres Digital, Data et IA (Data/IA, Confiance et numérique responsable, Expérience Client/Employé/Opérationnelle, produits digitaux), garantir une déclinaison homogène des offres (dont les produits digitaux) sur l'ensemble du territoire, en lien avec les Régions et les Agences Conseil & Expertise et piloter une vision consolidée. Structurer et clarifier la gouvernance de la direction DDIA, à l'image des dispositifs existants pour les activités Cloud et Microsoft.

Pilotage économique :

  • Porter la responsabilité primaire du P&L des activités DDIA (chiffre d'affaires par offre, marge nationale) ;
  • Définir le budget et dimensionner la workforce interne/externe en fonction des ambitions de développement en collaboration avec les Régions;
  • Piloter l'équation de performance globale en coordination avec les P&L régionaux dont les Régions de DSF sont garantes

Management et animation des équipes :

  • Piloter les Départements Portfolio, Avant-Vente, Opérations Mutualisées et Live Intelligence, ainsi que les activités du Directeur Technique IA et du Directeur Influence IA
  • Animer un lien fonctionnel fort avec les Directeurs Conseil & Expertise en région et la Direction La Fabrique, afin qu'ils contribuent au cycle de vie du portfolio et à la diffusion des innovations ;
  • Manager les Responsables de départements de la Direction DDIA

Alignement commercial et delivery :

  • Assurer l'alignement de nos capacités et savoir-faire en termes de delivery avec nos offres, en coordination avec la Direction Performance & Optimisation;
  • Assurer et accompagner la bonne diffusion commerciale de nos offres en coordination avec la Direction Commerciale Nationale ;
  • Renforcer l'orchestration territoriale de la stratégie DDIA avec les Régions et les équipes commerciales (grands comptes / ETI et PME)

Compétences et transformation IA :

  • Porter, avec le Directeur Technique IA et le Directeur Influence IA, l'accélération de la transformation IA en interne comme en externe.
  • Structurer et industrialiser, via l'IA Academy, l'upskilling/reskilling des collaborateurs à l'ère de l'IA ;

Votre profil

Vous êtes

Formation et expérience : Diplôme supérieur (Bac+5, école d'ingénieur ou de commerce) avec une expérience confirmée de direction dans le secteur des ESN, sur les activités Digital, Data et/ou IA impliquant le management d’un P&L, d’une stratégie d’offre et d’équipes pluridisciplinaires d’au moins 300 salariés ainsi que la conduite de projet(s) de transformation.

Compétences requises :

Domaine

Compétences attendues

Expertise métier

Connaissance approfondie du marché Digital, Data, IA ; culture des offres et du portfolio d'une ESN

Leadership

Capacité à fédérer un collectif transverse, à porter une vision stratégique et à accompagner le changement

Pilotage économique

Maîtrise de la gestion de P&L, du budget et des indicateurs de performance

Vision stratégique

Capacité à anticiper les évolutions technologiques et de marché, notamment liées à l'IA générative et agentique

Communication

Excellentes compétences relationnelles, capacité à convaincre en interne (CODIR, Régions) et en externe (partenaires, clients)

Entité

Orange Business est un intégrateur réseau et numérique qui comprend toute la chaîne de valeur du monde digital, permettant à nos clients de se concentrer sur les initiatives stratégiques qui font avancer leur business.

Chaque jour, vous collaborerez avec une équipe dédiée à la livraison de solutions globales cohérentes et durables, peu importe où nos clients opèrent.

Avec plus de 30 000 salariés en Europe, Asie, Amérique et Afrique, nous proposons un environnement dynamique et innovant permettant de développer et affiner vos compétences.

Nous offrons des opportunités passionnantes dans la data et le digital, le cloud, l'IA, la cybersécurité, ou encore l'IoT et le digital workspace.

Entité de rattachement

Digital Services est l'ESN d'Orange Business qui combine les expertises Cloud, Digital, Data et IA. Plus de 4 000 experts répartis dans toute la France accompagnent des entreprises et institutions publiques dans leur transformation numérique. Nous rejoindre, c'est participer à l'accompagnement de nos clients à travers des missions stimulantes et variées. Digital Services France place le Numérique Responsable au cœur de ses préoccupations, affirmant ainsi l’importance qu’elle accorde au numérique inclusif, durable et de confiance.

Company Culture

Job Summary

The GMP Account Manager is a client-facing, billable role responsible for the day-to-day management of a portfolio of Google Marketing Platform (GMP) clients. You will combine platform knowledge with strong relationship management to drive customer satisfaction.

Working closely with the Head of GMP, you will be the main point of contact for your clients. You will own those relationships, drive platform adoption, and handle operational tasks efficiently and confidently.

Strategic growth and account development

Collaboration and operations

  • Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience.
  • Government-mandated benefits plus supplemental HMO coverage.

raw.description:
We are looking for a Data and Reporting Analyst(Inside IR35)ideally with a background in HR/Recruitment/Talent Acquisition for a6 month contract, remote working.

Role purpose

  • Lead regular and ad-hoc Talent Acquisition (TA) reporting and develop robust, reliable data solutions.
  • Provide specialist expertise in data, reporting and process improvement within a complex TA environment, connecting recruitment operations, systems, data and stakeholder needs to deliver actionable insight and practical solutions.
  • Use advanced Excel and Power Query to combine, transform and assure data from multiple sources, automating reporting and data processes wherever practical.
  • Understand the operational context, investigate anomalies and root causes, and turn complex or imperfect datasets into robust, proportionate and sustainable solutions.
  • Work directly with stakeholders to translate requirements into effective, maintainable solutions and strengthen team data capability and best practice.
  • Bring curiosity, professional challenge and a continuous improvement mindset, using evidence to question existing approaches and improve TA operations.

As Data and Reporting Analyst, your main responsibilities will be:

  • Own regular and ad-hoc Talent Acquisition reporting and MI.
  • Design, build and maintain automated, repeatable Excel and Power Query solutions.
  • Combine, cleanse and transform data from multiple sources.
  • Own data quality and assurance, ensuring accurate, reliable reporting and investigating anomalies to identify root causes across systems, processes and data sources—not just correct outputs.
  • Translate stakeholder requirements into practical data and reporting solutions, challenging constructively where appropriate.
  • Understand end-to-end TA operations so reporting and solutions reflect recruitment practice.
  • Develop solutions that enable team collaboration through Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365.
  • Review and simplify data and reporting processes, removing duplication and unnecessary manual work through standardisation and automation.
  • Apply and promote Power Query best practice, sharing knowledge and upskilling colleagues.
  • Define and document data, controls and solutions to ensure transparency, auditability and team maintainability.
  • Identify trends, risks and opportunities, translating complex data into clear insight for operational and senior decision-making.
  • Support wider TA Operations and Solutions activity as required, applying specialist expertise to improve processes, controls and solutions.

PLEASE NOTE: SC Clearance is an essential requirement for this role. Please note, due to the exceptional requirements of this position (short-term nature of this role and speed at which we require a postholder in situ) preference may be given to candidates who meet all of the essential criteria and hold active security clearance.

Essential:

  • Strong to advanced Power Query skills, independently designing robust, maintainable data transformations.
  • Advanced Excel skills and experience working with complex datasets from multiple sources.
  • Experience producing regular and ad-hoc reporting/MI for stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of data quality, reconciliation and assurance.
  • Stronganalytical and problem-solving skills, tracing complex data discrepancies to their source, system or process.
  • Experience developing and maintaining data or reporting solutions using Microsoft Teams and shared Microsoft 365 resources to support collaboration, accessibility and maintainability.
  • Ability to interpret and constructively challengecomplex or ambiguous stakeholder requirements, using specialist expertise to develop appropriate data solutions.
  • Experience improving and automating manual data and reporting processes.
  • Strong communication skills, explaining complex data and technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences and sharing best practice.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and own problems from requirements and investigation through implementation and continuous improvement.

Desirable:

  • Experience working in a recruitment, Talent Acquisition or HR function.
  • Understanding of recruitment lifecycle data and the challenges of linking vacancies, campaigns, candidates, applications and outcomes.
  • Experience developing dashboards and data visualisations in Excel and/or Power BI.
  • Experience with Power Apps, Power Automate or other Microsoft Power Platform tools.
  • Experience using Microsoft Copilot for data analysis, automation, solution development and productivity.
  • Experience documenting data processes, controls, methodologies or standard operating procedures for governance and knowledge transfer.
  • Experience in operational environments where reporting supports governance, assurance, performance management or senior decision-making.

Please be aware that this role can only be worked within the UK and not Overseas.

DE&I Commitment

Guarantee to interview all candidates who have a disability and who meet all the essential criteria for the vacancy. In cases where we have a high volume of candidates who have a disability who meet all the essential criteria, we will interview the best candidates from within that group. This scheme encourages candidates with a disability and/or neurodivergence to apply. In exceptional circumstances, we may also need to apply the desirable criteria in our shortlisting process which may include holding active security clearance.

Armed Forces Covenant / commitment

As a signatory of the Armed Forces Covenant, we welcome applications from veterans, service leavers, reservists and military spouses or partners. Applications from eligible candidates who meet the essential criteria for the role will be prioritised for review. Where application volumes are high, additional role-specific and desirable criteria may be applied as part of the shortlisting process which may include holding active security clearance.

In applying for this role, you acknowledge the following "this role falls in scope of the Off Payroll Working in the Public Sector legislation. Any rates of payment quoted will reflect the gross rate per day for the assignment and will be subject to appropriate taxes and statutory costs. As such the payment to the intermediary and your income resulting from this contract will be different".

raw.description:
Estamos em busca de um Analista de Qualidade (QA)Sêniorpara compor um time altamente técnico, com foco em desenvolvimento. Você atuará em projetos estratégicos.

Sua missão é garantir que cada entrega chegue à produção com qualidade e previsibilidade. Isso significa estruturar e evoluir a automação de testes, reduzir regressões e ser referência técnica de qualidade para o time.


  • Desenhar, implementar e manter suítes de testes automatizados de UI, API e regressão.
  • Definir a estratégia de testes da squad, equilibrando a pirâmide de testes (unit, integration, E2E).
  • Integrar os testes ao pipeline de CI/CD, com execução automática a cada Pull Request e deploy.
  • Analisar requisitos e histórias com PO e devs, definindo critérios de aceite testáveis (BDD/Gherkin quando fizer sentido).
  • Validar correções e melhorias em ambiente de sustentação, com foco em evitar regressões em produção.
  • Investigar incidentes junto ao time, reproduzir bugs e documentá-los com evidências claras.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de qualidade (cobertura automatizada, taxa de defeitos escapados, flaky tests, tempo de execução).
  • Atuar como referência técnica: revisar código de testes, orientar QAs menos experientes e disseminar boas práticas.

  • Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida em Quality Assurance, com atuação comprovada em nível sênior.
  • Vivência prática em automação de testes Web com pelo menos um framework de mercado: Cypress, Playwright ou Selenium WebDriver.
  • Automação de testes de API REST (Postman/Newman, REST Assured, Karate ou similar).
  • Programação para automação em JavaScript/TypeScript, Java ou Python.
  • Integração de testes em pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI ou Jenkins).
  • Domínio de Git e fluxo de trabalho com Pull Requests.
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de teste (particionamento, valor-limite, testes exploratórios, regressão) e da pirâmide de testes.
  • Experiência em times ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban).
  • SQL para validação e preparação de massa de dados.

Diferenciais

  • Testes de performance e carga (k6, JMeter ou Gatling).
  • Automação de testes mobile (Appium, Detox ou Maestro).
  • Contract testing (Pact) e testes em arquiteturas de microsserviços.
  • Experiência em times de sustentação, com SLA e gestão de incidentes.
  • Observabilidade aplicada a qualidade (logs, Datadog, Grafana, New Relic).
  • Uso de IA aplicada a testes (geração de casos, self-healing de seletores, análise de falhas).
  • Noções de testes de segurança (OWASP) e acessibilidade (WCAG).
  • Certificações como ISTQB/CTFL ou CTAL.

Competências comportamentais

  • Senso de dono da qualidade: atua na prevenção de defeitos, não só na detecção.
  • Comunicação clara: traduz riscos técnicos para PO, devs e cliente.
  • Priorização sob pressão: sabe decidir o que testar primeiro em demandas urgentes de sustentação.
  • Colaboração: trabalha lado a lado com o time e compartilha conhecimento.
  • Aprendizado contínuo: acompanha novas ferramentas e práticas de qualidade.

As part of an industry-leading team you will drive results for our clients by delivering innovative and effective claims solutions across all personal lines of business. The Private Risk Claims Advocacy Executive will strengthen relationships with existing clients and prospects through proactive advocacy for the best possible claim outcome, helping to ensure that our clients’ interests are protected/represented. APRM is dedicated to protecting our clients on a personal level with thoughtful risk management and custom-tailored personal insurance products and services. APRM partners with highly rated personal insurance providers who possess superior financial ratings, offer the broadest coverage available in the marketplace and specialize in resolving claims in an expeditious and empathetic manner. Our role is to design bespoke solutions that protect all that our clients and their families have achieved. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like: Act as a resource, provide support and collaborate with the client facing Account Executive team on large/complex claim efforts in region or as needed. Serve as primary claims point of contact on assigned claims and/or assigned large/Family Office or complex clients. Responsible for management of the strategy, process and successful claims outcome, including claim intake and evaulation, assessing coverage and identifying possible issues. Including claim intake and evaluation, assessing coverage and identifying possible issues. Work with client team as applicable (risk managers, legal team, etc.) Coordinate discussions and meetings to ensure outstanding levels of communication between client and carrier. Drive communication and negotiations with the carrier on behalf of our client Escalate claims (ex: denials/partial denials) via carrier regional leadership and/or APRM claims leadership as appropriate. Drive proactive claims management and advocacy service for clients with adjusters and other external customers, from submission through close of the loss file, ensuring an outstanding experience for our clients. Proactively communicate with clients and internal colleagues around claim status, explaining complex terms, addressing concerns and setting expectations. Represent client interests for best possible claims/service results – maximize benefits within policy limits. Collaborate and maintain strong relationships with carriers and/or other relevant external parties for best possible claims/service results. Review coverage positions for accuracy and to ensure the broadest terms are applied and all coverage avenues are exhausted. Negotiate terms/advocate for clients with carriers or adjusters as needed. Negotiate terms with builders/contractors, body shops, storage facilities, mitigation firms, etc. Review insurance contracts and advise of potential coverage disputes/issues and collaborate on solutions/options. Identify potential challenges/delays and take steps to expedite resolution. Provide APRM client facing colleagues with claims education around coverage application, providing guidance as needed. Report coverage concerns or denials to internal partners. Actively maintain detailed internal system claim file documentation. Provide timely updates to Claims Leader on issues affecting business unit results. Support APRM branding and marketing efforts by participating in prospect RFPs/proposals and on existing client renewals, demonstrating APRMs claims capabilities/expertise. During natural catastrophes (CAT) provide support to the client facing Account Executive team and assist in advising CAT responses. Maintain claims info/tools library in SharePoint. Special projects as assigned. Skills and experience that will lead to success: Property and Casualty producer license or must obtain upon hire. 5-7 years' experience in the High-Net-Worth personal insurance field and/or experience in the High-Net-Worth claims management field required. Risk Management background a plus. AINS, AIC, CPCU, CIC, ARM, CAPI and/or CPRIA designations completed or in process preferred. Experience in the resolution of large/complex personal insurance claims required. Personal liability claims experience preferred. Occasional travel required. Flexibility to work outside regular hours including CAT or weather events is required Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills. Self-directed, problem solving/solution oriented. Project management, negotiation, and advocacy experience is required. Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment. Critical and abstract thinking with attention to detail is required. Technical expertise in insurance contract review. Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of industry experience. For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $120,000 to $135,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant’s geographic location. This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon’s annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan. A summary of all the benefits offered for this position: Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon’s discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies. 2582145

Adjunct Faculty – Introduction to Business and Management

Department of Marketing, Management, and Health Care Administration | University of Maryland Global Campus (UMGC)

This position is specifically to teach remotely for stateside applicants. Local applicants only; UMGC does not sponsor logistical support for this role.

Introduction to Business and Management (BMGT 110):

An introduction to the fundamental concepts of business management and leadership. The objective is to understand the interrelated dynamics of business, society, and the economy. Discussion covers business principles and practices in the context of everyday business events and human affairs and from a historical perspective.


*Once hired, you may be asked to teach a variety of courses within the program based on your qualifications, experience, and departmental needs.

At UMGC, we don’t just teach; we empower. Founded in 1947, UMGC is an open-access, minority-serving institution serving over 90,000 nontraditional learners worldwide, including a proud, large military-affiliated population. Our students are mature, highly dedicated, and balancing careers, families, and service. As an Adjunct Faculty member, you are the essential partner helping them bridge the gap between classroom theory and real-world career success.

Why Teach with UMGC?

  • Focus on Students, Not Course Design: All courses follow a standardized, pre-designed, unified course model. Standardized rubrics, OER materials, library resources, and digital textbooks are fully provided at no cost to you. You get to focus 100% of your energy on mentoring, facilitating, and providing high-quality feedback—no unpaid course-building required.
  • True Asynchronous Flexibility: Teach with flexibility, on your own schedule. As long as you meet weekly grading, responsiveness, and engagement milestones, your daily hours are entirely up to you.
  • Ongoing Growth: We invest in you. All newly hired faculty receive comprehensive online orientation, alongside ongoing, cost-free professional development opportunities.

The Rhythm of Your Week (Key Responsibilities)

Adjunct faculty bring our pre-built curriculum to life through real-world expertise and active mentorship.

Classroom Engagement & Presence

  • Be Visible: Maintain an active classroom presence at least 5 days per week, introducing yourself with a welcome announcement and driving discussions.
  • Bridge Theory & Practice: Enrich the pre-built curriculum with your own professional expertise and real-world examples.
  • Build Belonging: Foster an inclusive, culturally responsive environment where adult learners feel supported and motivated.

Responsiveness & Feedback

  • Stay consistently engaged with learners throughout the course by responding to inquiries, returning feedback, and posting final grades within the expected timeframe.

Proactive Support & Collaboration

  • Monitor Progress: Use available data tools to track student engagement and conduct proactive outreach to at-risk students.
  • Team Up: Partner with success coaches, academic staff, and portfolio directors to refer struggling students to UMGC support resources.
  • Stay Connected: Participate in UMGC's vibrant faculty community, including the Program Hub and ongoing training.

Course Structure & Time Commitment

  • Format: 100% Online & Asynchronous
  • Term Length: 8-week sessions (3-credit courses)
  • Class Size: Typically, 25–35 students (smaller sections for select courses)
  • Time Commitment: The adjunct faculty role requires a substantial commitment throughout the term focusing not only on academic success but also the social, personal, and professional growth of students

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Education: ​Master’s degree in Business or related field from an accredited institution of higher learning.
  • Experience:Professional experience in Business or Knowledge Management or related fields.
  • Legal Status: Applicants must have and be able to maintain their own legal status in the country in which they apply to teach.
  • English Language Proficiency: Applicants must demonstrate proficiency in written and spoken English sufficient to effectively teach course content, communicate with students, and evaluate academic work in English.
  • The Mindset: A deeply student-centered approach rooted in empathy, flexibility, professional integrity, and cultural responsiveness.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience teaching adult learners in an online, asynchronous environment.
  • Prior postsecondary teaching experience.
  • Active engagement in your discipline's professional community.

Materials needed for submission

  • Resume/ Curriculum Vitae
  • Cover letter highly preferred
  • Unofficial Transcripts
  • If selected, candidates with international degrees may be required to submit a translation/degree evaluation from a NACES approved vendor

All submissions should include a cover letter and resume.

The University of Maryland Global Campus (UMGC) is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal and state laws regarding nondiscrimination. UMGC is committed to a policy of equal opportunity for all persons and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, age, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, disability, religion, ancestry, political affiliation or veteran status in employment, educational programs and activities, and admissions.

Workplace Accommodations:

The University of Maryland Global Campus Global Campus (UMGC) is committed to creating and maintaining a welcoming and inclusive working environment for people of all abilities. UMGC is dedicated to the principle that no qualified individual with a disability shall, based on disability, be excluded from participation in or be denied the benefits of the services, programs, or activities of the University, or be subjected to discrimination. For information about UMGC’s Reasonable Workplace Accommodation Policy or to request an accommodation, applicants/candidates can contact Employee Accommodations via email .

Benefits Package Highlights:

  • Health Coverage: Access to health care, medical with vision, dental, and prescription plans for both individuals and families, effective from the 1st of the month following your hire date. NOTE: Adjuncts are not eligible for the State of Maryland subsidized rates. Adjuncts would be responsible for the total cost if enrolled.
  • Insurance Options: Term Life Insurance and Accidental Death and Dismemberment Insurance.
  • Supplemental Retirement Plans: include 401(k), 403(b), 457(b), and various Roth options. The university does not provide matching funds.

For additional information please see: SS Adjunct Faculty_2020.pdf (umgc.edu)

Instructor: No Terminal Degree: Step 1 $806 - Step 11 $1,050 per credit hour

Assistant Adjunct Professor: No Terminal Degree Step 1 $877 - Step 11 $1,127 per credit hour

Location: Canada, Remote

Industry: Mission-Critical Facilities, Data Centers

Engagement Type: Full-Time

Ehvert Mission Critical, a business unit within Salas O’Brien, is seeking an experienced ICT Designer to lead the design and coordination of structured cabling, low-voltage, and telecommunications systems for hyperscale and AI data centers across North America. This is a remote position within an international engineering firm recognized for its innovation and expertise in mission-critical infrastructure.

Our projects involve large-scale, high-demand facilities with complex structural, electrical, mechanical, automation, and security systems, often exceeding 100 MW per facility and up to 500 MW per site.

Role Summary:

We are seeking a skilled ICT Designer who will be responsible for developing and coordinating low-voltage systems such as structured cabling, telecommunications, security, and data networks, ensuring they are fully integrated within the overall building design. This role involves producing detailed design documentation, performing engineering calculations, developing system layouts, and ensuring design accuracy using BIM and ICT engineering tools. You will collaborate closely with electrical, mechanical, and BIM teams in a multidisciplinary environment, contributing to the full project lifecycle from schematic design through construction documentation and coordination. Strong technical knowledge, attention to detail, and excellent communication skills are essential.

WhatWe Offer:

  • Experience in a high-tech industry within an international company
  • Unique, cutting-edge data center projects
  • Comprehensive training
  • Professional development support
  • Supportive management and a dynamic team environment
  • Career growth potential
  • Ability to work from home
  • Comprehensive compensation package
  • Competitive employee benefits: Health insurance (Medical, HSA & FSA, Dental, Vision), Life insurance, Short-term and long-term disability, many other benefits, including PTO.
  • Opportunity to participate in the company’s retirement plan
  • Stock ownership / synthetic equity options

What You Will Do:

  • Designing and coordinating ICT and low-voltage systems including structured cabling, telecommunications, access control, video surveillance (CCTV), and security systems
  • Using BIM tools to model and coordinate ICT systems with other engineering disciplines using tools such as Autodesk Revit – is a must
  • Developing a thorough understanding and delivery of the project requirements as they relate to scope, cost and schedule
  • Determining and expediting the engineering deliverables for projects
  • Developing and maintaining project scope of work documentation and revisions during design development
  • Preparing engineering calculations, system layouts, and technical documentation for ICT infrastructure
  • Preparing technical documentation required for project execution including design criteria, technical specifications, and equipment data sheets
  • Reviewing shop drawings and contractor submittals
  • Producing models and drawings using BIM and CAD modeling tools
  • Supporting coordination with multidisciplinary engineering teams during project development and execution

What We Expect:

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, telecommunications, IT, or a related field
  • Proven expertise as an ICT / telecommunications / low-voltage systems engineer
  • Written and spoken English B1 and higher
  • Experience in ICT design including structured cabling systems, telecommunications infrastructure, and security systems
  • Experience designing low-voltage systems for industrial, commercial, or mission-critical facilities
  • Experience using BIM modeling tools and design software
  • Hands-on experience using Autodesk Revit – is a must
  • Experience working in multidisciplinary engineering environments
  • Understanding of telecommunications standards and low-voltage system codes
  • Microsoft Office proficiency (Word, Excel, Outlook)
  • Ability to multi-task and prioritize while meeting project deadlines
  • Self-starters that are ambitious and thrive in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to communicate technical knowledge in a clear and understandable manner
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Optional site visits if desired (no required travel)
  • Authorization to work in Canada

Join Us:

Our commitment to innovation drives us to deliver superior services to our clients using advanced tools and software.

We offer a dynamic environment fostering creativity through exposure to diverse technologies and experiences, ranging from designing energy-efficient facilities and site supervision for multi-million-dollar facilities to the production of digital twins, three-dimensional building modeling, computational fluid dynamics, and the development of custom controls software.

Join our team at Ehvert Mission Critical, now a proud part of Salas O'Brien, and help us achieve our international engineering goals!

For more information, visit Ehvert and Salas O'Brien.

raw.description:
COMPANY 🌱

RYZE was founded in 2019 by Andrée Werner and Rashad Hossain, out of a parents' basement, with a mission to change daily health, starting with the morning routine: a nutrient-dense mushroom coffee delivering clean energy, mental clarity, and immune support. Built on a Direct-to-Consumer foundation with a performance marketing engine, RYZE achieved hockey-stick growth and a community of over 1 million active subscribers.

DTC remains the foundation, but RYZE has expanded into mass retail, quickly becoming the #2 items in Target's overall coffee category and is now executing a multi-channel expansion, with a cross-category launch coming in early 2027. RYZE is uniquely positioned to redefine how people think about daily wellness.

We’re a lean, fast-moving, mission-driven team who believe daily rituals create the foundation for living your greatest life, and we’re just getting started!

ROLE OVERVIEW:
RYZE Superfoods is rapidly expanding across retail, DTC, Amazon, and TikTok Shop. We are seeking a hands-on demand planning leader to own forecasting, lead our Demand Planning Manager, build scalable automated/AI-driven planning infrastructure, and drive alignment across Sales, Marketing, and S&OP.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🎯

Responsibilities will include:


Demand planning across all channels

  • Build and maintain the consensus plan for retail, DTC, Amazon, TikTok Shop and marketplaces, by SKU and month over a rolling 18 months, in units and dollars.
  • Lead channel-level forecasting to support 30,000+ retail doors while DTC and digital channels scale in parallel
  • Bring every forecast input into that plan with a named owner and a due date each cycle. That includes the items that fall between teams today: gifts, merchandise, kits and limited-time offers.
  • Reconcile the plan to Finance's revenue plan every cycle, so a demand gap shows up as a dollar gap.

Committed demand and upside, kept apart

  • Run the plan in two columns: committed and upside. Every retail initiative carries a confidence level, reviewed weekly with Sales, and new distribution moves to committed when the retailer confirms it.
  • Work with supply planning so long-lead purchases and production are sized to the committed column, and the upside is held as an option with suppliers.
  • Model upside and downside scenarios and show what each does to inventory and cash before the company commits.

Forecast accuracy and bias

  • Own forecast accuracy as a measurable output, not a reporting exercise
  • Measure accuracy and bias by channel, retailer and SKU at one, two and three months of lag, and publish the results weekly. Current targets are 70% at three months, 80% at two, 90% at one and 95% in-month.
  • Change the plan when sell-through misses. Set the triggers that force a revision, apply them in the same cycle, and record the reason.
  • Log the driver behind every material forecast change so the next cycle learns from it.

Retail and launch forecasting

  • Forecast sell-in from sell-through: POS, weeks of supply, door counts and velocity by account, using retailer portals, distributor data and syndicated data.
  • Build launch and ramp curves for new retailers and new items from comparable launches, and re-base them within the first weeks of real sales.
  • Size promotions, endcaps and displays from measured lift, and take the pull-forward out of the months that follow.

DTC and digital forecasting

  • Forecast the subscription business from its drivers: new customers, retention and rebill rates, and gift and add-on attachment, with Growth and Data owning the assumptions alongside you.
  • Own the Amazon and TikTok Shop forecasts with the channel leads, including promotional events.

Team and tools

  • Lead our Demand Planning Manager and any future demand planning hires
  • Work actively in our planning platform and partner with our data and systems teams to build automated reporting, forecast workflows and channel-level visibility
  • Be an early adopter and driver of AI tools within the planning function we are actively building this capability and want someone who leans into it

S&OP and cross-functional influence

  • Run the demand review in the monthly S&OP cycle and hold every input owner to the calendar.
  • Challenge promotional plans, launch assumptions and growth targets that the data does not support, with Sales, Marketing and the executive team.
  • Work with New Product Launch and Marketing so that no launch or promotion reaches the calendar without a demand plan behind it.
  • Hand supply planning a plan it can execute. Production schedules, inventory targets and the rolling forecasts we send co-manufacturers and suppliers all start from your number.

WHAT WE OFFER 🌟

PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS


  • CPG background required. You have worked in consumer packaged goods and understand how demand planning functions inside a multi-channel brand.
  • Channel expansion experience. You have been part of a brand scaling aggressively adding doors, launching new channels, managing the forecast complexity that comes with growth. You know how launch assumptions go wrong and how fast to correct them.
  • Retail forecasting depth. You know the difference between a load-in and a sell-through rate, and you forecast from POS. You have worked with brokers, distributors and retailer replenishment teams.
  • Fluent in DTC and marketplaces. You can forecast a subscription business from acquisition and retention, and you understand how Amazon and social commerce behave around promotions.
  • Hands-on and managing. You have led a small team before but you are still doing the work. You are not a manager who delegates and reviews—you are in the data and in the tools alongside your team.
  • Comfortable with software and data. You pick up new tools quickly and are not waiting for a report to tell you what is happening. Experience working with data or BI teams to build what you need is a plus.
  • Curious about AI. We are pushing AI adoption across the company and want someone who is excited to build, not just use. You do not need to be an engineer, you need to be willing to explore.
  • Clear communicator. You can translate a complex forecast into a clean story for leadership and you are willing to have a hard conversation when the numbers do not support the plan.
  • 8+ years in demand planning or forecasting within CPG
  • Has owned the consensus demand plan for a multi-channel consumer brand, with reported accuracy and bias
  • Has managed at least one direct report in a planning function while still carrying forecasts personally
  • Retail forecasting for national accounts such as Target, Walmart, Kroger or club, using POS and syndicated data (Circana, SPINS or Nielsen)
  • DTC and marketplace forecasting; subscription experience is a plus
  • New-item and new-distribution forecasting through rapid door expansion
  • Has run the demand review in a monthly S&OP cycle and reconciled the plan with Finance
  • Has worked in a planning system and with data teams; NetSuite, Snowflake or SQL experience is a plus

raw.description:
It’s More Than a Career, It’s a Mission.

Our people are the foundation of our success. By joining our growing team at Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI), a subsidiary of McKesson, you will have the opportunity to become part of one of the largest community-based cancer programs to advance oncology treatments and improve outcomes for cancer patients across the globe. We look for mission-driven candidates who have a desire to advance the fight against cancer and make a difference in the lives of patients diagnosed with cancer every day.

Our Mission

People who live with cancer – those who work to prevent it, fight it, and survive it – are at the heart of every decision we make. Bringing the most innovative medical minds together with the most passionate caregivers in their communities, we are transforming care and personalizing treatment. Through clinical excellence and cutting-edge research, SCRI is redefining cancer care around the world.

Job Summary


Join our team and play a key role in advancing clinical research as our

Sr Clinical Data Analyst. In this position, you'll support a variety of data management activities across clinical studies, working collaboratively with project teams to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and compliance. You'll also have opportunities to mentor others, contribute to departmental initiatives, and help drive continuous improvement efforts.


This is a remote position in the US; relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not available.


What You'll Do

  • Execute data management activities in compliance with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), sponsor requirements, and internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Review study protocols and study-specific documentation to understand data collection and processing requirements.
  • Review clinical study data, identify discrepancies, and generate queries to ensure data accuracy, quality, and integrity.
  • Prepare and distribute study status reports to support project tracking and decision-making.
  • Partner with cross-functional study team members to provide data updates and resolve data-related issues.
  • Collaborate with programmers to develop reconciliation reports and perform data reconciliation activities according to project specifications and data management plans.
  • Develop and maintain Case Report Form (CRF) Completion Guidelines.
  • Train site personnel and study team members on study-specific CRF Completion Guidelines and data management processes.
  • Support departmental initiatives and serve as a resource and mentor to team members as appropriate.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in a scientific, healthcare, technical, or related field.
  • At least 1 year of experience in clinical research, preferably within a Contract Research Organization (CRO), sponsor, or research site environment.
  • Understanding of clinical trial processes and clinical data management principles.
  • Working knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines and regulatory requirements.
  • Experience using Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and Project.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting oncology clinical trials.
  • Exposure to data reconciliation processes and external data integrations.
  • Previous experience developing training materials or mentoring team members.

Why Join Us?

You'll have the opportunity to make a direct impact on clinical research while developing your expertise in a collaborative, mission-driven environment here at Sarah Cannon Research Institute. This role offers exposure to a variety of studies, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to help improve processes that support high-quality clinical trial outcomes.

About Sarah Cannon Research Institute

Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI) is one of the world’s leading oncology research organizations conducting community-based clinical trials. Focused on advancing therapies for patients over the last three decades, SCRI is a leader in drug development. In 2022, SCRI formed a joint venture with former US Oncology Research to expand clinical trial access across the country. It has conducted more than 850 first-in-human clinical trials since its inception and contributed to pivotal research that has led to the majority of new cancer therapies approved by the FDA in the past decade. SCRI’s research network brings together more than 1,300 physicians who are enrolling patients into clinical trials at more than 200 locations in 20+ states across the U.S. Please click here to learn more about our research offerings.

We care about the well-being of the patients and communities we serve, and that starts with caring for our people. That’s why we have a Total Rewards package that includes comprehensive benefits to support physical, mental, and financial well-being. Our Total Rewards offerings serve the different needs of our diverse colleague population and ensure they are the healthiest versions of themselves. For more information regarding benefits through our parent company, McKesson, please click here.

As part of Total Rewards, we are proud to offer a competitive compensation package. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered.

Online Recruiting-related Scams


McKesson has become aware of online recruiting-related scams in which individuals who are not affiliated with or authorized by McKesson are using McKesson’s (or affiliated entities, like CoverMyMeds or RxCrossroads) name in fraudulent emails, job postings or social media messages. In light of these scams, please bear the following in mind:


McKesson Talent Advisors will never solicit money or credit card information in connection with a McKesson job application.

McKesson job postings are posted on our career site: .


AI Disclosure


Candidates are not dispositioned based on AI-generated assessments or autonomous decision-making. Disposition outcomes are based on pre-defined, job-related eligibility criteria and screening requirements established by the organization. When an applicant does not meet mandatory role qualifications or fails required prescreening questions, the system applies the corresponding disposition in accordance with those human-defined criteria.



We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

WHO WE ARE:

Headquartered in Southern California, Skechers — the Comfort Technology Company® — has spent over 30 years helping men, women, and kids everywhere look and feel good. Comfort innovation is at the core of everything we do, driving the development of stylish, high-quality products at a great value. From our diverse footwear collections to our expanding range of apparel and accessories, Skechers is a complete lifestyle brand.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

This role handles daily operations, troubleshooting, and governance support across our multi-cloud environment(AWS, GCP, and OCI) and the tooling that supports them, including Terraform, identity services, and backup platforms. Responsibilities include access reviews and offboarding, resource audits and cleanup, incident triage, log and cost analysis, and documentation. In partnership with cloud engineers, the role improves and automates processes to reduce manual toil. The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, comfortable with CLI tools, scripting, and Infrastructure as Code, and able to work independently while knowing when to escalate.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Triage and investigate operational issues across AWS, GCP, and OCI (connectivity, service degradation, access problems).
  • Perform log investigations (CloudWatch Logs/Insights, GCP Cloud Logging) to pull targeted evidence for incidents and support cases.
  • Support incident response for outages; document timelines, root cause, and resolution.
  • Execute user offboarding across cloud platforms: audit and remove IAM permissions, roles, and group memberships; consolidate and document findings.
  • Conduct periodic access reviews and least-privilege audits.
  • Support directory services work (AWS Directory Service, WorkSpaces registrations, AD integration cleanup) in coordination with the AD/Identity team.
  • Audit cloud resources to identify orphaned, unused, or misconfigured assets and drive their cleanup (e.g., empty directory registrations, stale functions, unused compartments).
  • Enforce resource tagging standards; remediate untagged/non-compliant resources.
  • Produce teardown/decommission plans with clear order-of-operations and backout considerations.
  • Analyze cloud spend and billing data; identify cost-optimization opportunities.
  • Maintain operational dashboards and team KPIs; produce recurring reports.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • 2–4 years of hands-on cloud operations / cloud analyst experience.
  • Working proficiency with AWS (IAM, EC2/VPC networking, CloudWatch, Directory Service/WorkSpaces, S3, RDS); familiarity with GCP and/or OCI.
  • Comfortable in the CLI (AWS CLI, gcloud) and reading/writing shell scripts.
  • Solid understanding of IAM concepts, least privilege, and access reviews.
  • Experience with log analysis and troubleshooting across cloud services.
  • Strong documentation habits and attention to detail.
  • Familiarity with change-management processes and ticketing (e.g., ServiceNow/Jira).
  • Organized and self-directed; manages a queue of varied requests.
  • Clear written and verbal communicator.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Associate-level cloud certification (AWS Certified Solutions Architect / SysOps Administrator, or GCP Associate Cloud Engineer).
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and Git-based workflows.
  • Exposure to backup/DR tooling, SFTP/managed file transfer, and directory services / Active Directory integration.
  • Experience with cost management and tagging governance at scale.
  • Scripting for automation (Python or shell).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field required.

The pay range for this position is $90,000-$115,000/yr USD.

Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. raw.description:
Position Summary

The Senior Claim Consultant, Lawyers Liability provides complete claim-loss services for Coverys policyholders. This role will investigate, evaluate and dispose of legal malpractice claims with varying degrees of complexity and severity, including those with high levels of complexity and severity. The Senior Claim Consultant works independently with minimal supervision on a day-to-day basis.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Oversee a portfolio of complex Lawyer Professional Liability claims and possibly other Professional Liability claims.
  • Interpret policy provisions, identify potential coverage issues, and prepare comprehensive written coverage positions.
  • Interview insureds, claimants, witnesses and other appropriate parties to obtain information used to assess liability exposure.
  • Document related files regarding results of investigation and negotiations.
  • Prepare reports to file on established diary dates and other specific reports as needed to ensure timely file documentation and plan of action.
  • Secure records for investigation and evaluation of cases.
  • Determine and implement negotiation strategy and negotiate settlements within authority level.
  • Timely post and adjust reserves by specific dates pursuant to the company’s Best Claim Practices and Reserving Guidelines. Advise claims management on claims status and attend Reserve & Settlement Committee Meetings as necessary. Ensure timely reporting to the Reserve and Settlement Committee.
  • Interact with other departments as necessary to help facilitate and coordinate services to our insured and client.
  • Evaluate cases for appropriate disposition and seek authority for settlement from Manager/Director when settlement amount requests exceed authority.
  • Direct and monitor activities of defense counsel in compliance with Case Management Guidelines.
  • Monitor trials and attend pre-trial proceedings, mediations and arbitrations as necessary.
  • Identify significant insured Risk Management or Underwriting issues and direct the information to the appropriate department.
  • Communicate with insureds, claimants and witnesses; consult relevant records, varying methods of investigation according to type of claim.
  • Analyze and verify insurance coverage for claims brought against policyholders.
  • Maintain working knowledge of policy forms and can confirm policy in effect for date of loss.
  • Support evolving business needs, as applicable.

Education, Experience, Competencies & Values

  • Bachelor's degree from four-year college or university, required.
  • J.D. preferred with 5+ years of experiencing handling Professional Liability claims, preferably with some experience handling Lawyer Professional Liability claims.
  • Knowledge of legal and insurance terminology is required.
  • Must hold a current driver's license.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • Must have training in contract/policy review and application.
  • Must be comfortable making oral presentations to staff and insureds, and able to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, insureds, agents and attorneys.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret insurance policy coverage forms, professional journals, technical procedures, or government regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and technical case summaries.
  • Must be able to synthesize complex or diverse information; Collect and research data; use intuition and experience to complement data; design workflows and procedures.
  • Must have the ability to design and generate creative solutions.
  • Experience with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Able to work with minimal supervision on a day-to-day basis.
  • Insurance adjuster's license may be required for specific states.
  • Ability to travel up to 25-30%.

Base salary range is $103,530 - $140,070. Individual compensation packages are based on a variety of factors that are unique to each candidate including location, skill set, experience, qualifications and education.

If you're a caring and customer focused individual who enjoys working with passionate team members, Coverys is the right company for you!

Department of Marketing, Management, and Health Care Administration | University of Maryland Global Campus (UMGC)

Introduction to Business and Management (BMGT 110):

An introduction to the fundamental concepts of business management and leadership. The objective is to understand the interrelated dynamics of business, society, and the economy. Discussion covers business principles and practices in the context of everyday business events and human affairs and from a historical perspective.


*Once hired, you may be asked to teach a variety of courses within the program based on your qualifications, experience, and departmental needs.

At UMGC, we don’t just teach; we empower. Founded in 1947, UMGC is an open-access, minority-serving institution serving over 90,000 nontraditional learners worldwide, including a proud, large military-affiliated population. Our students are mature, highly dedicated, and balancing careers, families, and service. As an Adjunct Faculty member, you are the essential partner helping them bridge the gap between classroom theory and real-world career success.

Why Teach with UMGC?

  • Focus on Students, Not Course Design: All courses follow a standardized, pre-designed, unified course model. Standardized rubrics, OER materials, library resources, and digital textbooks are fully provided at no cost to you. You get to focus 100% of your energy on mentoring, facilitating, and providing high-quality feedback—no unpaid course-building required.
  • True Asynchronous Flexibility: Teach with flexibility, on your own schedule. As long as you meet weekly grading, responsiveness, and engagement milestones, your daily hours are entirely up to you.
  • Ongoing Growth: We invest in you. All newly hired faculty receive comprehensive online orientation, alongside ongoing, cost-free professional development opportunities.

The Rhythm of Your Week (Key Responsibilities)

Adjunct faculty bring our pre-built curriculum to life through real-world expertise and active mentorship.

Classroom Engagement & Presence

Responsiveness & Feedback

raw.excerpt: COMPANY 🌱 RYZE was founded in 2019 by Andrée Werner and Rashad Hossain, out of a parents' basement, with a mission to change daily health, starting with the morning routine: a nutrient-dense mushroom coffee delivering clean energy, mental clarity, and immune support.
raw.description:
COMPANY 🌱

RYZE was founded in 2019 by Andrée Werner and Rashad Hossain, out of a parents' basement, with a mission to change daily health, starting with the morning routine: a nutrient-dense mushroom coffee delivering clean energy, mental clarity, and immune support. Built on a Direct-to-Consumer foundation with a performance marketing engine, RYZE achieved hockey-stick growth and a community of over 1 million active subscribers.

DTC remains the foundation, but RYZE has expanded into mass retail, quickly becoming the #2 items in Target's overall coffee category and is now executing a multi-channel expansion, with a cross-category launch coming in early 2027. RYZE is uniquely positioned to redefine how people think about daily wellness.

We’re a lean, fast-moving, mission-driven team who believe daily rituals create the foundation for living your greatest life, and we’re just getting started!

ROLE OVERVIEW:
RYZE Superfoods is rapidly expanding across retail, DTC, Amazon, and TikTok Shop. We are seeking a hands-on demand planning leader to own forecasting, lead our Demand Planning Manager, build scalable automated/AI-driven planning infrastructure, and drive alignment across Sales, Marketing, and S&OP.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🎯

Responsibilities will include:


Demand planning across all channels

  • Build and maintain the consensus plan for retail, DTC, Amazon, TikTok Shop and marketplaces, by SKU and month over a rolling 18 months, in units and dollars.
  • Lead channel-level forecasting to support 30,000+ retail doors while DTC and digital channels scale in parallel
  • Bring every forecast input into that plan with a named owner and a due date each cycle. That includes the items that fall between teams today: gifts, merchandise, kits and limited-time offers.
  • Reconcile the plan to Finance's revenue plan every cycle, so a demand gap shows up as a dollar gap.

Committed demand and upside, kept apart

  • Run the plan in two columns: committed and upside. Every retail initiative carries a confidence level, reviewed weekly with Sales, and new distribution moves to committed when the retailer confirms it.
  • Work with supply planning so long-lead purchases and production are sized to the committed column, and the upside is held as an option with suppliers.
  • Model upside and downside scenarios and show what each does to inventory and cash before the company commits.

Forecast accuracy and bias

  • Own forecast accuracy as a measurable output, not a reporting exercise
  • Measure accuracy and bias by channel, retailer and SKU at one, two and three months of lag, and publish the results weekly. Current targets are 70% at three months, 80% at two, 90% at one and 95% in-month.
  • Change the plan when sell-through misses. Set the triggers that force a revision, apply them in the same cycle, and record the reason.
  • Log the driver behind every material forecast change so the next cycle learns from it.

Retail and launch forecasting

  • Forecast sell-in from sell-through: POS, weeks of supply, door counts and velocity by account, using retailer portals, distributor data and syndicated data.
  • Build launch and ramp curves for new retailers and new items from comparable launches, and re-base them within the first weeks of real sales.
  • Size promotions, endcaps and displays from measured lift, and take the pull-forward out of the months that follow.

DTC and digital forecasting

  • Forecast the subscription business from its drivers: new customers, retention and rebill rates, and gift and add-on attachment, with Growth and Data owning the assumptions alongside you.
  • Own the Amazon and TikTok Shop forecasts with the channel leads, including promotional events.

Team and tools

  • Lead our Demand Planning Manager and any future demand planning hires
  • Work actively in our planning platform and partner with our data and systems teams to build automated reporting, forecast workflows and channel-level visibility
  • Be an early adopter and driver of AI tools within the planning function we are actively building this capability and want someone who leans into it

S&OP and cross-functional influence

  • Run the demand review in the monthly S&OP cycle and hold every input owner to the calendar.
  • Challenge promotional plans, launch assumptions and growth targets that the data does not support, with Sales, Marketing and the executive team.
  • Work with New Product Launch and Marketing so that no launch or promotion reaches the calendar without a demand plan behind it.
  • Hand supply planning a plan it can execute. Production schedules, inventory targets and the rolling forecasts we send co-manufacturers and suppliers all start from your number.

WHAT WE OFFER 🌟

PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS


  • CPG background required. You have worked in consumer packaged goods and understand how demand planning functions inside a multi-channel brand.
  • Channel expansion experience. You have been part of a brand scaling aggressively adding doors, launching new channels, managing the forecast complexity that comes with growth. You know how launch assumptions go wrong and how fast to correct them.
  • Retail forecasting depth. You know the difference between a load-in and a sell-through rate, and you forecast from POS. You have worked with brokers, distributors and retailer replenishment teams.
  • Fluent in DTC and marketplaces. You can forecast a subscription business from acquisition and retention, and you understand how Amazon and social commerce behave around promotions.
  • Hands-on and managing. You have led a small team before but you are still doing the work. You are not a manager who delegates and reviews—you are in the data and in the tools alongside your team.
  • Comfortable with software and data. You pick up new tools quickly and are not waiting for a report to tell you what is happening. Experience working with data or BI teams to build what you need is a plus.
  • Curious about AI. We are pushing AI adoption across the company and want someone who is excited to build, not just use. You do not need to be an engineer, you need to be willing to explore.
  • Clear communicator. You can translate a complex forecast into a clean story for leadership and you are willing to have a hard conversation when the numbers do not support the plan.
  • 8+ years in demand planning or forecasting within CPG
  • Has owned the consensus demand plan for a multi-channel consumer brand, with reported accuracy and bias
  • Has managed at least one direct report in a planning function while still carrying forecasts personally
  • Retail forecasting for national accounts such as Target, Walmart, Kroger or club, using POS and syndicated data (Circana, SPINS or Nielsen)
  • DTC and marketplace forecasting; subscription experience is a plus
  • New-item and new-distribution forecasting through rapid door expansion
  • Has run the demand review in a monthly S&OP cycle and reconciled the plan with Finance
  • Has worked in a planning system and with data teams; NetSuite, Snowflake or SQL experience is a plus

Bringing the most innovative medical minds together with the most passionate caregivers in their communities, we are transforming care and personalizing treatment. Through clinical excellence and cutting-edge research, SCRI is redefining cancer care around the world.

Job Summary


Join our team and play a key role in advancing clinical research as our

Sr Clinical Data Analyst. In this position, you'll support a variety of data management activities across clinical studies, working collaboratively with project teams to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and compliance. You'll also have opportunities to mentor others, contribute to departmental initiatives, and help drive continuous improvement efforts.


This is a remote position in the US; relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not available.


What You'll Do

  • Execute data management activities in compliance with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), sponsor requirements, and internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Review study protocols and study-specific documentation to understand data collection and processing requirements.
  • Review clinical study data, identify discrepancies, and generate queries to ensure data accuracy, quality, and integrity.
  • Prepare and distribute study status reports to support project tracking and decision-making.
  • Partner with cross-functional study team members to provide data updates and resolve data-related issues.
  • Collaborate with programmers to develop reconciliation reports and perform data reconciliation activities according to project specifications and data management plans.
  • Develop and maintain Case Report Form (CRF) Completion Guidelines.
  • Train site personnel and study team members on study-specific CRF Completion Guidelines and data management processes.
  • Support departmental initiatives and serve as a resource and mentor to team members as appropriate.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in a scientific, healthcare, technical, or related field.
  • At least 1 year of experience in clinical research, preferably within a Contract Research Organization (CRO), sponsor, or research site environment.
  • Understanding of clinical trial processes and clinical data management principles.
  • Working knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines and regulatory requirements.
  • Experience using Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and Project.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting oncology clinical trials.
  • Exposure to data reconciliation processes and external data integrations.
  • Previous experience developing training materials or mentoring team members.

Why Join Us?

You'll have the opportunity to make a direct impact on clinical research while developing your expertise in a collaborative, mission-driven environment here at Sarah Cannon Research Institute. This role offers exposure to a variety of studies, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to help improve processes that support high-quality clinical trial outcomes.

About Sarah Cannon Research Institute

Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI) is one of the world’s leading oncology research organizations conducting community-based clinical trials. Focused on advancing therapies for patients over the last three decades, SCRI is a leader in drug development. In 2022, SCRI formed a joint venture with former US Oncology Research to expand clinical trial access across the country. It has conducted more than 850 first-in-human clinical trials since its inception and contributed to pivotal research that has led to the majority of new cancer therapies approved by the FDA in the past decade. SCRI’s research network brings together more than 1,300 physicians who are enrolling patients into clinical trials at more than 200 locations in 20+ states across the U.S. Please click here to learn more about our research offerings.

We care about the well-being of the patients and communities we serve, and that starts with caring for our people. That’s why we have a Total Rewards package that includes comprehensive benefits to support physical, mental, and financial well-being. Our Total Rewards offerings serve the different needs of our diverse colleague population and ensure they are the healthiest versions of themselves. For more information regarding benefits through our parent company, McKesson, please click here.

raw.description:
WHO WE ARE:

Headquartered in Southern California, Skechers — the Comfort Technology Company® — has spent over 30 years helping men, women, and kids everywhere look and feel good. Comfort innovation is at the core of everything we do, driving the development of stylish, high-quality products at a great value. From our diverse footwear collections to our expanding range of apparel and accessories, Skechers is a complete lifestyle brand.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

This role handles daily operations, troubleshooting, and governance support across our multi-cloud environment(AWS, GCP, and OCI) and the tooling that supports them, including Terraform, identity services, and backup platforms. Responsibilities include access reviews and offboarding, resource audits and cleanup, incident triage, log and cost analysis, and documentation. In partnership with cloud engineers, the role improves and automates processes to reduce manual toil. The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, comfortable with CLI tools, scripting, and Infrastructure as Code, and able to work independently while knowing when to escalate.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Triage and investigate operational issues across AWS, GCP, and OCI (connectivity, service degradation, access problems).
  • Perform log investigations (CloudWatch Logs/Insights, GCP Cloud Logging) to pull targeted evidence for incidents and support cases.
  • Support incident response for outages; document timelines, root cause, and resolution.
  • Execute user offboarding across cloud platforms: audit and remove IAM permissions, roles, and group memberships; consolidate and document findings.
  • Conduct periodic access reviews and least-privilege audits.
  • Support directory services work (AWS Directory Service, WorkSpaces registrations, AD integration cleanup) in coordination with the AD/Identity team.
  • Audit cloud resources to identify orphaned, unused, or misconfigured assets and drive their cleanup (e.g., empty directory registrations, stale functions, unused compartments).
  • Enforce resource tagging standards; remediate untagged/non-compliant resources.
  • Produce teardown/decommission plans with clear order-of-operations and backout considerations.
  • Analyze cloud spend and billing data; identify cost-optimization opportunities.
  • Maintain operational dashboards and team KPIs; produce recurring reports.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • 2–4 years of hands-on cloud operations / cloud analyst experience.
  • Working proficiency with AWS (IAM, EC2/VPC networking, CloudWatch, Directory Service/WorkSpaces, S3, RDS); familiarity with GCP and/or OCI.
  • Comfortable in the CLI (AWS CLI, gcloud) and reading/writing shell scripts.
  • Solid understanding of IAM concepts, least privilege, and access reviews.
  • Experience with log analysis and troubleshooting across cloud services.
  • Strong documentation habits and attention to detail.
  • Familiarity with change-management processes and ticketing (e.g., ServiceNow/Jira).
  • Organized and self-directed; manages a queue of varied requests.
  • Clear written and verbal communicator.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Associate-level cloud certification (AWS Certified Solutions Architect / SysOps Administrator, or GCP Associate Cloud Engineer).
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and Git-based workflows.
  • Exposure to backup/DR tooling, SFTP/managed file transfer, and directory services / Active Directory integration.
  • Experience with cost management and tagging governance at scale.
  • Scripting for automation (Python or shell).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field required.

The pay range for this position is $90,000-$115,000/yr USD.

About Skechers

Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

Position Summary

The Senior Claim Consultant, Lawyers Liability provides complete claim-loss services for Coverys policyholders. This role will investigate, evaluate and dispose of legal malpractice claims with varying degrees of complexity and severity, including those with high levels of complexity and severity. The Senior Claim Consultant works independently with minimal supervision on a day-to-day basis.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Oversee a portfolio of complex Lawyer Professional Liability claims and possibly other Professional Liability claims.
  • Interpret policy provisions, identify potential coverage issues, and prepare comprehensive written coverage positions.
  • Interview insureds, claimants, witnesses and other appropriate parties to obtain information used to assess liability exposure.
  • Document related files regarding results of investigation and negotiations.
  • Prepare reports to file on established diary dates and other specific reports as needed to ensure timely file documentation and plan of action.
  • Secure records for investigation and evaluation of cases.
  • Determine and implement negotiation strategy and negotiate settlements within authority level.
  • Timely post and adjust reserves by specific dates pursuant to the company’s Best Claim Practices and Reserving Guidelines. Advise claims management on claims status and attend Reserve & Settlement Committee Meetings as necessary. Ensure timely reporting to the Reserve and Settlement Committee.
  • Interact with other departments as necessary to help facilitate and coordinate services to our insured and client.
  • Evaluate cases for appropriate disposition and seek authority for settlement from Manager/Director when settlement amount requests exceed authority.
  • Direct and monitor activities of defense counsel in compliance with Case Management Guidelines.
  • Monitor trials and attend pre-trial proceedings, mediations and arbitrations as necessary.
  • Identify significant insured Risk Management or Underwriting issues and direct the information to the appropriate department.
  • Communicate with insureds, claimants and witnesses; consult relevant records, varying methods of investigation according to type of claim.
  • Analyze and verify insurance coverage for claims brought against policyholders.
  • Maintain working knowledge of policy forms and can confirm policy in effect for date of loss.
  • Support evolving business needs, as applicable.

Education, Experience, Competencies & Values

  • Bachelor's degree from four-year college or university, required.
  • J.D. preferred with 5+ years of experiencing handling Professional Liability claims, preferably with some experience handling Lawyer Professional Liability claims.
  • Knowledge of legal and insurance terminology is required.
  • Must hold a current driver's license.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • Must have training in contract/policy review and application.
  • Must be comfortable making oral presentations to staff and insureds, and able to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, insureds, agents and attorneys.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret insurance policy coverage forms, professional journals, technical procedures, or government regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and technical case summaries.
  • Must be able to synthesize complex or diverse information; Collect and research data; use intuition and experience to complement data; design workflows and procedures.
  • Must have the ability to design and generate creative solutions.
  • Experience with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Able to work with minimal supervision on a day-to-day basis.
  • Insurance adjuster's license may be required for specific states.
  • Ability to travel up to 25-30%.

Base salary range is $103,530 - $140,070. Individual compensation packages are based on a variety of factors that are unique to each candidate including location, skill set, experience, qualifications and education.

If you're a caring and customer focused individual who enjoys working with passionate team members, Coverys is the right company for you!
