SFORS is a trading company where traders succeed!

We trade in the global financial markets and are among the key proprietary trading players and pre-market trading leaders. Our company owes its 20 years of success in the stock market to constantly investing in talent development, trading technologies, progressive risk management models, and effective trading strategies - all of which drive trader success. SFORS operates exclusively with proprietary funds, without any third-party investments. Our team currently includes over 600 specialists, most of them traders.

About the Role

The Business Process Analyst is one of the key roles within the Automation & Optimization team. The specialist in this position is responsible for researching, documenting, and analyzing the company's internal processes to drive continuous improvement.

Together with the Process Optimization & Automation Lead and Automation Engineer, the Business Process Analyst forms the core of a function that directly impacts the company's operational stability and revenue.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Document and digitize the company's existing internal processes (as-is).

  • Create process maps using BPMN notation and develop target-state process models (to-be).

  • Design processes with a focus on scalability and long-term sustainability.

  • Conduct regular process audits to identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies.

  • Analyze incidents, perform root cause analysis, and contribute to developing processes that prevent recurring issues.

  • Gather requirements from stakeholders and prepare technical specifications for automation initiatives.

  • Prepare analytical reports and recommendations for the Process Optimization & Automation Lead.

  • Define process KPIs and establish performance metrics.

  • Maintain and regularly update the process knowledge base in Confluence.

  • Support process improvements through implementation and validate results.

Requirements

Requirements:

  • At least 2 years of experience as a Business Analyst or Process Analyst.

  • Strong knowledge of BPMN notation and hands-on experience creating process maps using tools such as Miro, Lucidchart, draw.io, Bizagi, or similar.

  • Experience conducting process audits and root cause analysis.

  • Ability to collaborate with stakeholders at different organizational levels, gather requirements, and structure information effectively.

  • Experience working with Jira and Confluence.

  • Strong proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets for data analysis and reporting.

  • Analytical mindset, attention to detail, and the ability to identify systemic issues.

  • Proactive approach to identifying problems and proposing solutions.

  • Ability to structure information and explain complex concepts in a clear and simple manner.

  • Upper-intermediate or higher English proficiency (B2+).

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in financial services, fintech, or trading.

  • Familiarity with incident management and operational resilience practices (ITIL, BCDRP, DORA, or similar).

  • Familiarity with automation principles and low-code/no-code platforms, such as n8n.

  • Experience working in a regulated environment.

  • Experience developing RACI matrices for process documentation and implementation.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive and performance-aligned compensation package.

  • Clear opportunities for long-term professional growth and strategic career development.

  • A high-trust, collaborative environment with a strong ownership culture.

In Addition, We Provide

  • Corporate housing access - up to 2-3 weeks of free accommodation per year in Larnaca (Cyprus) for vacations, business trips, or work-related travel.

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including annual medical check-ups.

  • Psychological support program (up to four sessions per month).

  • Partial compensation for tennis training, gym memberships, other sports activities, rehabilitation, massages, and participation in competitions, including international events.

  • Partial reimbursement for external professional education and certifications.

  • Full access to internal educational, cultural, and entertainment initiatives, including guest lectures.

Job Title: Business Development Manager – Sustainability

Location: Mexico- Remote

Employment Type: Full-time


About the Role

BSI is seeking an experienced and strategic Business Development Manager (BDM), Sustainability to maintain and grow relationships with large, strategically important clients. You will coordinate BSI’s global efforts to deliver assurance solutions focused on sustainability, greenhouse gas (GHG) verification, reduction, and neutrality.

In this role, you will lead account planning, achieve sales targets by expanding existing accounts and securing new business, and provide thought leadership within the sustainability space. You will also support sales initiatives across the Americas and actively engage in industry events.


In your day to day, you will be responsible for:

  • Achieve assigned sales targets and drive profitable revenue growth.
  • Develop and manage relationships with strategic accounts and senior business leaders.
  • Retain existing accounts through ongoing engagement and partnership with operational teams.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities to expand BSI’s sustainability client base.
  • Negotiate contracts and close deals, integrating requirements into operational delivery.
  • Support other sales professionals in selling sustainability and GHG audit services.
  • Collaborate with global marketing, product development, and sales teams on priorities and initiatives.
  • Participate in industry associations, conferences, and events to provide thought leadership.
  • Conduct account health checks, review pricing annually, and facilitate issue resolution.
  • Maintain accurate forecasting and CRM data to support business planning and customer service.
  • Analyze market conditions, competitors, and customer insights to enhance sales performance.

To be successful in the role, you will have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, quimical engineer or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • At least 5 years of experience in solutions sales and business development.
  • Experience selling assessment or audit solutions within professional services.
  • Proven ability to engage senior-level management and manage multinational client relationships.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Salesforce (preferred).
  • Strong skills in communication, persuasion, relationship-building, and performance monitoring.

Career opportunities are vast with around 5,000 employees working with over 82,000 clients in 182 countries. BSI challenges mediocrity and complacency to help embed excellence into the way people and products work. That means showing businesses how to improve performance, reduce risk, and achieve sustainable growth.


What we offer:

BSI offers a competitive total reward package, an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training and development with the inclusion of 20-days annual leave, bank holidays, medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, maternal leave, paid parental leave, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.


Do you believe the world deserves excellence?

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organisations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.


Headquartered in London, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Incorporated by Royal Charter, we’re truly impartial and home to the ultimate mark of trust, the Kitemark.

Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance, and regulatory services, we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.


D&I Policy

BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. Our goal is to create a sense of belonging for all employees by providing opportunities to develop, grow, and engage with our global organization, all while having fun doing great work. BSI is a community where everyone can thrive.

If you require any reasonable accommodations to be made on account of a disability or impairment throughout our recruiting process, please inform your Talent Acquisition Partner.

About Us

BSI is a business improvement and standards company and for over a century BSI has been recognized for having a positive impact on organizations and society, building trust and enhancing lives.

Today BSI partners with more than 77,500 clients in 195 countries and engages with a 15,000 strong global community of experts, industry and consumer groups, organizations and governments.
Utilizing its extensive expertise in key industry sectors - including automotive, aerospace, built environment, food and retail, and healthcare - BSI delivers on its purpose by helping its clients fulfil theirs.
Living by our core values of Client-Centricity, Agility, and Collaboration, BSI provides organizations with the confidence to grow by partnering with them to tackle society’s critical issues – from climate change to building trust in digital transformation and everything in between - to accelerate progress towards a better society and a sustainable world.

BSI is an Equal Opportunity Employer dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

LBL Manager, BL Metals UK

What's in it for you?

Process Industries delivers complete electrification, automation and digital solutions that improve productivity, energy efficiency and sustainability across industrial operations. Join us. Be part of the team where progress happens, industries transform, and your work shapes the world.

Run What Runs the World.

We also encourage applications from men, who are under-represented in our Children’s Services roles. We recognise that people hold multiple identities, and we value the richness this brings to our team.

Job Summary

Quality Management Specialist

Aptive Resources is seeking a Quality Management Specialist to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Office of Research and Development (ORD) Cooperative Studies Program (CSP) under the Field Enterprise Research Support Services (FERSS) contract. Sponsored by the Palo Alto VA Medical Center (VAMC), this role coordinates the planning, execution, and tracking of activities required for CSP’s six Epidemiology Centers (ECs) to achieve ISO 9001:2026 Quality Management System (QMS) certification, ensuring a structured, clause-aligned implementation across centers.

This position requires strong knowledge of ISO 9001 principles, QMS structures, and controlled document governance, combined with the project management and facilitation skills needed to align work across distributed teams. The selected candidate will work closely with EC Directors, Quality Assurance leads, document governance teams, ISO subject matter experts (SMEs), and CSP Central Office.

This is a full-time (40 hours/week), 100% remote position.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive ISO 9001:2026 implementation plan, organized by phase (Gap Assessment, QMS Development, Rollout, Internal Audit, and Certification), based on direction from EC Directors.
  • Coordinate clause-specific planning for all actionable ISO 9001 requirements, including Context of the Organization, Leadership, Planning, Support, Operation, Performance Evaluation, and Improvement.
  • Support identification of processes across the six ECs suitable for unified evaluation, and manage milestones and communication around development of unified EC processes for external review and certification scope.
  • Facilitate cross-center gap analysis workshops and consolidate results into a clause-specific gap assessment.
  • Support resource needs assessments, including staffing, SME input, and certification body contracting mechanisms.
  • Map existing EC QMS components to ISO 9001 clauses and identify elements to adopt, adapt, or abandon.
  • Support integration of clause-aligned documentation processes across centers, including controlled document lifecycles and compliance with global versus local documentation requirements.
  • Monitor implementation progress against the project plan, identify schedule risks and quality gaps, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Maintain progress dashboards and milestone tracking to provide transparent visibility into implementation status.
  • Prepare monthly written progress summaries for CSP leadership.
  • Facilitate cross-center collaboration and knowledge sharing among EC Directors, Quality Assurance leads, document governance teams, ISO SMEs, and CSP Central Office.
  • Apply risk management and change management practices to support adoption of new QMS processes across distributed teams.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in public health, epidemiology, life or biomedical sciences, health administration, business or management, quality management, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in quality management, QMS implementation, or project management within a complex or regulated organization.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of ISO 9001 principles (ISO 9001:2015 and/or the 2026 revision), including leadership, context of the organization, risk-based thinking, document control, and audit requirements.
  • Knowledge of QMS structures and controlled document lifecycles, including document governance practices.
  • Experience with process mapping and workflow optimization.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and manage project plans, schedules, milestones, and risks across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Strong facilitation, written, and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing progress reports for leadership audiences.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a public trust clearance.
  • Legal authorization to work in the U.S.

Desired Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (Master’s or above) in a scientific, public health, or related field.
  • Direct experience leading or supporting an organization through ISO 9001 certification, including multi-site or unified certification scope.
  • Familiarity with quality management systems in research organizations, especially epidemiologic or clinical research environments.
  • Knowledge of regulatory alignment for research QMS, including Good Clinical Practice (GCP), federal requirements, and VA policies.
  • ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor certification, or an ASQ quality certification (e.g., CQA, CMQ/OE).
  • Project management, process improvement, or change management certifications (e.g., PMP, CAPM, Lean Six Sigma Green or Black Belt, Prosci Change Management).
  • Experience working in a federal or VA research environment; familiarity with the VA Cooperative Studies Program is a plus.
  • Experience with change management and stakeholder engagement across geographically distributed teams.

Physical Requirements

Physical Requirements: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit for extended periods, use a computer keyboard and mouse, and communicate verbally and in writing. The employee may occasionally need to stand, walk, bend, or lift up to 15 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

About Aptive

About Aptive. Aptive partners with federal agencies to achieve their missions through improved performance, streamlined operations and enhanced service delivery. Based in Alexandria, Virginia, we support more than a dozen agencies including Veterans Affairs, Transportation, Defense, Homeland Security and the National Science Foundation. We specialize in applying technology, creativity and human-centered services to optimize mission delivery and improve experiences for millions of people who count on government services every day. Founded: 2012. Employees: 300+ nationwide.

EEO Statement

Aptive is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, parental status, veteran status, age, disability, or any other protected class. Veterans, members of the Reserve and National Guard, and transitioning active-duty service members are highly encouraged to apply. Title: Digital Product Designer
Reports to: Director of Product
Location: Remote

About the Organization
Upwardly Global is a national workforce development organization that connects work-authorized, college-educated immigrants to skill-aligned professional employment across the United States. We address one of the country’s most significant economic inefficiencies: more than 2 million highly educated, work-authorized immigrants are underemployed, representing over $40 billion in annual forgone wages and untapped productivity for the American economy.

Our model works. Jobseekers enter our programs earning an average of $9,000 per year and are placed in roles averaging $67,000 per year. To date, we have supported an estimated 35,000 job placements, contributing billions in earnings to the U.S. economy.
Upwardly Global is data-driven, economically accountable, and built for scale. We are committed to leveraging AI to its fullest potential, driving operational efficiency, jobseeker readiness, and national economic impact. We operate nationally, partnering with leading employers, workforce agencies, and policymakers to ensure that global talent becomes American advantage.

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Product Designer who is passionate about designing products that improve people's lives to join our team and support our transformation to a digital product-driven organization.
The Product Designer will own the user experience of our platform end-to-end, collaborating with cross-functional teams to craft user-centered design solutions. They will leverage data and user research to inform the design process, resulting in products that are visually appealing but also highly functional and aligned with user needs. Because we are building an AI-powered career platform, this position will shape how our users experience AI as a helpful and trustworthy guide.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Lead design projects end-to-end, including user flows, wireframes, low-fidelity prototypes, high-fidelity mockups, and visual assets.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to align design solutions with business goals and technical requirements.
  • Design conversational and AI-guided experiences- chat, voice, and assistant-driven flows- so that AI feels like one coherent, consistent presence across the product.
  • Design for our users' real conditions: mobile-first, accessible, and clear for users navigating English as a second or third language.
  • Designing data-rich interfaces such as dashboards, progress indicators, or assessment/scoring displays and applying strong information hierarchy and visual encoding (color, iconography, progressive disclosure
  • Own and evolve our design system- design documentation, style guides, component patterns, and asset libraries - to ensure consistency across a multi-role platform and to ensure alignment with the branding and enable clean handoff to engineering.
  • Drive design iterations, refining and improving UX solutions based on feedback from users, team members, and stakeholders.
  • Help plan and conduct usability tests, analyze results, and identify areas to improve the user experience.
Qualifications:
  • 3–5 years of experience in UX and product design.
  • A well-designed portfolio demonstrating relevant design projects and skills- including wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity design
  • Experience designing AI-powered or conversational products (chatbots, voice agents, or AI assistants).
  • Experience designing end-to-end, consumer-facing product experiences- not just individual screens or internal tools.
  • Experience designing learning or educational products- structured content, progression, and progress-tracking systems.
  • Familiarity with how LLM-based features behave- latency, variability, and the risk of incorrect output- and how thoughtful design mitigates those rough edges.
  • Familiarity with front-end development technologies (e.g., React/component-based frameworks) and how they shape design implementation and handoff.
  • Experience designing accessible, mobile-first interfaces, ideally for audiences with a range of language and digital literacy levels to ensure designs meet accessibility standards (i.e. WCAG compliance).
  • Knowledge of usability testing methodologies and user research techniques.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment, meet deadlines, and demonstrate professionalism and a positive attitude.
  • A growth mindset- actively seeking feedback from users, stakeholders, and the design community, and continually sharpening your craft.
  • Excitement about our mission to create an inclusive and welcoming country without barriers for newcomers to thrive in the labor market.
*To be considered for this role, please include a link to your portfolio or attach 3-5 relevant work samples with your application.

Salary Range: 110- 125K

Salary Disclaimer: The base salary range represents the low and high end of the Indeed salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Upwardly Global's total compensation package for employees. Benefits include a paid time off policy, medical/dental/vision insurance, paid parental leave, short-term disability insurance, life insurance and a retirement plan with employer match.

Upwardly Global is deeply committed to building a workplace where inclusion is not only valued but prioritized. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment.

raw.excerpt: Company Overview At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents.
raw.description:
Company Overview

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

Be part of a team that makes a real difference.

Job Description

This is a full-time remote position that can be located anywhere in the Eastern Time Zone of the U.S. Preference will be given to candidates located in New Jersey; however, remote candidates throughout the Eastern Time Zone are encouraged to apply.

As a Workers’ Compensation Adjuster, you will manage a caseload of workers’ compensation claims from initial investigation through resolution. You'll play a key role in ensuring injured employees receive appropriate medical care and benefits while collaborating with employers, medical providers, nurse case managers, and legal partners. This role offers the opportunity to develop expertise in workers’ compensation claims handling, litigation management, and return-to-work strategies while utilizing modern claims technology and AI-powered tools to improve efficiency and outcomes.
Duties and Responsibilities
  • Investigates, evaluates, and resolves assigned Workers’ Compensation claims of a more complex or litigated nature in a timely manner in accordance with legal statutes, policy provisions, and company guidelines.
  • Evaluate claimant eligibility; communicate with attending physician, employer and injured worker.
  • Work with both the claimant and their physician to medically manage the claim, from initial medical treatment to reviewing and evaluating ongoing treatment and related information.
  • Work directly with employers to facilitate a return to work, either on a full-time or modified duty basis.
  • Confirm coverage and applicable insurance policy or coverage document and statutory requirements.
  • Identify potential for third party recovery, including subrogation, Second Injury Fund or other fund involvement (when applicable) and excess or reinsurance reimbursement. Pursue the process of reimbursement and complete posting of recovery to the claim file, where appropriate.
  • Identify potential for disability or pension credits or offsets and apply same where appropriate.
  • Ensure timely denial or payment of benefits in accordance with jurisdictional requirements.
  • Establish claim reserve levels by estimating the potential exposure of each assigned claim, establish appropriate reserves with documented rationale, maintain and adjust reserves over the life of the claim to reflect changes in exposure.
  • Establish compensability status through case investigation and evaluation and application of jurisdictional statutes and laws.
  • Manage diary in accordance with Best Practices and complete tasks to ensure that cases move to the best financial outcome and timely resolution.
  • Where litigation is filed, evaluate exposure and work with defense counsel to establish strong defenses, prepare litigation plan of action, set legal reserve and manage litigation over life of claim.
  • Close all files as appropriate in a timely and complete manner.
  • Maintain closing ratio as directed by management team.
  • Oversee and coordinate medical treatment for injured employees and provide information to treating physicians regarding employees’ medical history, health issues, and job requirements; provide direction to assigned nurse case manager where applicable.
  • Complete PARs (payment authorization request) when applicable.
  • Comply with all excess and reinsurance reporting requirements; manage self-insured retention reporting.

Qualifications

  • High School diploma required.
  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • 2 years of experience handling workers’ compensation claims.
  • Experience managing claims investigations, compensability determinations, and benefit administration.
  • Litigation and/or subrogation experience preferred.
  • Workers’ compensation designations, certifications, or industry training are a plus.

Benefits

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $18.45 - $23.55 hourly, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.

The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and underrepresented minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

raw.excerpt: Hi, we are ecobee.  ecobee introduced the world’s first smart Wi-Fi thermostat to help millions of consumers save money, conserve energy, and bring home automation into their lives.
raw.description:
Hi, we are ecobee.

ecobee introduced the world’s first smart Wi-Fi thermostat to help millions of consumers save money, conserve energy, and bring home automation into their lives. That was just the beginning. We continue our pursuit to create technology that brings peace of mind into the home and allows people to focus on the moments that matter most. We take pride in making a meaningful difference to the environment, all while being part of the exciting, connected home revolution.

In 2021, ecobee became a subsidiary of Generac Power Systems. Generac introduced the first affordable backup generator and later created the category of automatic home standby generator. The company is committed to sustainable, cleaner energy products poised to revolutionize the 21st century electrical grid. Together, we take pride in making a meaningful difference to the environment.

Why we love to do what we do:

We’re helping build the world of tomorrow with solutions that improve everyday life while making a positive impact on the planet. Our products and services work in harmony to provide comfort, efficiency, and peace of mind for millions of homes and businesses. While we’re proud of what we’ve done so far, there’s still a lot we can do—and you can be part of it.

Join our extraordinary team.

We're a rapidly growing global tech company headquartered in Canada, in the heart of downtown Toronto, with an office in Leeds, UK, and remote ecopeeps in the US. We get to work with some of North America and UK's leading professionals. Our colleagues are proud to bring their authentic selves to work, confident that what we do is grounded in a greater purpose. We’re always looking for curious, talented, and passionate people to join our team.


Who You Will Be Joining
The Senior Energy Sales Manager reports to the Senior Director, Energy and leads growth across ecobee’s portfolio of energy hardware and energy services solutions in North America. The role develops and expands relationships with energy providers, implementation contractors, aggregators, virtual power plant operators, and other energy industry stakeholders. It brings integrated smart home, grid services, and energy management solutions to market; structures complex commercial agreements; and builds trusted relationships that drive long-term revenue, margin, and strategic growth.


How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Develops and executes sales strategies that deliver revenue, margin, and growth targets, supported by a strong pipeline of hardware and recurring energy services opportunities.
  • Leads opportunities from prospecting and qualification through business case development, proposal, pricing, contract execution, and program launch.
  • Maintains disciplined CRM data, opportunity qualification, forecasting, and pipeline reporting to support accurate revenue projections and mitigate deal risk through extended utility procurement cycles.
  • Structures and negotiates complex, high-value hardware, software, and services agreements, including new program launches, renewals, and multi-year strategic partnerships.
  • Identifies and develops integrated hardware and services opportunities across capacity and flexibility programs, virtual power plants, home energy management, carbon and sustainability offerings, and emerging distributed energy resource programs.
  • Builds trusted relationships with senior decision-makers across utilities, energy providers, implementation contractors, aggregators, virtual power plant operators, and other strategic energy partners.
  • Represents ecobee at industry conferences, customer events, and stakeholder forums and brings market insights and customer feedback into strategic planning.
  • Collaborates across marketing, finance, operations, legal, regulatory, and other go-to-market sales channels to maximize partner and customer value and advance ecobee’s long-term energy growth strategy.

What You’ll Bring to the Table:
We've built the following list as a guideline for some of the skills and interests of our development team - but we strive to build our team with members from a diverse background and skill set, so if any combination of these apply to you, we would love to chat!

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Energy Management, Sustainability, or a related discipline.
  • Eight or more years of experience in energy, utilities, clean technology, distributed energy resources, demand-side management, grid services, or a related industry and demonstrated success in consultative enterprise sales, strategic accounts, or business development involving complex hardware, software, SaaS, or services solutions.
  • Experience developing sales strategies and structuring and negotiating high-value commercial agreements and multi-year partnerships through extended procurement cycles.
  • Strong knowledge of utility business models, regulatory environments, and energy program structures.
  • Ability to apply a rigorous, consultative enterprise selling framework, build business cases and pricing strategies, maintain pipeline visibility and forecast accuracy, and influence executive stakeholders.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, negotiation, relationship-building, and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% for customer meetings, industry events, and on-site deal development.

Good to Have:

  • MBA or advanced degree.
  • Experience with virtual power plants, demand response & energy efficiency programs, distributed energy resources, retail energy programs, grid services, or home energy management technologies.
  • Established network within the North American utility and energy services ecosystem.
  • Familiarity with wholesale electricity markets, DER aggregation, carbon markets, and home energy management technologies.

Just so you know:The hired candidate will be required to complete a background check.


What happens after you apply:

Application review. It will happen by an actual person in Talent Acquisition.

We get upwards of 100+ applications for some roles, it can take a few days, but every applicant can expect a note regarding their application status.


Interview Process:

  • A 30-minute phone call with a member in Talent Acquisition.
  • A first round 60-minute virtual interview with the hiring manager and a team member – expect behavioural and situational questions.
  • The final interview will be a 60-minute case study round with a panel of cross functional leaders.

Generac is committed to fair and equity compensation practices. The salary range for this remote role is $134,200 - $164,000. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate's relevant work experience, skills, certifications and geographic location. This position includes a comprehensive benefit package that includes medical, dental and vision plans; life, long-term disability, flexible, spending and health savings accounts, accrued paid time off, eight paid holidays in 401(k) retirement benefits.


“We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.”

Please note that fluency in French is required, as it is our main business language. English is considered our secondary working language.

📅 Date de démarrage

  • Dès que possible, idéalement entre décembre 2026 et janvier 2027

  • Le profil prime sur la rapidité : un préavis jusqu'à 3 mois n'est pas un frein

🏡 Type de contrat

  • CDI ou Freelance

  • Temps plein

  • Séniorité : Confirmé(e) / Senior

🌍 Localisation

  • 100% Remote en Europe (zone CET ± 4h)

  • Ou hybride à Lausanne pour les profils basés en Suisse

💼 Description du poste

DotWorld édite plusieurs SaaS B2C par abonnement, dont certains s'appuient sur l'intelligence artificielle, utilisés chaque année par des millions de personnes dans le monde. Notre acquisition amène énormément de trafic sur nos produits : le prochain levier de croissance, c'est de transformer davantage de visiteur(se)s en client(e)s, puis de faire en sorte que nos abonné(e)s tirent pleinement parti de leur abonnement.

C'est tout l'enjeu du poste de Product Growth Ops : ta mission est de transformer nos visiteur(se)s en client(e)s et de maximiser leur engagement dans la durée, avec un impact direct sur le chiffre d'affaires et la rentabilité de nos SaaS.

Tu interviens sur trois leviers : reconvertir les visiteur(se)s et inscrit(e)s qui n'ont pas finalisé leur parcours (re-marketing), construire et opérer le CRM qui unifie la connaissance de nos client(e)s B2C, et maximiser l'engagement de nos utilisateur(rice)s, avant comme après l'achat, pour réduire leur time-to-value et augmenter leur lifetime value.

Tu es le/la premier(e) Product Growth Ops de DotWorld : tu es pleinement lead sur la manière de conduire les campagnes, le choix des outils et la définition des indicateurs de succès. Ta réussite se mesure à l'impact de tes actions sur les conversions et le revenu - ici, ce sont les résultats qui comptent, pas le temps passé.

👥 Description de l'équipe

Tu rejoins l'organisation Produit, sous la responsabilité de Jérémy RICHARD, notre CPO, qui sera ton manager direct.

Le poste est rattaché au Produit car la grande majorité de tes initiatives se construisent avec les Product Managers de chaque SaaS. Tu travailles aussi en lien étroit avec l'équipe Acquisition et le département Data : un rôle transverse, à la jonction du produit, du marketing et de la donnée.

💻 Tes responsabilités

Re-marketing & conversion

  • Concevoir et piloter les campagnes de re-marketing (emailing, retargeting) pour reconvertir les visiteur(se)s et inscrit(e)s n'ayant pas finalisé leur parcours d'achat

  • Construire les audiences et le ciblage en coordination avec l'équipe Acquisition, pour des campagnes cohérentes sur l'ensemble du funnel

  • Mesurer la performance de chaque campagne (délivrabilité, conversion, revenu) et itérer rapidement

CRM unifié

  • Mettre en place et piloter un CRM unifié des client(e)s et prospects B2C de l'ensemble de nos SaaS, référence unique pour toutes les équipes

  • Structurer le modèle de données client, garantir sa fiabilité et construire des segmentations exploitables, avec le département Data

  • Mettre la donnée CRM au service des campagnes, du produit et de l'acquisition (audiences, triggers, personnalisation)

Engagement, adoption & rétention

  • Amener chaque utilisateur(rice) à la valeur le plus vite possible et réengager les abonné(e)s qui n'utilisent plus le produit

  • Concevoir et automatiser les campagnes lifecycle tout au long du cycle de vie utilisateur (in-app, emails, newsletters)

  • Mener des études et interviews utilisateur(rice)s pour comprendre pourquoi certain(e)s ne reviennent pas, et transformer ces insights en recommandations concrètes pour les équipes Produit

  • Suivre l'activation, l'engagement et la rétention, et partager des insights actionnables

Growth machine

  • Outiller, automatiser et documenter les mécaniques growth pour qu'elles passent à l'échelle sur l'ensemble de nos SaaS

  • Faire le pont entre Produit, Acquisition et Data pour que la machine tourne sans friction

⭐ Ton profil

Expérience

  • Environ 5 ans d'expérience en growth, CRM / lifecycle marketing ou marketing automation

  • Des résultats prouvés et chiffrés : tu sais relier tes campagnes à leur impact sur la conversion et le revenu

  • Une expérience en B2C à fort volume est indispensable, idéalement sur des SaaS par abonnement

  • Un profil growth avant tout, à l'aise pour travailler au quotidien avec des équipes Produit

Compétences techniques

  • Solide maîtrise des CRM et des plateformes de marketing automation, de la configuration au pilotage

  • Conception et pilotage de campagnes emailing et in-app, retargeting

  • Analyse de données : funnels, cohortes, segmentation, tableaux de bord, outils d'analytics produit

  • Culture d'expérimentation : conception et lecture de tests, décisions fondées sur la donnée

  • Usage autonome et quotidien des outils d'IA (analyse, rédaction, automatisation, création de segments et de contenus)

Compétences interpersonnelles

  • Ownership de bout en bout : de la conception d'une campagne à la mesure de son impact

  • Hands-on, autonome et orienté(e) résultats

  • Aisance dans la gestion de nombreuses parties prenantes

  • Exigence qualité et souci du détail sur chaque message envoyé aux utilisateur(rice)s

  • Curiosité pour les utilisateur(rice)s : tu aimes comprendre leurs comportements et leurs besoins

Compétences linguistiques

  • Français courant - c'est notre langue de travail principale

  • Anglais courant (B2 minimum) - c'est notre langue de travail secondaire, et il est évalué pendant le processus de recrutement

✨ Les avantages du poste

  • Un rôle transverse et central, au cœur de la Growth machine de plusieurs SaaS B2C

  • Un impact direct et mesurable sur le revenu, à l'échelle de millions d'utilisateur(rice)s

  • Le premier poste de Product Growth Ops chez DotWorld : tu choisis les outils, les méthodes et les KPI

  • Une forte autonomie et une vraie liberté de décision sur tes campagnes

  • Un environnement IA-first, où l'IA fait partie intégrante de la manière de travailler

🔥 Les défis du poste

  • Un périmètre large (re-marketing, CRM, lifecycle) sur plusieurs SaaS : savoir prioriser est essentiel

  • Un terrain de jeu à construire : tu poses les fondations du CRM et des mécaniques growth, avec le département Data

  • Des objectifs ambitieux sur la conversion et le revenu, suivis de près dès ta prise de poste

  • De nombreuses parties prenantes (Product Managers, Acquisition, Data) à embarquer

📋 Notre processus de recrutement

  • Entretien de découverte avec notre Talent Acquisition Manager, Noémie - 30 min

  • Étude de cas growth en live avec notre CPO, Jérémy - 1h

  • Entretien culturel avec notre Head of HR & Finance, Matteo - 1h

  • Prise de références

ℹ️ A propos de DotWorld

Dotworld est un Venture Builder et SaaS Studio. Notre modèle est simple mais exigeant : nous concevons, lançons et scalons plusieurs produits SaaS en parallèle. Notre équipe, entièrement distribuée, évolue avec une culture forte : Test, Learn, Scale. Nous créons des outils concrets qui facilitent le quotidien de millions de personnes dans le monde entier. Aujourd'hui, notre activité est structurée autour de différents univers produits, allant d'outils RH à des solutions de gestion de contenus et de création design.

Notre approche

Nous construisons des SaaS robustes, intuitifs et techniquement solides. Une fois les bases maîtrisées, nous les déployons à l'international grâce à un travail poussé de traduction et de localisation. raw.title: Temp - Product Marketing Manager
raw.excerpt: At Curriculum Associates, we believe in the potential of every child and are changing the face of education technology with award-winning learning programs like i-Ready that serve a third of the nation’s K–8 students.
raw.description:
At Curriculum Associates, we believe in the potential of every child and are changing the face of education technology with award-winning learning programs like i-Ready that serve a third of the nation’s K–8 students. For more than 50 years, our commitment to making classrooms better places, serving educators, and supporting accessible learning experiences for all students has driven the continuous improvement of our innovative programs. Our team of more than 2,500 employees is composed of lifelong learners who stand behind this mission, working tirelessly to serve the educational community with world-class programs and support every day.

The Product Marketing Manager, Literacy (Temporary) provides focused, hands-on support to the Literacy Product Marketing team at Curriculum Associates from approximately November 2026 through May 2027. Working across the literacy portfolio, including Mosaico: Lectoescritura and Magnetic Literacy, the role executes go-to-market deliverables such as collateral, sales enablement materials, website and campaign content, state adoption support, and event materials. Reporting to the Associate Vice President of Product Marketing, this role turns established messaging and priorities into finished, accurate deliverables that help Sales, Regional Marketing, and educators understand and adopt Curriculum Associates literacy programs. This is a temporary assignment averaging 30 hours per week.

The impact you'll have:

  • Execute product-level marketing plans for core and supplemental literacy products, including Magnetic Literacy and Phonics for Reading, in partnership with the Associate Vice President of Product Marketing and product marketing peers, so launches and campaigns stay on schedule
  • Develop and update collateral and sales enablement materials, such as overview brochures, presentations, guides, FAQs, and flyers, so Sales and Regional Marketing can present literacy programs clearly and consistently
  • Draft and edit digital content, including product page updates, campaign copy, email, and social content, in partnership with Web, Integrated Campaigns, and Regional Marketing so educators see accurate, current information
  • Support curriculum adoption efforts by gathering market information, preparing messaging and competitive summaries, and building adoption materials
  • Conduct market and competitive research, such as district listening sessions, focus group preparation, and event or customer visit notes, and summarize findings so they inform messaging and go-to-market decisions
  • Prepare materials and follow-up for conferences, webinars, and events, such as booth kits, session materials, and one-pagers, so teams are ready to share program stories with educators and district leaders
  • Write scripts and content for videos, case studies, and thought leadership pieces in partnership with Video, Research, and Content teams so customers and Sales have proof points that reflect real classroom use
  • Provide flexible support to priority launches and campaigns, such as Mosaico: Lectoescritura and biliteracy, by completing assigned deliverables so the team can focus on strategy for those programs
  • Partner with Product, Research/Insights, Sales, Enablement, Web, Video, and Brand to gather input, confirm accuracy, and move deliverables through review and approval so materials reflect product capabilities and meet company content standards
  • Track deliverable status, open items, and handoffs in a weekly update to the Associate Vice President of Product Marketing so priorities stay visible and work transitions cleanly at the end of the assignment

Who we're looking for:

  • Translate direction and established messaging into clear, well-executed marketing deliverables on defined timelines
  • Write and edit clear, accurate, audience-appropriate marketing content in English
  • Manage multiple concurrent deliverables with competing due dates, and communicate status and risks to stakeholders
  • Prioritize requests that arrive through multiple channels, such as direct messages, email, and project tools, in agreement with the Associate Vice President of Product Marketing
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners, including Product, Sales, Enablement, Research/Insights, Web, Video, and Brand, and incorporate their input into final deliverables
  • Use Microsoft 365 (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, and Teams). Experience with work-management tools such as Workfront and sales enablement platforms such as Highspot is preferred
  • Apply company brand, content, and review guidelines, and route any claims about product effectiveness through the required evidence review before use
  • Observe and absorb information communicated through relevant materials such as meetings, product documents, and written feedback, and apply it to deliverables
  • Maintain the confidentiality of unreleased product, roadmap, and customer information, and complete required confidentiality and intellectual property agreements
  • Work independently in a remote setting during U.S. business hours, including availability for scheduled team meetings

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree, or a combination of education and experience that provides equivalent knowledge
  • 3+ years of experience in product marketing, content marketing, or related marketing work for K–12 curriculum, educational publishing, or education technology
  • Experience creating sales enablement materials, collateral, or campaign content that supports a product launch
  • Working knowledge of K–12 literacy instruction, such as foundational skills, phonics, and comprehension, and how districts review and adopt curriculum
  • Preferred: experience supporting state or district adoption processes; experience with supplemental or foundational literacy programs; professional fluency in Spanish (reading and writing); classroom teaching experience

Benefits and Pay Range:

Pay Range – This role’s range is $40 - $50/hr.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that Curriculum Associates considers in making compensation decisions based on our

Compensation Philosophy. Actual base pay within that range will vary based upon several factors including, but not limited to, prior experience and relevant skill sets. At Curriculum Associates, it is not typical for an

individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances for each case. The Company recognizes that minimum wage varies by location and will ensure all compensation decisions comply with applicable state and local laws.

Benefits - Temporary employees who average, and maintain, at least 30 hours of work per week may become eligible for medical coverage, under the Affordable Care Act, after an initial waiting period. Temporary and per-diem employees working more than 20 hours per week are eligible for twelve paid

holidays. All temporary employees are eligible for accrued sick time. Temporary employees may be

eligible to participate in the 401k if they meet the hours required of the plan.


Travel: Less than once per month. Occasional domestic travel by air or car, including overnight stays, may be requested for conferences, customer events, or district visits. Attendance is to be confirmed.

Hours: Average of 30 hours per week; assignment runs approximately through May 15, 2027


Application Deadline: December 11, 2026. This is subject to close earlier if there is a high volume of applicants or a qualified hire is made

Job Posting Closing Date: Open until Filled

Where do you belong?

Your career is more than just a job, it's part of your life. Whether you’re a clinician, or non-clinical professional, at USACS you'll feel a sense of connection working with clinicians and office staff who share your interests and values. We want you to love coming to work each day because you believe in what you do and the people with whom you work. We care about your success.

USACS also understands that location is important. We offer career opportunities for clinicians and non-clinical support staff from New York to Hawaii and numerous points in between. Our supportive culture, outstanding benefits and competitive compensation package is best in class.

Job Description

The Vice President, Total Rewards provides strategic design and direction, execution and ongoing management of USACS total rewards programs. As an integral member of our HR leadership team, the Vice President of Total Rewards will have a focus on constant innovation to ensure that our benefit and compensation programs remain competitive, sustainable, scalable, and positively impact the short- and long-term performance of the organization.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:


Benefits

  • Partner with Chief Administrative Officer and broader Executive Team on the development of company benefit strategy, aligning with USACS’s model to manage quality and cost, as well as attract and retain a high-performance workforce
  • Incorporate experience and marketing methodology into benefit implementation and communication strategy, simplifying complex concepts and ensuring team members are aware of the available support and investment on behalf of the organization
  • Ensure compliance across all plans with applicable Federal, State and local regulations governing employer sponsored benefits
  • Lead the annual open enrollment process including broker and carrier marketing, plan decisions and managing employee communication
  • Develop an innovative and engaging benefits education program that extends beyond open enrollment period to provide a best in class experience for all employees
  • Research new strategies for a self-funded organization and network to understand best practices in the industry
  • Ensure all plan documents and Summary Plan Descriptions are updated, and stored for accessibility, 5500 Filings are filed accurately and in a timely manner, and oversee annual plan audits
  • Monitor industry and external market and provide analysis on the impact of relevant developments in the compensation and benefits areas
  • Communicate and interface with insurance companies and third-party benefit plan administrators to facilitate proper and complete utilization of benefits for all employees

Compensation

  • Design, implement and administer USACS compensation program that includes salary, bonus, and variable incentives including day-to-day management of these programs
  • Lead the analysis of market survey data and area differentials, total rewards, recognition, and supplemental pay programs
  • Conduct market pricing activities like job matching, data analytics, compensation practices and trends
  • Leverage advanced understanding of market data methodology and compensation principles preparing results and identifying potential trends
  • Develop required infrastructure to partner with broader business on compensation analysis and support of role pricing and banding guidelines
  • Manage assessments of new tools to support compensation initiatives
  • Oversee and update all compensation-related communications and materials and ensuring accuracy
  • Partner with Legal team on FLSA reviews for current and new positions

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Experience supporting health care organization
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills and interpersonal skills
  • Excellent at managing workflow for multiple projects, with minimal oversight, in a fast-paced environment
  • Highly organized, self-directed, and action-oriented, with an ability to work with employees at all levels in a range of functions
  • Demonstrated record of managing to budgets, targets, goals, and timelines
  • Familiarity with HRIS systems and reporting tools

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree required. Degree in business or human resources a plus
  • Advanced degree or MBA preferred
  • 10 or more years of progressive experience in human resources, with substantial experience in the areas of responsibility listed above

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit for prolonged periods and occasionally walk, stand, bend, stoop, and lift up to 15 pounds.
  • Required to have close visual acuity to perform job

Salary Range:

$157,973.00 - $292,250.00

Salary may be determined on several factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills, experience, education, geographical location and requirements stated in job description.

USACS offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our employees.

Benefits may vary based on role, location, and employment status, but generally include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance options

  • Health savings accounts (HSA) and flexible spending accounts (FSA)

  • 401(k) employee and employer contributions

  • Paid time off, including vacation, sick leave, and company holidays

  • Paid parental leave & family support benefits

  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance

  • Life and accidental death & dismemberment (AD&D) insurance

  • Employee assistance programs & wellness resources

Additional compensation may include bonus eligibility, equity, or other incentive programs, depending on the role.

Specific benefit offerings and eligibility will be provided during the hiring process and may be subject to change in accordance with applicable laws and company policies.

Click the red apply button to submit an application and resume. If you are an USACS employee, please apply via the Jobs Hub in the Workday system.

Energy Markets Consultant/Senior Energy Markets Consultant

Location: US Remote or ICF Office Hybrid (Reston, VA)


About ICF

ICF helps clients navigate the rapidly evolving energy landscape through market analysis, forecasting, transaction support, strategic advisory services, and regulatory expertise. Our clients include power plant developers, utilities, infrastructure investors, lenders, private equity firms, technology companies, government agencies, and other stakeholders shaping the future of the energy industry. ICF’s Power Markets team supports investment decisions, asset development, mergers and acquisitions, resource planning, and policy evaluation across major U.S. power markets and regions, including CAISO, WECC, ERCOT, PJM, NYISO, ISO-NE, MISO, SPP, and SERC.


About the Role

ICF is seeking an Energy Markets Consultant/Senior Energy Markets Consultant to join our growing Power Markets practice. In this role, you will work with leading energy industry participants to evaluate investment opportunities, forecast market outcomes, assess risks, and develop strategies in an increasingly complex energy environment.

You will contribute to projects involving power market forecasting, asset valuation, transmission and interconnection analysis, renewable energy development, battery energy storage systems (BESS), resource adequacy, data center load growth, and energy transition initiatives. Working alongside experienced industry professionals, you will gain exposure to a broad range of technical, financial, and strategic issues affecting U.S. electricity markets while developing expertise that directly informs major investment and business decisions.


What You Will Be Doing

  • Perform quantitative, economic, and technical analyses of U.S. power markets using commercial market models, proprietary tools, and large datasets.
  • Develop long-term forecasts of energy, capacity, ancillary services, and renewable energy market outcomes.
  • Evaluate renewable energy, battery storage, conventional generation, transmission, and emerging energy investments.
  • Analyze market fundamentals, including load growth, fuel prices, transmission congestion, generation retirements, policy changes, and new resource additions.
  • Support interconnection and transmission analyses, including assessments of queue activity, network upgrade costs, congestion impacts, and project economics.
  • Assist with asset valuations, project financing analyses, acquisition due diligence, and M&A support engagements.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to enhance ICF’s proprietary forecasting methodologies, databases, and analytical tools.
  • Prepare client presentations, technical reports, and market insights that effectively communicate complex findings to technical, nontechnical, and executive audiences.
  • Support business development initiatives through market research, proposal preparation, conference participation, and thought leadership.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Economics, Finance, Operations Research, Mathematics, Energy Systems, Statistics, or a related quantitative field, and 2–8+ years of relevant experience in U.S. power markets.
  • Experience with power market simulation and forecasting tools such as PROMOD®, PLEXOS®, Aurora®, PSLF®, or similar platforms.
  • Project management and/or consulting experience.
  • Experience communicating complex technical concepts to both technical and nontechnical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Understanding of market design, transmission systems, resource adequacy, and generation economics.
  • Experience supporting renewable energy, battery storage, transmission, utility, or infrastructure investment projects.
  • Knowledge of asset valuation, project finance, M&A due diligence, or investment analysis.
  • Experience leveraging artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, generative AI, and AI-enabled productivity tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) to improve market analysis, research, forecasting, data processing, automation, and client deliverables.
  • Interest in emerging topics, including energy transition, data center load growth, electrification, battery storage, transmission expansion, and grid modernization.
  • Experience using Python, R, SQL, Power BI, or other advanced analytical tools.

Professional Skills

  • Strong attention to detail, initiative, and commitment to client service.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and within multidisciplinary teams.
  • Intellectual curiosity and a desire to continuously learn about energy markets and emerging technologies.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEO policy.


We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


Work Authorization and Sponsorship

All candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for new H-1B visa sponsorship by ICF. Candidates who currently hold valid work authorization may be considered for a change of employer petition, subject to company policy and applicable immigration requirements.

Reasonable Accommodations

Reasonable Accommodations are available, including, but not limited to, for disabled veterans, individuals with disabilities, and individuals with sincerely held religious beliefs, in all phases of the application and employment process. To request an accommodation, please email  and we will be happy to assist. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations. 


Read more about workplace discrimination rights or our benefit offerings which are included in the Transparency in (Benefits) Coverage Act.


Bot and Third-Party Applications

Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration. Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration. Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact for assistance.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to generate or assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is not permitted. This policy is in place to maintain the integrity and authenticity of the interview process. 


However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodation that involves the use of AI. If such an accommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at . We are dedicated to providing the necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed.  


Pay Range

There are multiple factors that are considered in determining final pay for a position, including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and competencies that align to the specified role, geographic location, education and certifications as well as contract provisions regarding labor categories that are specific to the position.

Customer Service Advisor – Work from Home – Full Time

£26426 per annum

Are you passionate about helping people? Are you looking for a role where you can enhance your customer service skills and develop a career path, remaining in Customer Service or exploring other areas of our business? At Premium Credit we’re looking to hire Customer Service Advisors who are able to provide outstanding customer experiences to our partners and customers through inbound calls and emails.

You’ll receive all the training you need on our systems, processes and industry as well as training to enhance the skills that you already have in communicating professionally, listening and understanding customer needs. You’ll be supported in your journey to success by your buddy and your team manager, as well as the teams around you.

We’re keen for you to apply if;

You maintain high standards of customer care in every interaction

You want to develop your skills within a professional environment

You’re able to work in a fast paced targeted environment

What will you be doing?

Our contact centre is open Monday to Friday between 8am and 6.15pm, so you’ll have a shift rota between these times, working an average of 37.5 hours a week, leaving you free to enjoy your evenings and weekends.

Day to day you’ll answer calls, using our systems to locate customer and partner details to respond to their queries.

  • You could be perform routine tasks such as updating bank or address details or processing payments, or you may deal with more complex calls from vulnerable customers who require additional support.
  • You’ll update call notes and any further actions required using the set processes.
  • On a rotational basis you will spend time responding to emails
  • You’ll be developed and trained to respond to more complex client and commercial partner queries.
  • You’ll work to targets such as calls per hour and call quality, ensuring that you consistently provide the highest levels of customer care.

What do we Offer?

Premium Credit is a leading provider of insurance premium finance and a range of annually charged services such as school fees, golf club membership and football season tickets in the UK and Ireland. It’s an exciting time to join us as we continue to grow and work collaboratively for our future success.

Certified as a Great Place to Work, we have a purpose and values driven culture that ensures we treat each other, our partners and customers with respect and care, uphold our regulatory obligations and treat our customers fairly.

Our benefits include

  • 25 days holiday (plus the opportunity to buy or sell up to 5 days per year)

· A competitive workplace pension scheme

  • Learning and development opportunities that will support your career development
  • 24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Programme as well as access to Mental Health First Aiders

· 1 days paid volunteering per year

  • A range of shopping and lifestyle discounts through our benefits portal

So …. What’s Next?

We’re hiring a team of Customer Service Advisors to join us on 11th January to support increased call volumes. If you’re interested in joining our team, apply via our website. You’ll need to have a passion for great customer service, attention to detail and the ability to communicate in a professional and friendly manner, both over the telephone and in writing.

Your CV and application will be reviewed against our requirements for the role

If you meet our criteria you’ll be contacted to arrange a telephone interview with our recruiter which will include a CV review, a call scenario and the opportunity for you to ask any questions. We’ll also make sure that you’re aware of the role requirements.

If successful, you will be invited to interview with two of our contact centre team leaders via video call. This will be a competency-based interview to find out more about your experience.

Once we have conducted interviews we will review applications and make offers to successful applicants.

More information for you….

We’re committed to providing reasonable adjustments or accommodations for applicants, so if you need assistance or support during the recruitment process, please let us know on the application form or by sending an email

If you’re made an offer of employment you’ll be required to prove your eligibility to work in the UK before you start work. You must reside in the UK from the start date of this role; unfortunately we are unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time.

To ensure you can work from home efficiently you will be asked to provide your internet speed at the application stage.

Premium Credit are an equal opportunities employer with a strong and passionate commitment to Diversity, Equality and Inclusion in the workplace. We welcome applications from all sections of the community and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. Equal opportunities are the only acceptable way to conduct business and we believe that the more inclusive our environments are, the better our work will be.

By submitting your application, you agree that Premium Credit may collect your personal data for recruiting and related purposes. PCL uses AI tools to assist with our review of applications, including to summarise CVs against relevant job criteria and transcribe interviews. However, our team always makes the final decision on any application. Please see our privacy notice () for further information on how we process your personal data during the application process.

All postholders will be subject to appropriate pre-employment vetting procedures and a satisfactory Disclosure & Barring Service (DBS) check prior to appointment.

So, if role appeals to you and you’re looking to join an industry-leading organisation, please apply.

Please note, we reserve the right to close this vacancy early if we identify a number of suitable candidates. All applicants will be advised if the vacancy closes early.

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$40,200.00 - $66,200.00

Target Openings

4

What Is the Opportunity?

Do you have a strong desire to help others? Can you provide a superior customer experience while maintaining a high level of professionalism and productivity? As the first contact for customers, agents, brokers and/or internal business partners, the Operations Customer Service team at Travelers play a key role in providing a positive experience. In the role of Customer Service Associate, you will handle a high volume of customer inquiries, primarily via inbound calls, in an accurate and efficient manner while demonstrating empathy and resolving their needs. As you expand your communication, technical, and business knowledge you will have the opportunity to grow your career at Travelers.

What Will You Do?

  • Successfully complete applicable new hire training.
  • Handle inbound inquiries from external customers and/or internal business partners via calls, emails, chats and/or other methods, taking the appropriate action, as needed. As you grow your knowledge and skills, you will increase the variety of interactions you are able to assist, which may include questions regarding quotes, policies, coverages, billing, audits, or application access/support.
  • Build and maintain customer satisfaction and trust by actively listening to inquiries and effectively applying learned product, systems, and business area knowledge to educate and respond to the customer accurately and efficiently.
  • Navigate multiple systems and platforms simultaneously while interacting with the customer.
  • Adapt and modify communication style to provide a positive, consistent, empathetic, and thorough customer experience.
  • Ensure accurate and comprehensive documentation of information, following the defined guidelines and procedures of the corresponding business area.
  • May support departmental projects and initiatives and take on other developmental opportunities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Schedule Details:

· During training for EST, your schedule will fall between the hours of 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. EST; Monday through Friday.

· During training for PST, your schedule will fall between the hours of 7:00 a.m. - 4:00 p.m. PST; Monday through Friday.

· After training hours will be 8:30 a.m. - 5:00 p.m. local time.

· Training will start February 2027.


Pay Details:

· This position offers a starting base salary of $48,500.

· Eligible for Full Benefits on day one of employment.

· Quarterly financial awards are offered, based on performance


What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Prior customer service experience.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly convey information to various audiences while showing empathy and understanding of the customer’s needs.
  • Proficiency utilizing technology, including the ability to navigate across multiple systems simultaneously.
  • Ability to analyze information and think critically to make informed decisions.
  • Organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle shifting priorities in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.
  • Flexibility and resiliency to navigate change.
  • Desire to continuously acquire new skills and knowledge.

What is a Must Have?

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish language.
  • Successful completion of applicable new hire training, and subsequently meeting minimum performance expectations, or 6 months of customer service or related experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.
