wo du mit anpacken kannst

  • Du agierst als das entscheidende Bindeglied zwischen unseren Code-Poeten aus der Entwicklung und dem IT-Betrieb, schlägst die perfekte Brücke im Maschinenraum und sorgst mit viel Herzblut dafür, dass aus frischen Codezeilen im Handumdrehen ein absolut stabiler, zuverlässiger Roll-out wird.
  • Du nimmst die Gestaltung, Automatisierung und Optimierung unserer Build-, Test- und Deployment-Prozesse eigenständig in die Hand und befeuerst unsere Release-Pipeline von der allerersten Code-Basis bis tief hinein in den Live-Betrieb.
  • Du erweckst unsere Container-Plattform zu echtem Höchstleben, entwickelst sie kontinuierlich weiter und gießt smarte Self-Service-Bausteine in Form, mit denen unsere Entwicklungsteams wie auf Schienen noch schneller, sicherer und völlig unbeschwert ausliefern können.
  • Du ziehst unsere Infrastruktur vollkommen reproduzierbar sowie automatisiert hoch, hegst und pflegst das technologische Fundament wie Dein eigenes Projekt und hältst den Kurs mit einer sauberen, glasklaren Dokumentation jederzeit transparent.
  • Du bringst Struktur und Harmonie in unsere Deployment- sowie Release-Abläufe, treibst die Automatisierung wiederkehrender Aufgaben mit sportlichem Ehrgeiz voran und lässt lästiger Routinearbeit absolut keine Chance.
  • Du genießt die absolute Freiheit eines 100-prozentigen Homeoffice-Setups von Deinem Lieblingsort aus, weshalb Dein Lebensmittelpunkt für unsere gemeinsame Reise keineswegs in Thüringen liegen muss.
  • Du gestaltest Deine Tage absolut selbstbestimmt, denn einer Teilzeitanstellung steht bei uns nichts im Wege, solange Du wöchentlich mindestens 30 Stunden Deiner wertvollen Zeit und Energie mit uns im Team teilst.

was du mitbringen solltest

  • Du bringst ein starkes Fundament durch ein technisches Studium, eine entsprechende Ausbildung oder handfeste, leidenschaftliche Praxis im IT-Umfeld mit, wobei sich mindestens 3 Jahre wertvolle Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung oder IT-Administration wie ein roter Faden durch Deinen Lebenslauf ziehen.
  • Moderne DevOps-Technologien sind Deine wahre Passion – bei Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, GitLab und Infrastruktur als Code (Terraform) fängt Dein Tech-Herz erst richtig an zu schlagen, und mindestens eine Skript- oder Programmiersprache (wie Python, Bash, Java oder Go) beherrschst Du absolut sicher.

Overview

The Lifeway Internship Program is a unique opportunity designed to provide college students and recent graduates with a valuable learning experience that fosters growth both professionally, personally, and spiritually. Our internships go far beyond "busy work"—you’ll engage in meaningful projects, gain hands-on experience, and be empowered to make an impact. Interns at Lifeway receive professional development, have opportunities for exposure to senior leaders, and benefit from mentoring relationships with experts in their chosen field.

Job Overview

Lifeway is seeking a summer software engineering intern to join the Lifeway On Demand team as a full-stack engineer with a backend focus. The intern will own a vertical slice of the work from start to finish, building backend services in Scala or Rust and the matching web, mobile, or TV front end, shipping production features, and working with AI-assisted development workflows.

Internship Program Details & Requirements

  • Compensation: Lifeway’s summer internship program offers a competitive hourly pay rate, and all necessary equipment is provided.
  • Work Schedule: Interns work an average of 32 hours per week, with core workdays from Tuesday to Thursday. The expectation is that the internship is the primary focus during working hours.
  • Program Duration: June 7 - August 11, 2027 (11 weeks). Interns must commit to participating in the entire program.
  • Eligibility: Candidates must be enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate program and have completed at least two years of study by the internship start date. Recent graduates (December 2026 or May 2027) are also eligible.
  • Development Opportunities: Weekly professional development sessions are provided, including specialized training, mentorship, and leadership development.
  • Remote Structure: This is a remote position in the U.S., with required in-person attendance for orientation (June 7 - 11, 2027) and end-of-summer presentations (August 9-11, 2027) in Nashville. Travel costs for these events are covered by Lifeway.
  • Application Deadline: Applications are due by December 31, with interviews beginning as soon as possible. Selections are finalized by April 1.

Explore our culture further at team.lifeway.com/culture-code

This is a remote position based in the contiguous 48 United States with occasional travel to Nashville for in-person team gatherings.

Responsibilities

  • Live out Lifeway’s mission and values, showing deep commitment to Kingdom work
  • Design, build, and test backend services and APIs in Scala or Rust
  • Build the matching front-end features in the Lifeway On Demand web, mobile (React Native), or TV apps
  • Own two or three features from scoping through release
  • Pair with team engineers and take part in code reviews
  • Join team ceremonies: standup, sprint planning, and retrospectives
  • Work with the team’s AI-assisted development workflows
  • Document the work and demo it to the team and stakeholders
  • Overnight travel for Orientation, and Final Presentation weeks

Education

Currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate program, or a recent graduate, in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field

Skills, Knowledge, & Experiences, required

  • At least one programming course completed (any language)
  • Eager to learn new languages and tools, including ones you haven't used before
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Clear written and verbal communication, and comfortable asking lots of questions

Actively involved in an evangelical Christian church

Skills, Knowledge, & Experiences, preferred

  • A personal, school, or open-source project
  • Experience with Git or another version control tool
  • Basic understanding of APIs, databases, or how web applications work
  • Experience with Scala, Rust, or functional programming
  • Experience with React or React Native
  • Experience using AI coding tools, such as Claude, Copilot, or Cursor

raw.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose: moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Proposal and Contract Manager to join our team. As a Senior Proposal and Contract Manager, you will manage the full proposal and contract process for clinical research clients, turning Requests for Proposal (RFPs) into client-ready budgets and contracts that set the foundation for successful studies. This client-facing position plays a key role in proposal accuracy, contract negotiation, and client satisfaction. It requires consistent management of proposal and contract processes from RFP receipt through client signature. You'll collaborate with Operations, Project Management, Legal, Business Development, and Finance teams, work with subject matter experts (SMEs), and follow established standard operating procedures (SOPs) to deliver high-quality work.


Responsibilities include overall accountability for the end-to-end RFP process and the negotiation and management of client contracts, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence client outcomes.

You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through strategic proposals, sound budgeting, and effective client negotiations. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Proposal and Contract Manager can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research.


Key Responsibilities

  • Hold overall accountability for the full RFP process, from receiving and analyzing RFP documentation, including study protocols or synopses, through to delivery, identifying and mitigating risks along the way.
  • Ensure the appropriate SMEs are assigned to and notified of each RFP and coordinate key strategic and operational areas throughout proposal preparation.
  • Prepare and modify strategic proposals and budgets in response to RFPs and revisions, based on SME feedback and proposal management input, ensuring alignment with client specifications, communications, and internal assumptions.
  • Manage the overall contract process for specific or varied accounts, coordinating Operations, Project Management, Legal Business Development, and Finance to prepare, review, and negotiate contracts in line with departmental SOPs and work instructions.
  • Develop account-specific contract standards, including budget presentation, payment terms, and standard contract language, and build contract strategies and plans for delivery and client signature.
  • Lead and facilitate client meetings to negotiate costs and terms by targeted client signature dates, providing formatted client grids that clearly explain the rationale for cost changes.
  • Amend project budgets in partnership with project and functional teams, using internal tools and reports to update client budgets.
  • Draft contract documents from Parexel templates, and identify and manage contractual issues that require finance, tax, or other stakeholder input, applying lessons learned to new contracts.
  • Obtain third-party quotes as needed and independently map client bid-grids to the pricing tool, keeping mapping references up to date.
  • Keep documents, files, and data current in the appropriate systems for metrics and key performance indicator (KPI) reporting, while meeting internal and external deadlines.
  • Serve as a resource and mentor for less experienced team members, aid colleagues as workload allows, and take part in process improvement initiatives, tool refreshes, and change champion activities.

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Strengths in proposal development, contract negotiation, and budgeting.
  • A strong understanding of clinical study operations across different regions of the world, ideally gained through industry experience.
  • The ability to collaborate across teams, communicate clearly, and escalate difficult situations appropriately.
  • A patient-focused mindset, strong attention to detail, and a sense of urgency.
  • Comfort working with pricing tools, Salesforce, and data systems.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Life Science, Business, or Languages, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 4-6 years of previous experience in project support, finance, contracting, or proposals in a Contract Research Organization (CRO) or similar environment.
  • Broad experience in proposals and contract management, including contractual terms, pricing structures, pricing tools, and data systems such as Salesforce.
  • Standard knowledge of managing client contract processes and accounts, including reporting.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of cash flow and revenue recognition.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of relevant software, including Windows, Word, Excel, Outlook, and databases.
  • Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to work irregular and/or extended hours as needed to meet client proposal deadlines.
  • Fluent in written and oral English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA
  • Experience with multinational and multicultural companies

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.


If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

We provide independent hospitals and health systems with the support, guidance and tech-enabled shared services needed to remain strong and viable. With a strong sense of purpose and commitment to operating excellence, we help rural healthcare providers fulfill their missions.


The Ovation Healthcare difference is the extraordinary combination of operations experience and consulting guidance that fulfills our mission of creating a sustainable future for healthcare organizations. Ovation Healthcare’s vision is to be a dynamic, integrated professional services company delivering innovative and executable solutions through experience and thought leadership, while valuing trust, respect, and customer focused behavior.


We’re looking for talented, motivated professionals with a desire to help independent hospitals thrive. Working with Ovation Healthcare, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with highly skilled subject matter specialists and operations executives, in a collegial atmosphere of professionalism and teamwork.


Ovation Healthcare’s corporate headquarters is located in Brentwood, TN. For more information, visit .


Summary:

Ovation Healthcare is seeking a Coding Auditor with at least three years of coding experience and one year of auditing experience. The Coding Auditor is responsible for performing coding reviews and documentation audits across multiple medical record types to ensure accuracy, compliance with regulations, and adherence to established coding guidelines. This role will identify and correct coding errors, evaluate documentation, and assist with educating coding staff, providers, and clinical teams to improve coding quality and efficiency.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Apply appropriate coding classification standards and guidelines to medical record documentation for accurate coding and documentation reviews.
  • Help create and review provider queries to resolve documentation discrepancies.
  • Support the manager with providing education regarding appropriate documentation and code applications.
  • Perform quality assessments of records, including verification of medical record documentation.
  • Review appropriate charges and make changes or recommendations based on the documentation.
  • Research errors or missing documentation from medical records to support accurate coding processes.
  • Assist with organizing and maintaining auditing logs for multiple clients and team members.
  • Create executive summaries based on audit findings, including recommendations for next steps.
  • Communicate effectively with executives, physicians, and members of the C-suite.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Must have facility, professional, and critical access auditing experience and ideally be exposed to observation hours, injections, and infusion code assignment.
  • Must be able to assist in educating coders, providers, and clinical staff.
  • Must be comfortable working with AR teams to resolve issues.
  • Must be able to pass a coding assessment.
  • Must be proficient in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Excel, and Teams.
  • Ability to multi-task and have excellent communication skills.
  • Must meet and maintain a 95% quality accuracy rate and productivity standards.
  • Must be able to apply official coding guidelines, NCCI edits, CPT Assistants, and Coding Clinics.
  • Must have experience working in a remote environment.

Work Experience, Education, and Certifications:

  • AHIMA/AAPC Credentials
  • One or more years of auditing experience
  • Three or more years of coding experience
  • CDI experience preferred

100% Remote

About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

This is a remote role. You can work from home and be located anywhere in Ireland or the United Kingdom

Canada : Hybrid if based in Ottawa. Remote for other locations in Canada

About the team

The Employee Relations Specialist, EMEA is responsible for providing expert employee relations support across the EMEA region. Acting as a trusted advisor to managers, HR Business Partners, Legal, and key stakeholders, this role manages complex employee relations matters, supports organizational change initiatives, and ensures compliance with local employment legislation and consultation requirements across multiple EMEA jurisdictions.

The successful candidate will bring significant employee relations experience supporting EMEA employees and leaders, including practical knowledge of employee representative structures, Works Councils, consultation obligations, and country-specific employment requirements. 

What you will do

  • Manage complex employee relations casework across EMEA, including performance management, probation reviews and extensions, disciplinary matters, grievances, investigations, and terminations. 
  • Provide coaching and guidance to managers on complex employee relations matters, employment legislation, global and local HR policies, and HR processes. 
  • Support managers in navigating sensitive employee matters, ensuring fair, consistent, and legally compliant outcomes. 
  • Conduct thorough, objective, and timely investigations into workplace concerns, policy violations, misconduct allegations, and employee complaints.
  • Support the establishment of and ongoing collaboration with employee representative bodies, including Works Councils. 
  • Manage consultation activities and ensure compliance with local statutory requirements and employee representative obligations. 
  • Conduct country-specific legal processes as required.
  • Guide leaders and employees through the accommodation process, ensuring equitable treatment and consistent application of policy and employment legislation.
  • Identify trends and themes across employee relations activity and escalate complex or high-risk matters as appropriate. 
  • Support organizational change initiatives, restructures, acquisitions, workforce reductions, and business transformation activities. 
  • Partner with Legal, HR Business Partners, and business leaders on complex employee relations matters. 
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of employee relations processes, documentation, manager capability, and best practices across EMEA. 

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Employment Relations, Labour Relations, or a related field. 
  • Minimum 5 years of Employee Relations experience supporting multiple EMEA countries. 
  • Demonstrated experience with Works Councils, employee representative bodies, and consultation processes. 
  • Experience managing EMEA-based investigations, disciplinary matters, grievances, performance management, probation management, and terminations. 
  • Strong knowledge of employment legislation and employee relations practices across EMEA jurisdictions. 
  • Experience supporting organizational change initiatives and restructures in EMEA. 
  • Experience partnering with Legal, HR Advisors/Business Partners, and leaders on complex employee relations matters.  
  • Ability to analyze data and trends to identify potential employee relations issues and develop proactive solutions.
  • Ability to build strong relationships with stakeholders at all levels within the organization.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively interact with employees, managers, and senior leadership.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced organization and manage multiple priorities
  • Ability to maintain a high level of discretion, confidentiality, and integrity
  • Ability to work effectively across multiple time zones and cultures.

Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Ameresco, Inc. (NYSE: AMRC) is a leading energy infrastructure company delivering integrated solutions that provide reliable power and modernize infrastructure. Since 2000, we have served as a trusted partner to public and private sector customers across North America, the UK and Europe, delivering over $15 billion in solutions and contracting more than 5 GW of energy resources.

At Ameresco, we integrate energy resources and modernize the built environment through innovative infrastructure solutions that improve reliability, optimize performance, strengthen resilience, and support long-term sustainability. Join us in building the infrastructure that powers the future. Explore opportunities to make a meaningful impact while growing your career with a company at the forefront of energy innovation.


Ameresco currently has an opportunity for Licensing & Compliance Analyst to join the Construction Services team. Reporting to the Operations Manager, this role will serve as the Construction Services business-unit liaison to the Corporate Licensing Department, coordinating licensing and registration needs associated with projects managed by the construction organization across multiple jurisdictions.


The analyst will serve as the business unit’s central point of coordination for licensing and registration matters, gathering information, communicating requirements, and facilitating timely support between the Corporate Licensing Department and stakeholders in Construction, Engineering, Legal, Contracts, Human Resources, Safety, and Business Development. This coordination will help address licensing requirements before project pursuit, contract execution, mobilization, and project completion.

Responsibilities:


  • Support the corporate licensing function by coordinating business-unit licensing needs across jurisdictions, including company, contractor, engineering, professional, trade, and business licenses.
  • Serve as the business-unit liaison to the corporate licensing team and third-party licensing consultant, providing information and coordinating applications, renewals, amendments, reinstatements, reciprocal licenses, foreign entity qualifications, annual reports, and registered-agent filings.
  • Support reviews of project opportunities and preconstruction activities by gathering jurisdiction-specific licensing and registration requirements and coordinating credential verification with the corporate licensing team before bid submission, contract execution, project mobilization, and regulated work.
  • Coordinate business-unit requests related to engineering firm registrations and Professional Engineer or responsible-engineer requirements with * Engineering leadership and the corporate licensing team.

Assist project teams by obtaining required licensing certificates, registrations, and supporting documentation from the corporate licensing team for clients and auditors.

  • Maintain business-unit licensing records and reports in alignment with corporate processes; serve as an administrator and member of the team supporting COMPASS, the subcontractor qualification platform; and communicate upcoming deadlines, regulatory changes, and potential impacts to relevant stakeholders.
  • Escalate identified licensing risks to the corporate licensing team and help coordinate business-unit actions needed to avoid delays, bid disqualification, penalties, stop-work orders, and other project disruptions.

* Perform other duties as assigned.


Minimum Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Construction Management, Engineering, Legal Studies, Public Administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in licensing, permitting, corporate compliance, construction, engineering, or contract administration, including multi-jurisdiction contractor, engineering, business, or corporate registrations.
  • Experience working with state licensing and engineering boards, municipalities, and other regulatory agencies.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and electronic document or compliance tracking systems.

Additional Qualifications:


  • Experience supporting licensing and engineering registrations in construction, EPC, renewable energy, utility, infrastructure, or engineering operations, including multi-state contractor licensing and engineering firm registrations.
  • Experience in paralegal, corporate compliance, regulatory affairs, licensing consulting, or licensing/compliance tracking software administration.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage compliance deadlines, detailed records, and concurrent priorities with a high degree of accuracy.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate across business functions.
  • Ability to research and interpret jurisdiction-specific licensing and registration requirements and translate them into practical project controls.

The anticipated base salary range for this role is $70,000 – $100,000 (presented in good faith). In addition to base pay, employees receive a comprehensive benefits package, such as health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off, and may be eligible for performance incentives, bonuses, commissions, or equity, depending on the role.


Actual pay will depend on factors such as internal equity, skills, experience, education, certifications, and location. This range supports our commitment to pay transparency and compliance with applicable laws. Compensation may vary by work location, including remote arrangements.


We disclose salary ranges and benefits in all required external and internal postings and will provide further details upon request at any stage of the hiring process. Applications are accepted on a rolling basis until the position is filled.


Ameresco challenges the brightest, most talented, and creative individuals in the industry by providing an environment that fosters initiative and achievement. We are proud of our comprehensive and competitive employee benefits, including people-oriented insurance, investment, and incentive plans.

All official communications from Ameresco will originate from an @ameresco.com email address. Any correspondence from other domains should be regarded as fraudulent. Please report any suspicious activity to the platform where the issue was encountered. For further inquiries or concerns, please contact us at 1-866-AMERESCO

The Opportunity:

The Sr.Tradeshow Specialist supports the Communications & Events organization as a member of the Tradeshow Center of Excellence, leading the strategy, planning, execution, and measurement of Avantor’s flagship tradeshows. The role combines strategic event leadership with hands-on operational excellence, driving brand awareness, customer engagement, lead generation, and measurable business impact across global markets. Working closely with commercial, product, marketing, digital, and executive stakeholders, the manager curates best-in-class tradeshow experiences while continuously improving processes, reporting, and standards of excellence.


How you will thrive and create an impact


  • Strategic Tradeshow Leadership: Develop recommendations for participation in global and flagship shows aligned to business objectives, customer engagement goals, and brand strategy.
  • Contract Negotiation & Sponsorships: Lead negotiation of exhibit space, sponsorship agreements, and event contracts to maximize value, visibility, and cost efficiencies.
  • Portfolio Management: Independently manage a portfolio of tradeshows while providing consultative oversight and governance for additional regional events.
  • Cross Functional Leadership: Coordinate planning efforts with Commercial, Product, Marketing, Digital, Communications, and external partners to ensure seamless execution aligned around consistent objectives and messaging.
  • Logistics & Operations: Oversee registration, housing, meeting space, shipping, show services, booth assets, hospitality, lead retrieval systems, and onsite execution.
  • Budget Ownership: Manage event budgets, forecasts, and expenditures with disciplined cost control and transparent stakeholder reporting.
  • Asset & Vendor Management: Direct external agencies, vendors, and logistics partners while ensuring booth assets, collateral, promotional items, and displays are available and maintained.
  • Performance Measurement & Reporting: Own post-event reporting, ROI analysis, lead metrics, executive summaries, attendee feedback, and strategic recommendations for future participation.
  • Process Excellence: Create and maintain project documentation, Teams channels, timelines, workstreams, and best-practice standards that improve organizational efficiency.
  • Relationship Management: Build trusted partnerships with organizers, sponsors, vendors, and internal stakeholders globally.

What we're looking for


Ideal Candidate

  • Creative and results-driven leader passionate about delivering elevated customer experiences and industry-leading programs.
  • Highly organized self-starter demonstrating accountability, ownership, and sound judgment across multiple concurrent projects.
  • Exceptional communicator with strong stakeholder management and influence skills in highly matrixed organizations.
  • Experienced in global, international, and domestic trade show environments with proven ability to manage complexity.
  • Skilled in continuous improvement, process optimization, and development of operational standards.
  • Proficient with Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, C4C, Cvent, and event measurement platforms such as iCapture

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • Minimum 5-7 years of progressive experience in trade show, events, marketing, communications, or related agency environments.
  • Demonstrated success leading end-to-end planning and execution of large-scale, third-party tradeshows .
  • Strong contract negotiation, budget management, reporting, and project management capabilities.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership within matrixed organizations.
  • Healthcare, biotech, pharmaceutical, or bioprocess industry experience preferred
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 20%.

raw.excerpt: Company Description Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society.
raw.description:
Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented, and results-driven OSP Closeout Package Quality Assurance (COP QA) Manager to lead our team responsible for reviewing, validating, and approving Outside Plant (OSP) project closeout packages prior to customer delivery.


The ideal candidate will provide leadership, technical oversight, and operational direction to a team of QA specialists responsible for ensuring closeout packages are complete, accurate, and compliant with company specifications, customer requirements, and established quality standards.


This role requires a strong understanding of OSP fiber optic construction, fiber optic testing, construction documentation, quality assurance processes, and team leadership. The manager will be responsible for driving review consistency, maintaining productivity and quality standards, identifying recurring deficiencies, and implementing corrective actions to improve the overall closeout process.


A critical component of this position is collaboration with OSP Project Managers (PMs) to communicate quality deficiencies, provide training and guidance, and improve the accuracy and completeness of initial package submissions.


The manager will also be responsible for developing, maintaining, and delivering daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports to track team performance, package review progress, quality trends, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Operational Management

  • Lead, manage, and develop the OSP Closeout Package Quality Assurance team responsible for reviewing and validating completed OSP project closeout packages prior to customer delivery.
  • Oversee daily QA operations, including workload distribution, review prioritization, resource allocation, and adherence to established turnaround times.
  • Establish clear performance expectations, productivity targets, and quality standards for QA team members.
  • Monitor individual and team performance to ensure consistent, accurate, and timely completion of closeout package reviews.
  • Provide technical leadership, coaching, mentoring, and ongoing training to QA specialists to promote accountability, consistency, and professional development.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex package deficiencies, technical discrepancies, and operational challenges.

Closeout Package Quality Assurance

  • Oversee the comprehensive review of OSP closeout packages to ensure all required documentation, testing results, construction records, and supporting materials meet company specifications and customer requirements.
  • Ensure the team validates the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of submitted documentation, including as-built drawings, fiber assignments, splice records, test results, network inventory records, and other required closeout deliverables.
  • Direct the review and validation of fiber optic test results, including OTDR, insertion loss, optical power meter, Fiber Inspection Probe (FIP), Chromatic Dispersion (CD), and Polarization Mode Dispersion (PMD) data, as applicable.
  • Ensure fiber optic testing documentation reflects appropriate testing methodologies, equipment settings, wavelengths, test durations, and acceptance criteria in accordance with engineering and contractual requirements.
  • Establish and maintain standardized QA checklists, review procedures, acceptance criteria, and documentation requirements.
  • Ensure package deficiencies are accurately documented, communicated, tracked, and resolved before final QA approval.
  • Maintain consistent quality standards across all reviewers to minimize discrepancies, rework, and customer rejections.
  • Ensure completed closeout packages meet internal acceptance requirements and are ready for customer submission.

Project Management Collaboration & Corrective Action

  • Partner closely with OSP Project Managers to identify, communicate, and resolve closeout package deficiencies and documentation discrepancies.
  • Provide clear, actionable feedback to Project Managers regarding rejected or incomplete submissions, including required corrections and expectations for resubmittal.
  • Identify recurring submission errors, documentation gaps, and process deficiencies across projects and individual Project Managers.
  • Develop and deliver targeted training, coaching, and corrective action initiatives to improve the quality and consistency of closeout package submissions.
  • Collaborate with OSP operations, engineering, construction, and project management leadership to address systemic quality issues and implement sustainable improvements.
  • Establish feedback mechanisms to reduce repeat deficiencies, improve first-pass acceptance rates, and minimize unnecessary review cycles.
  • Support Project Managers in understanding closeout requirements, internal specifications, and customer-specific acceptance criteria.
  • Escalate recurring or unresolved quality issues to appropriate leadership with recommended corrective actions.

Reporting, Metrics & Performance Management

  • Develop, maintain, and distribute daily, weekly, and monthly reports detailing QA team performance, closeout package review activity, quality metrics, and operational trends.
  • Track and report key performance indicators (KPIs), including:
  • Total closeout packages received, reviewed, approved, and rejected.
  • First-pass acceptance and rejection rates.
  • Package review turnaround times and aging.
  • Outstanding packages, backlog volume, and review status.
  • Rejection reasons, deficiency categories, and recurring quality issues.
  • Individual reviewer productivity and quality performance.
  • Project Manager submission quality and resubmittal trends.
  • Rework volume and repeat rejection rates.
  • Analyze performance data to identify bottlenecks, productivity challenges, and opportunities for operational improvement.
  • Develop and maintain reporting dashboards and tracking tools to provide leadership with visibility into QA operations and overall closeout package readiness.
  • Provide regular performance summaries to management, highlighting trends, risks, corrective actions, and improvement initiatives.
  • Utilize reporting data to establish performance benchmarks, measure process effectiveness, and support resource planning.
  • Process Improvement & Quality Compliance
  • Develop, document, and continuously improve QA processes, standard operating procedures (SOPs), review checklists, and acceptance workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline the closeout review process, reduce manual effort, and improve operational efficiency without compromising quality.
  • Implement quality control measures to ensure consistent application of internal specifications and customer requirements.
  • Perform periodic audits of completed QA reviews to verify reviewer accuracy, process compliance, and documentation quality.
  • Analyze rejection trends and root causes to develop corrective and preventive action plans.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve documentation standards, submission processes, and overall closeout package quality.
  • Ensure QA records, review histories, and supporting documentation are maintained in accordance with company standards and audit requirements.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on increasing first-pass acceptance rates, reducing review cycle times, and improving customer delivery readiness.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience in the telecommunications industry, with a strong background in Outside Plant (OSP) fiber optic construction, network documentation, quality assurance, or project management.
  • Demonstrated experience leading teams, managing operational workflows, or supervising quality assurance activities.
  • Strong understanding of OSP fiber optic construction processes, including fiber placement, splicing, testing, network documentation, and project closeout requirements.
  • Minimum of four (4) years of experience reviewing or analyzing fiber optic test results, including OTDR, OLTS, FIP, CD, and PMD, or equivalent relevant technical experience.
  • Ability to read, interpret, and validate OSP construction drawings, as-built documentation, splice diagrams, fiber assignments, and network records.
  • Experience reviewing technical documentation for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with established specifications.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify recurring quality issues, determine root causes, and implement corrective actions.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain operational reports, performance metrics, and KPI tracking.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and other business reporting and documentation tools.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to provide constructive feedback, facilitate training, and collaborate effectively with Project Managers and cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage competing priorities in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Ability to hold team members accountable for performance, quality standards, and established procedures.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Telecommunications, Construction Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Previous experience managing OSP closeout package reviews, construction documentation QA, or fiber optic test acceptance teams.
  • Familiarity with EXFO FastReporter, EXFO ConnectorMax, Viavi FiberCable2 Suite, Viavi FiberChekPRO, Anritsu NetWorks, and similar fiber optic test analysis platforms.
  • Experience with Google Earth, GIS-based mapping tools, network inventory systems, and OSP construction documentation platforms.
  • Experience developing dashboards, automated reports, or performance tracking tools using advanced Microsoft Excel, Power BI, or similar reporting applications.
  • Familiarity with structured cabling, optical transport systems, telecommunications network architectures, and applicable industry standards.
  • Experience developing training programs, standard operating procedures, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Working knowledge of customer-specific OSP closeout requirements, contractual acceptance standards, and construction quality processes.

Key Performance Expectations

  • Success in this position will be measured by the manager's ability to:
  • Maintain consistent, accurate, and timely QA reviews of OSP closeout packages.
  • Improve first-pass acceptance rates and reduce recurring deficiencies in Project Manager submissions.
  • Minimize QA backlog and maintain established package review turnaround times.
  • Improve team productivity, review consistency, and individual reviewer performance.
  • Deliver accurate, actionable daily, weekly, and monthly performance reporting.
  • Reduce customer rejections resulting from incomplete or inaccurate closeout documentation.
  • Implement effective training and corrective action programs that produce measurable improvements in submission quality.
  • Continuously improve QA workflows, operational efficiency, and overall closeout package readiness.

Estimated base salary range: $84,900 - $130,000 USD/annually.

raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Lead Product Owner is a senior product leader who serves as the product lead for a large, cross-functional patient experience initiative to reimagine how new patients are onboarded, from identification and scheduling through the early visits and the transition to ongoing care. Guided by the principle that earlier information enables earlier care, the role turns the vision into a prioritized product roadmap that improves patient engagement, provider preparedness, care continuity, and clinical documentation quality, accelerating clinical and financial value.

Operating with a high degree of autonomy, the Lead Product Owner partners with executive sponsors, business and clinical leaders, and workstream leads to deliver an initial MVP launch while continuing to advance the broader vision. The role helps keep shared documentation aligned with product decisions, guides technical and business decisions across engineering, data, design, and operations, and mentors Product Owners who support the initiative.

Responsibilities

  • Own the product vision, strategy, and integrated roadmap for the patient journey, sequencing the initial MVP and the fully reimagined journey across its stages, from identification through scheduling, initial visits, and the transition to ongoing care.
  • Translate journey design into epics, requirements, and complex user stories for capabilities such as care planning in the electronic medical record, pre-visit reporting, earlier records retrieval and gap identification, chart-prep triggers, upstream capture of critical patient information, forms and portal engagement, and earlier diagnostic screening workflows.
  • Prioritize across workstreams, making key decisions on value trade-offs, MVP scope, release sequencing, and dependencies, and drive resolution of open decisions such as patient identification criteria, clinical approvals, and opportunities to use technology to reduce provider administrative burden.
  • Partner with clinical operations, center and provider leadership, sales and growth, patient engagement, analytics, IT, compliance, engineering, and design to define role-based responsibilities, handoffs, and escalation paths, so every journey stage has accountable owners and closed-loop handoffs.
  • Establish and monitor shared success measures with analytics partners, such as time to first visit, pre-visit records capture, forms completion, task completion, timely documentation, and risk adjustment accuracy, and use them to drive continuous optimization.
  • Lead launch readiness and post-launch support for the MVP, including workflow validation with frontline teams, training and job aids, FAQs, decision and issue logs, escalation paths, hypercare, and ongoing refinement of the implementation roadmap.
  • Support the investment and value case for the journey, ensure regulatory alignment, and communicate progress, risks, and decisions to executive sponsors and senior leadership forums.
  • Provide leadership and representation, including mentoring Product Owners, shaping team culture, and participating in cross-enterprise initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Product Management, Health Informatics, Business), including experience leading enterprise-scale digital products.
  • 7+ years of product management (or related) experience, including 3+ years in a senior or lead role, ideally in digital health or virtual care.
  • Proven ability to define and deliver product roadmaps using Agile methodologies, including backlog management, sprint planning, and leading agile ceremonies.
  • Strong understanding of value-based care models, clinical workflows, and healthcare regulations.
  • Demonstrated success using data, user research, and clinical insights to guide product decisions, improve outcomes, and track key KPIs (e.g., roadmap delivery, feature adoption, NPS, care gap closure).
  • Excellent collaboration skills with clinicians, engineers, designers, and business stakeholders, and strong communication abilities to influence senior leadership and non-technical audiences.
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% within the U.S. to support product initiatives and stakeholder engagement.
  • Remote role; must be available to work normal business hours in Eastern Standard Time (EST).

  • Master’s degree in business administration, Health Informatics, Public Health, or a related field.

raw.description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Director, Consumer Pricing and Analytics


Labcorp is seeking a remote-based Director, Consumer Pricing and Analytics to join our team!


Responsibilities:

Pricing & Demand Modeling

  • Lead price elasticity, demand forecasting, and scenario modeling to inform pricing, promotional, subscription, bundling, margin, and portfolio decisions.
  • Evaluate pricing opportunities and risks by balancing consumer demand, competitive dynamics, and business objectives.
  • Establish pricing frameworks and governance that support profitable, data-driven decision making.

Customer Economics & Growth Performance

  • Develop customer lifetime value (LTV), cohort, and retention frameworks.
  • Analyze customer, transaction, and product performance to identify opportunities to improve conversion, average order value (AOV), and long-term customer value.
  • Partner with Marketing, Finance, Product, and Merchandising leaders to align growth strategies with financial outcomes.

Experimentation, Measurement & Performance Insights

  • Partner on testing and experimentation strategies for pricing, promotions, subscriptions, bundles, and customer offers.
  • Establish measurement methodologies and success metrics that quantify initiative performance and business impact.
  • Develop executive reporting and performance insights that provide visibility into pricing effectiveness, customer economics, and growth initiatives.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that enable continuous optimization and informed decision making.

Competitive & Market Intelligence

  • Lead competitive intelligence efforts across pricing, product assortment, promotions, industry trends, and competitors.
  • Monitor consumer and market trends to identify opportunities, risks, and shifts in competitive positioning.
  • Translate market intelligence into strategic insights that inform portfolio, pricing, and growth strategies.
  • Leverage AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics to scale competitive intelligence, identify emerging trends, and enhance predictive insights.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, or Mathematics.
  • 7 or more years of experience in pricing analytics, revenue management, customer economics, commercial analytics or business intelligence.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA).

Additional Job Standards:

  • Experience in healthcare, diagnostics, consumer health, or other highly regulated industries where pricing decisions must balance customer value, compliance, and business objectives.
  • Demonstrated success building pricing and analytics management capabilities from the ground up, including frameworks, governance, tools, and measurement approaches.
  • Experience leveraging AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics to improve forecasting, pricing decisions, competitive intelligence, and business performance.
  • Strong quantitative skills — comfort building pricing models, running elasticity analysis, and translating data into clear recommendations.
  • Experience supporting direct-to-consumer (DTC), ecommerce, marketplace, retail, and/or consumer-focused digital health businesses.
  • Experience supporting subscription-based products, membership programs, or recurring revenue businesses.
  • Demonstrated experience building and maintaining pricing optimization, price elasticity, demand forecasting, customer lifetime value, and scenario-planning models.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills with experience translating large datasets into actionable business recommendations.
  • Experience pricing products sold directly to consumers (as opposed to purely B2B or payer-negotiated pricing)
  • Track record of partnering cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Merchandising, and Finance
  • Advanced Excel/modeling skills; experience with pricing or BI tools (e.g., SQL, Looker, Tableau)
  • Excellent communication skills — able to present pricing recommendations to executives and translate strategy into simple, actionable guidance for go-to-market teams


About the Role

Labcorp OnDemand is a DTC consumer testing business growing rapidly within the expanding consumer health market.

As Director, Consumer Pricing & Analytics, you will play a foundational role in developing the models and insights that inform pricing decisions for direct-to-consumer diagnostic products in a market shaped by payer dynamics, out-of-pocket consumer spend, regulatory considerations, and competitive lab/testing offerings.

You'll build the pricing frameworks and governance that let the business grow profitably while staying accessible to the consumers we serve. This role is directly responsible for tying pricing decisions to business outcomes — including revenue growth targets, margin goals, customer acquisition cost (CAC) and lifetime value (LTV) improvement, and subscription growth.

The ideal candidate brings experience from a direct-to-consumer, e-commerce, subscription, marketplace, retail, and/or digital health consumer business and has a proven track record of translating complex data into actionable commercial recommendations.

This role is remote-based in the US.


Application Window: Application window will close on December 11, 2026.

Pay Range: $150,000 - $165,000 annually + annual bonus eligibility.

All job offers will be based on a candidate’s skills and prior relevant experience, applicable degrees/certifications, as well as internal equity and market data. The position is also eligible for an annual bonus under the Labcorp Bonus Plan. Bonuses are payable based on corporate and/or business segment performance and are subject to individual performance modifiers.

Benefits: Employees regularly scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week are eligible for comprehensive benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, STD/LTD, 401(k), Paid Time Off (PTO) or Flexible Time Off (FTO), Tuition Reimbursement and Employee Stock Purchase Plan.Employees regularly scheduled to work less than 20 hours, Casual, Intern, and Temporary employees are only eligible to participate in the 401(k) Plan.Employees who are regularly scheduled to work a 7 on/7 off schedule are eligible to receive all the foregoing benefits except PTO or FTO. Acid Recovery Application Engineer(chemical process engineer)

Location:Rochester, NY (Remote Work Potential)
Travel: Approximately 20-30%

Join a Global Leader in Process Systems Engineering

GMM Pfaudler is a leading supplier of highly engineered equipment and process systems serving the chemical, pharmaceutical, energy, and industrial markets. Our Systems Group designs and delivers custom process solutions including Acid Recovery, Evaporation, Distillation, Reactor, and Wiped Film Evaporation (WFE) systems for customers around the world.

GMM Pfaudler designs and builds Acid Recovery process systems which, through evaporation and distillation process steps, purify spent/waste acid from various chemical processes enabling customers to re-use the acids to reduce operating costs. As part of our strategic growth, we are expanding our Acid Recovery business in the United States. This role offers a unique opportunity to become a technical leader in a specialized and growing technology area while working closely with our global Acid Recovery Center of Excellence in Hofheim, Germany.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Chemical Process Engineer to support business development through the sale of Acid Recovery Systems throughout North America.

This role combines process engineering, customer engagement, and commercial sales. You will work directly with customers to understand their process requirements, develop preliminary process designs to meet customer needs, prepare project costs estimates and proposals, and negotiate contracts to secure new business.

The ideal candidate enjoys working directly with customers to understand their process needs, solving complex process challenges and transforming process data into practical, commercial-scale solutions, and securing contracts.

What You'll Do

Process Design & Application Engineering

  • Develop preliminary process designs for acid recovery systems based on customer requirements, pilot testing data, and historical system performance.
  • Collaborate with pilot test engineers to develop and execute testing programs and then utilize pilot plant and laboratory data to scale processes to commercial production systems.
  • Perform engineering calculations and complete mass and energy balances for system equipment sizing and select instrumentation necessary for process monitoring and control.

Customer & Sales Support

  • Review customer inquiries and identify technical and commercial requirements.
  • Serve as the customer’s technical resource throughout the sales cycle.
  • Present process solutions and system recommendations to customers.
  • Travel to customer sites to support business development through technical discussions, proposal reviews, and contract negotiations.

Proposal Development

  • Utilize in-house cost data and vendor quotations to develop system cost estimates.
  • Prepare budgetary and firm-price proposals that present GMM Pfaudler solutions and their technical and commercial value to customers.

Project Support

  • Review customer purchase orders and ensure alignment with proposal scope.
  • Support project handoff activities with project execution teams.
  • Provide technical guidance during early project execution phases.
  • Participate in post-project reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering (preferred) or Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry with sufficient system design/engineering experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of strong chemical process engineering experience; 8 – 15 years experience preferred.
  • Experience designing chemical process systems.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 20-30%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with evaporation and distillation systems.
  • Customer-facing technical sales experience.
  • Additional skills which are not required but considered a plus for a candidate
    • Acid recovery systems design or operation experience
    • Experience conducting or utilizing pilot plant testing.
    • Aspen Plus, Aspen Exchanger Design, or similar process simulation and equipment sizing software.

Why Join GMM Pfaudler?

  • Unique opportunity to become a U.S.-based expert in Acid Recovery technology.
  • Exposure to diverse process applications across chemical and industrial markets.
  • Direct interaction with customers and leadership throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Flexible work arrangements including remote work potential.
  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.

Benefits

Full-time employees are eligible for:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Life and Disability Insurance
  • 401(k) with Company Match and Safe Harbor Contribution
  • Paid Vacation and Holidays
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Professional Development Opportunities

It’s More Than a Career, It’s a Mission.

Our people are the foundation of our success. By joining our growing team at Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI), a subsidiary of McKesson, you will have the opportunity to become part of one of the largest community-based cancer programs to advance oncology treatments and improve outcomes for cancer patients across the globe. We look for mission-driven candidates who have a desire to advance the fight against cancer and make a difference in the lives of patients diagnosed with cancer every day.

Our Mission

People who live with cancer – those who work to prevent it, fight it, and survive it – are at the heart of every decision we make. Bringing the most innovative medical minds together with the most passionate caregivers in their communities, we are transforming care and personalizing treatment. Through clinical excellence and cutting-edge research, SCRI is redefining cancer care around the world.

Job Summary


Our Accounts Receivable Analyst is responsible for the reconciliation of client receivables in accordance with contractual agreements. Includes review of all Clinical Trial revenues and expenses, as well as interaction with various departments in order to determine the validity of charges and payments received from sponsors.


This is a remote position based in the US; relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not available.


Duties include and are not limited to:

  • Reconcile in detail clinical trial receivables to ensure final billing to pharmaceutical companies is accurate and timely
  • Reconcile Sarah Cannon financial study data across multiple sources.
  • Review and interpret contracts and budgets
  • Work with operations and other departments to resolve variances
  • Respond to requests for information from Corporate, Internal Audit, Operations and Management
  • Perform Analysis of contracted revenue triggers to determine eligibility for reimbursement.
  • Ensure that all processing and reporting deadlines are consistently achieved.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications include:

  • Bachelor's Degree required
  • 1-2 years' work experience in Accounting or Finance in a medical, clinical trial research or healthcare-related environment
  • Experience with Microsoft products including above average use of Excel and financial accounting systems such as Quickbooks.
  • Knowledge of research techniques to analyze and evaluate financial data and information.



About Sarah Cannon Research Institute

Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI) is one of the world’s leading oncology research organizations conducting community-based clinical trials. Focused on advancing therapies for patients over the last three decades, SCRI is a leader in drug development. In 2022, SCRI formed a joint venture with former US Oncology Research to expand clinical trial access across the country. It has conducted more than 850 first-in-human clinical trials since its inception and contributed to pivotal research that has led to the majority of new cancer therapies approved by the FDA in the past decade. SCRI’s research network brings together more than 1,300 physicians who are enrolling patients into clinical trials at more than 200 locations in 20+ states across the U.S. Please click here to learn more about our research offerings.

We care about the well-being of the patients and communities we serve, and that starts with caring for our people. That’s why we have a Total Rewards package that includes comprehensive benefits to support physical, mental, and financial well-being. Our Total Rewards offerings serve the different needs of our diverse colleague population and ensure they are the healthiest versions of themselves. For more information regarding benefits through our parent company, McKesson, please click here.

As part of Total Rewards, we are proud to offer a competitive compensation package. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered.

Job Description Summary

Job Title: Senior Clinical Research Associate (Sr. CRA)

(Field Based)

Primary Location: Southeast United States

Drive clinical trials forward where it matters most - at the site level and with patients at the center. As a Senior CRA at Novartis, you will manage trusted site relationships and perform on-site and remote monitoring activities to support the initiation, conduct, and timely completion of Phase I – IV trials in compliance with International Council for Harmonization / Good Clinical Practices (ICH/GCP), local regulations, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and monitoring procedures. Serving as a key point of contact for investigational sites, you will proactively manage site performance, recruitment, quality, risks, and issue resolution to ensure sustainable trial execution and high-quality data delivery. Assigned to complex trials and/or less experienced sites, you may also act as a Subject Matter Expert, support audit and inspection readiness activities, ensure timely implementation of corrective actions, and collaborate with local and global cross-functional teams to drive process improvements that help bring innovative therapies to patients faster.

This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager. This position will require 80% travel.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead assigned sites as the primary point of contact throughout study delivery
  • Build strong relationships to ensure site performance, quality, and milestone achievement
  • Manage Phase I to Phase IV trials per monitoring plans and company procedures
  • Conduct site initiation visits and deliver ongoing training for site personnel
  • Perform remote and on-site monitoring to ensure compliance and patient safety
  • Maintain accurate documentation and update all clinical systems in a timely manner
  • Identify risks, resolve issues, and escalate concerns as needed
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive efficient study execution
  • Support timely data query resolution and ensure data accuracy
  • Act as a subject matter expert across study activities when required

Essential Requirements

  • Minimum of three years of clinical site monitoring experience
  • Minimum of Bachelor’s degree in science, healthcare, or a related field
  • Strong understanding of clinical research and drug development processes
  • Knowledge of ICH/GCP and 21 CFR regulatory requirements
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently
  • Strong site management, communication, and problem-solving skills
  • Fluency in English, written and spoken, Spanish highly desired
  • Ability to drive and travel extensively, up to 80%, in a company vehicle

Desirable Requirements

  • Experience in multiple therapeutic areas and Veeva Vault CTMS is a plus
  • Advanced knowledge and use of AI

The salary for this position is expected to range between $108,500 and $201,500 per year.

The final salary offered is determined based on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. Novartis may change the published salary range based on company and market factors.

Your compensation will include a performance-based cash incentive and, depending on the level of the role, eligibility to be considered for annual equity awards.

US-based eligible employees will receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, life and disability benefits, a 401(k) with company contribution and match, and a variety of other benefits. In addition, employees are eligible for a generous time off package including vacation, personal days, holidays and other leaves.

EEO Statement:

The Novartis Group of Companies are Equal Opportunity Employers. We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Accessibility and reasonable accommodations

The Novartis Group of Companies are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or to perform the essential functions of a position, please send an e-mail to or call +1(877)395-2339 and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please include the job requisition number in your message.

Salary Range

$108,500.00 - $201,500.00

Clinical Research, Clinical Study Reports, Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS), Clinical Trials, Clinical Trials Monitoring, Collaboration, Data Integrity, Decision Making, Life Science

raw.description:
Do you want a job with a purpose?

And do you want to make healthcare safer, better and more reliable?

Join our Team!

Rejoignez-nous en tant que PRODUCT OWNER chez Dedalus, l'un des leaders mondiaux de l’édition de logiciel de santé, idéalement à Bordeaux ou en remote.

Ce que vous accomplirez

En tant que Product Owner AddOn, vous travaillerez au sein de l’équipe AddOn, sur le projet Transition U.

Le/la Product Owner AddOn contribue à la conception et à l'évolution des contenus fonctionnels standardisés de Care4U, adaptés aux spécificités du marché français. Il accompagne la transformation des pratiques métier et la transition vers la nouvelle génération de DPI Dedalus, en étroite collaboration avec les professionnels de santé, les équipes UX, les développeurs et les équipes produit.

Rejoignez-vous pour avoir un impact profond sur l’ensemble du secteur de la santé.

Vous aurez la responsabilité de :

  • Recueillir, analyser et formaliser les besoins métier des établissements de santé français, dans une logique de standardisation et de réutilisabilité des contenus.
  • Animer ou co-animer les ateliers de cadrage fonctionnel avec les professionnels de santé et les équipes internes.
  • Contribuer à la définition de la roadmap fonctionnelle et à la priorisation des développements AddOn, en cohérence avec la stratégie produit et les enjeux de la Transition U.
  • Concevoir les solutions fonctionnelles en collaboration avec les équipes UX et les développeurs, en privilégiant l'ergonomie, la simplicité d'utilisation et la pertinence métier.
  • Rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles, user stories et critères d'acceptation nécessaires aux développements.
  • Piloter et prioriser le backlog en lien avec le Manager AddOn, en tenant compte de la valeur métier, des besoins du marché, des contraintes techniques et de la capacité de l'équipe.
  • Participer activement aux cérémonies agiles et accompagner les développeurs tout au long du cycle de développement.
  • Assurer la validation fonctionnelle des développements et contribuer à la qualité des contenus livrés.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes R&D et Produit pour garantir la cohérence et la bonne intégration des contenus AddOn dans Care4U.
  • Recueillir et analyser les retours utilisateurs afin d'alimenter l'amélioration continue des solutions.

Faites un pas de plus vers la carrière de vos rêves

Chez Dedalus, la vie passe par nos logiciels. Chaque jour, nos actes contribuent à faciliter le quotidien des soignants et professionnels de la santé à fournir de meilleurs soins aux citoyens. Faites en sorte que la prochaine étape de votre carrière ait un impact profond. Voici ce dont vous aurez besoin pour réussir.

Exigences essentielles

  • Expérience significative dans le secteur de la santé et bonne compréhension des processus métier hospitaliers.
  • Expérience en analyse fonctionnelle, gestion de produit, conception de solutions logicielles ou projets informatiques en santé.
  • Bonne connaissance des systèmes d'information hospitaliers, idéalement des DPI.
  • Capacité à analyser, structurer et traduire des besoins métier en spécifications fonctionnelles.
  • Maîtrise des principes et pratiques de la méthodologie Agile.
  • Excellentes capacités de communication, de collaboration et de synthèse.
  • Autonomie, rigueur, sens de l'organisation et orientation utilisateur.

Exigences souhaitables

  • Formation initiale dans les métiers du soin (IDE, cadre de santé ou équivalent).
  • Expérience chez un éditeur de logiciels de santé ou dans un établissement hospitalier.
  • Connaissance des enjeux réglementaires et organisationnels du système de santé français.
  • Sensibilité aux enjeux d'ergonomie, d'expérience utilisateur et de conception de parcours de soins.
  • Connaissance des outils de gestion de backlog et de suivi des développements, notamment Jira.
  • Anglais professionnel.

Nous sommes Dedalus, rejoignez-nous

Dedalus s'engage à offrir une expérience de travail motivante et enrichissante qui reflète la passion de nos employés pour notre mission : faciliter le quotidien des soignants.

Notre entreprise favorise une culture où les employés sont encouragés à apprendre et innover, rendre possible et améliorer la coopération dans la santé, afin d’apporter des améliorations significatives pour des millions de personnes dans le monde.

Chaque collaborateur est le point de départ des activités du groupe, ainsi que le bénéficiaire final. C'est pour cela que nous sommes si fiers d'accomplir chaque jour notre travail.


Date de clôture des candidatures : 8 décembre 2026


Dedalus s’engage en matière de diversité et d'inclusion, afin de garantir le respect, l'inclusion et la réussite de tous nos collègues et des différentes communautés avec qui nous collaborons. Il est impératif pour nous de partager notre engagement et notre dévouement pour garantir un lieu de travail inclusif et varié. Nous reconnaissons que nous avons des progrès à faire, et pour ce futur, nous devons rester authentiques, réalistes, mais aussi ambitieux.


Our diversity & inclusion commitment – Dedalus Global

Life Flows Through Our Software
