Overview

Baker Tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast-to-coast and global advantage in major regions of the U.S. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – New York, London, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago and Boston. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP (Baker Tilly) provide professional services through an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable laws, regulations and professional standards. Baker Tilly US, LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities provide tax and business advisory services to their clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms.

Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP, trading as Baker Tilly, are independent members of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5.2 billion. Visit bakertilly.com or join the conversation on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram.

Please discuss the work location status with your Baker Tilly talent acquisition professional to understand the requirements for an opportunity you are exploring.

Baker Tilly is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.

Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.

Job Description:

Come join Baker Tilly's Development Advisory (DA) team as a Project Manager working on our Prevailing Wage & Apprenticeship compliance team. You will be a part of our larger Development Advisory team, which provides a variety of services including, but not limited to, energy and infrastructure advisory and project development support, economic development and capital planning support, and federal grant advisory with potential clients such as Tribes and Tribal Organizations, municipalities, non-profits, and other for-profit entities.


This position plays an integral part in Baker Tilly's services tied to the Inflation Reduction Act ("IRA") of 2022. We are seeking a professional with hands-on experience navigating California Department of Industrial Relations (DIR) compliance and prevailing wage regulations, including the operational requirements associated with certified payroll, apprenticeship compliance, and construction labor standards. This experience will be critical in supporting clients with federal Prevailing Wage and Apprenticeship (PWA) requirements under the IRA.


As one of the fastest growing firms in the nation, Baker Tilly offers upward career trajectory, flexibility in how and where you get your work done and meaningful relationships with clients, teammates and leadership who truly care about you and your development.


You will enjoy this role if:

  • You enjoy being in a project manager role helping internal and external stakeholders meet their collective goals.
  • You have an interest in energy incentives, construction labor compliance or the Inflation Reduction Act ("IRA") of 2022.
  • You have experience navigating prevailing wage regulations, including California DIR compliance requirements, and enjoy helping clients manage complex labor compliance obligations.
  • You crave an opportunity to work with a team of professionals that will challenge you mentally and provide an opportunity for tremendous growth.
  • You want to be part of a firm that is invested in your success by providing the resources and support to continually sharpen your project management and consulting skills and build your career now, for tomorrow.

What you will do:

  • Lead prevailing wage and apprenticeship compliance efforts for projects seeking IRA credits.
  • Leverage experience with California DIR prevailing wage and apprenticeship compliance requirements to support clients in meeting applicable federal PWA requirements under the IRA.
  • Oversee and review prevailing wage compliance documentation, including certified payroll records, wage classifications, apprenticeship participation, and related labor compliance reporting.
  • Identify potential compliance gaps and advise clients and contractors on corrective actions related to prevailing wage, apprenticeship utilization, and documentation requirements.
  • Facilitate client and contractor meetings, train stakeholders to utilize our compliance program, respond to questions and direct to appropriate team members, and provide direct assistance to project stakeholders.
  • Advise internal and external clients on meeting specific requirements related to prevailing wage and apprenticeship throughout the construction process.
  • Utilize your interpersonal communication skills to build and manage strong relationships with Baker Tilly colleagues and our clients.
  • Assist team leaders by documenting and analyzing processes, internal controls, and workflow to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Support project staff in day-to-day service delivery.
  • Learn and grow from direct on-the-job coaching and mentoring along with participating in firmwide learning and development programs.
  • Enjoy friendships, social activities and team outings that encourage a work-life balance.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 4-year degree
  • 5 years of professional experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, supply chain, engineering, construction management or a related field.
  • A minimum of five (5) years of progressive related consulting experience, including at least one (1) year serving as a project manager.
  • Hands-on experience with California Department of Industrial Relations (DIR) compliance, including prevailing wage requirements, certified payroll reporting, apprenticeship standards, and construction labor compliance.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret and apply prevailing wage and apprenticeship regulations, with an understanding of how state-level DIR compliance experience translates to federal PWA requirements under the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA).
  • Experience reviewing certified payroll records, identifying wage classification discrepancies, monitoring apprenticeship participation, and supporting compliance audits or reporting requirements.
  • Familiarity with federal prevailing wage requirements, including the Davis-Bacon Act and related labor standards, preferred.
  • Demonstrated management, analytical, organizational, interpersonal, project management, and communication skills, along with highly developed Microsoft Office skills (Word, Excel).
  • Ability to provide exceptional client service, demonstrate commitment to continuous learning to stay current regarding applicable strategies, see the "big picture" as well as the details, display appropriate ethical knowledge and commitment, and exhibit a sense of urgency and commitment to quality and the timely completion of duties.
  • Experience within the construction industry or construction labor compliance.

The pay range for this position is $66,000 to $182,200. This range represents a good-faith and reasonable estimate of the compensation the firm expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will depend on a variety of relevant factors, including an applicant's skills, experience, qualifications, professional certifications, work arrangements, geographic location, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range, and compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. Baker Tilly offers a compensation and benefits package to eligible employees.

raw.description:
About GlobalFoundries:

GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www.gf.com.


Summary of Role:

GlobalFoundries is seeking a Senior Analog Design Engineer to develop advanced analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits and reusable IP for emerging semiconductor applications, including cryogenic CMOS and quantum systems. This role will drive designs from circuit architecture through tapeout and silicon validation while partnering closely with technology, PDK, modeling, and test teams.


Essential Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop high-performance analog and mixed-signal CMOS circuits and reusable IP, including amplifiers, bias and reference circuits, regulators, data converters, oscillators, PLLs, clocking circuits, and drivers.
  • Own circuit development from architecture and transistor-level design through simulation, layout supervision, physical verification, tapeout, silicon characterization, and design-to-measurement correlation.
  • Perform comprehensive circuit analysis across process, voltage, and temperature, including Monte Carlo/mismatch, noise, stability, linearity, timing, and post-layout parasitic simulations.
  • Optimize circuit performance across operating temperature ranges, including cryogenic conditions, power constraints, process variation, device behavior, and layout-dependent effects.
  • Collaborate with device modeling and PDK teams to assess model accuracy, identify model or design-rule gaps, and provide circuit-level feedback supporting cryogenic and advanced PDK development and validation.
  • Drive analog layout requirements and reviews for device matching, common-centroid structures, shielding, isolation, parasitic management, signal integrity, power integrity, and design for manufacturability.
  • Define silicon test structures and characterization plans, analyze measured data, debug performance issues, and correlate hardware results with pre-silicon simulation and compact models.
  • Lead technical design reviews, document design methodology and results, mentor engineers, and collaborate with cross-functional internal and external teams to enable customer and technology solutions.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.

Required Qualifications:

  • Education - Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Computer Engineering, Applied Physics, or a related field.
  • Experience - Minimum 5 years of relevant analog or mixed-signal integrated circuit design experience.
  • Skills - Demonstrated experience taking analog or mixed-signal circuits through schematic design, simulation, layout, DRC/LVS, parasitic extraction, tapeout, and silicon validation.
  • Skills - Strong knowledge of CMOS analog design fundamentals, including device physics, noise, matching, feedback, stability, frequency response, process variation, and PVT/Monte Carlo analysis.
  • Skills - Proficiency with industry-standard analog IC design, SPICE simulation, layout, physical verification, and post-layout extraction environments.
  • Skills - Ability to independently analyze complex circuit and silicon performance issues and translate results into design improvements.

• Travel - Up to 10%.

  • Fluency in English Language - written & verbal.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Education - Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, or a related field.
  • Experience - Experience with cryogenic CMOS, low-temperature circuit design or characterization, quantum-control electronics, precision instrumentation, RF, or other advanced analog applications.
  • Skills - Familiarity with CMOS device behavior and compact-model limitations at cryogenic temperatures.
  • Skills - Experience designing advanced analog/mixed-signal blocks such as ADCs/DACs, PLLs, LNAs, VGAs, oscillators, voltage/current references, LDOs, or high-speed drivers.
  • Skills - Experience with silicon characterization and correlation of measured results to simulation, including interactions with device modeling, PDK, process technology, or test teams.
  • Skills - Familiarity with design or characterization automation using Python, SKILL, Tcl, or equivalent scripting languages.
  • Project management skills - i.e., the ability to innovate and execute on solutions that matter; the ability to navigate ambiguity.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong planning & organizational skills.

$118,000.00 - $247,000.00

The exact Salary will be determined based on qualifications, experience and location.

raw.description:
About Us

We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead. 

Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!


Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Firmware Engineering Manager to lead our embedded systems team with a dedicated focus on technical execution and regulatory alignment under the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA). In this role, you will lead a team of firmware engineers owning existing and new secure, scalable IoT products while ensuring our entire embedded architecture and software development lifecycle (SDLC) meet mandatory EU cybersecurity requirements.


You will bridge the gap between low-level firmware development, security architecture, and regulatory compliance—ensuring our devices are secure by design, maintain continuous vulnerability management, and support robust over-the-air (OTA) updates throughout their support lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & CRA Implementation

  • Secure Architecture: Drive the design and implementation of firmware security controls aligned with CRA standards (e.g., ETSI EN 303 645, IEC 62443, ISO 27001), enforcing Hardware Root of Trust, Secure Boot, encrypted memory partitions, and secure key storage.
  • Automated SBOM & Dependency Management: Establish automated generation and maintenance of Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) (e.g., CycloneDX, SPDX) within build pipelines to maintain component transparency and track open-source dependencies.
  • Over-the-Air (OTA) & Patch Management: Direct the development of secure, cryptographically signed, and resilient OTA update mechanisms capable of delivering rapid security patches without bricking devices in the field.
  • Vulnerability & Incident Management: Implement processes to meet CRA reporting mandates—including 24-hour initial vulnerability alert capabilities, 72-hour notifications, and rapid patch deployment workflows.
  • Conformity & Technical Documentation: Oversee technical file generation, risk assessments, and compliance testing required for CRA CE marking and third-party conformity audits.

People & Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of embedded firmware engineers, fostering a culture prioritizing security-by-design and security-by-default principles.
  • Balance feature delivery roadmaps with compliance deadlines, security debt reduction, and refactoring efforts.
  • Conduct code reviews, establish secure coding standards (MISRA, CERT C), and integrate SAST/DAST/fuzz testing tools into CI/CD build environments.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product Management, Hardware Design, Legal/Compliance, and Cloud IoT teams to align hardware selection (e.g., Secure Elements, TPMs) with security standards.
  • Serve as the technical point of contact for external auditors, compliance bodies, and security researchers conducting vulnerability assessments or penetration testing.

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience:
    • 8+ years of experience in embedded firmware development (C/C++, RTOS, bare-metal, or Embedded Linux), preferably for IoT devices.
    • 3+ years of experience in an engineering management, tech lead, or supervisory role.
    • Demonstrated experience implementing firmware security primitives: Secure Boot, cryptographic hardware (HSM, TPM, Secure Elements), TLS/mTLS, memory protection, and secure storage.
    • Authorization to work in the United States - sponsorship will not be provided for this role. Temporary visas such as F1 (OPT & STEM), H1, L, B, J, or TN are not eligible.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on knowledge of hardware/software security frameworks and regulatory compliance standards (e.g., EU Cyber Resilience Act, ETSI EN 303 645, NIST SP 800-213, IEC 62443).
  • Experience establishing automated SBOM pipelines and vulnerability scanning (e.g., CVE mapping).
  • Deep experience with microcontroller architectures (ARM Cortex-M/TrustZone, RISC-V, ESP32) and wireless protocols (BLE, Wi-Fi, Cellular IoT, Thread/Matter).
  • Knowledge of global IoT cybersecurity legislation beyond the EU (e.g., US Cyber Trust Mark, UK PSTI Act).
  • Active cybersecurity certification (e.g., CISSP, CSSLP, or CISM).

Pay Transparency: $95,500 - $171,900 USD Annually




Our Commitment to Our People

Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.

Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal - to make the world a better place. We invest in the end-to-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally.

Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs: medical insurance plans, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) and more. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave, vacation and holiday leave. 

Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team!

Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland.

raw.title: Graphic Designer (Fully Remote)
raw.excerpt: Metricool is a social media management tool that helps freelancers, agencies, and marketing teams stay on top of their daily work.
raw.description:
Metricool is a social media management tool that helps freelancers, agencies, and marketing teams stay on top of their daily work. Behind every calendar, report, and post, there’s someone juggling deadlines and trying to make sense of their numbers—and our job is to make that work clearer and calmer.

As a Graphic Designer on our Content team, you’ll report to the Content Team Manager and work closely with the people leading Social, YouTube, Lead Magnets, and Emails. Your mission will be to bring design into the process from the very start. You’ll join at the brief, propose formats, push back when something doesn’t add up, and review performance data to see what actually worked. When a format proves itself, you’ll turn it into a reusable template for the rest of the team.

You’ll work 100% remotely as part of an international team publishing in four languages, where good design means clear hierarchy, clean data, and visuals that earn attention without shouting.

Your day-to-day

The design team shares this work and splits it by project:

  • Design for social across four markets.You’ll create static posts and carousels for Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, X, and Pinterest in English, Spanish, German and French, adapting to each platform and market. The copy comes from the Social team, so you don’t need to speak all four languages.

  • Make thumbnails that earn the click. You’ll design YouTube thumbnails and run A/B tests on key videos to learn what resonates with our audience.

  • Turn complex data into clear layouts. You’ll design industry reports, templates, and guides so readers can grasp the numbers at a glance.

  • Design the landing pages for our resources.You’ll design the pages behind our resource downloads, focusing on clarity and visual flow.

  • Maintain and evolve our design system. Alongside the rest of the design team, you’ll update Content’s templates, components, and usage rules.

  • Iterate based on results. You’ll review how your pieces perform with each channel lead and adjust your approach based on real numbers.

What we’re looking for

  • Design that starts with a "why".Before opening Figma, you ask what the piece is meant to achieve. You can explain the reasoning behind your layout and typography choices, and your portfolio reflects that.

  • An eye on performance. You look at clicks, saves, and downloads, draw your own conclusions, and apply them to your next piece. Experience running A/B tests or design experiments is a plus.

  • 3+ years in digital and social design.You understand how different platforms behave and have designed social posts, thumbnails, and landing pages.

  • Strong editorial and data skills. You’ve laid out multi-page documents like reports and know how to use typography, hierarchy, and charts to make information easy to scan.

  • Fluency in Figma. Components, auto layout, and shared libraries are part of your daily workflow.

  • Systems thinking. You’ve built and documented design systems that non-designers can use without breaking brand consistency. Experience with AI-assisted design workflows is a plus.

  • Versatility.A YouTube thumbnail, an Instagram carousel, and a 40-page report each require a different approach, and you adapt easily between them. Motion design basics are a bonus.

  • Comfort with open briefs. You don’t need every detail locked down before starting. You propose ideas, iterate quickly, and speak up when a brief feels off.

  • Openness to feedback. You see feedback as a way to make the work better. You share early drafts, welcome other points of view and give your own with care.

  • Organization and autonomy.You can juggle multiple channels and markets at once while keeping your files and process clean.

  • Spanish and advanced English. German or French is a big plus.

What your first months will look like

  • Month 1: You’ll get familiar with our brand identity, our design system, and the reasoning behind it, along with each channel’s goals and market nuances. You’ll start designing social posts and thumbnails with regular team reviews.

  • Month 3: You’ll own social posts and thumbnails across all four markets, lay out your first report and landing page, and start suggesting improvements based on performance data.

  • Month 12:You’ll co-own the design system with the design team, with recurring formats documented and running smoothly across Social and our AI workflows. You’ll be running thumbnail and landing page tests, hitting launch timelines reliably, and shaping format decisions with every channel lead.

Why you’ll love working at Metricool

  • 100% Remote:Work from home with the equipment you need to do your job comfortably.

  • Flexible Schedule: We trust you to organize your own day around your life, staying available during core hours to collaborate with the team.

  • Health Insurance:Comprehensive coverage so you can work with peace of mind.

  • Language Lessons: Support to learn or improve a language and connect more easily with teammates across markets.

  • Learning Platform:Full access to Udemy courses so you can keep exploring whatever sparks your curiosity.

  • The Epic Weekend: Once a year, the whole company meets in person to disconnect, catch up, and celebrate the work we’ve done together.

  • Salary: €26,000 – €35,000 gross per year, under the Spanish collective agreement for consulting, IT, and market and public opinion research companies (Convenio colectivo de empresas de consultoría, tecnologías de la información y estudios de mercado y de la opinión pública).

  • Room to grow:We’re scaling fast, and if you take ownership of your work, you’ll have plenty of space to shape your role.

The Process

  • 30-minute call with Sofía, People & Culture Specialist, to chat about your background, how we work, and your English level.

  • Portfolio review with Ana, Content Team Manager, and Andrea, Graphic Designer, to walk through your projects and how you make design decisions.

If you want to design work that helps thousands of social media professionals every day, send us your CV and portfolio.

raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Lead Product Owner is a senior product leader who serves as the product lead for a large, cross-functional patient experience initiative to reimagine how new patients are onboarded, from identification and scheduling through the early visits and the transition to ongoing care. Guided by the principle that earlier information enables earlier care, the role turns the vision into a prioritized product roadmap that improves patient engagement, provider preparedness, care continuity, and clinical documentation quality, accelerating clinical and financial value.

Operating with a high degree of autonomy, the Lead Product Owner partners with executive sponsors, business and clinical leaders, and workstream leads to deliver an initial MVP launch while continuing to advance the broader vision. The role helps keep shared documentation aligned with product decisions, guides technical and business decisions across engineering, data, design, and operations, and mentors Product Owners who support the initiative.

Responsibilities

  • Own the product vision, strategy, and integrated roadmap for the patient journey, sequencing the initial MVP and the fully reimagined journey across its stages, from identification through scheduling, initial visits, and the transition to ongoing care.
  • Translate journey design into epics, requirements, and complex user stories for capabilities such as care planning in the electronic medical record, pre-visit reporting, earlier records retrieval and gap identification, chart-prep triggers, upstream capture of critical patient information, forms and portal engagement, and earlier diagnostic screening workflows.
  • Prioritize across workstreams, making key decisions on value trade-offs, MVP scope, release sequencing, and dependencies, and drive resolution of open decisions such as patient identification criteria, clinical approvals, and opportunities to use technology to reduce provider administrative burden.
  • Partner with clinical operations, center and provider leadership, sales and growth, patient engagement, analytics, IT, compliance, engineering, and design to define role-based responsibilities, handoffs, and escalation paths, so every journey stage has accountable owners and closed-loop handoffs.
  • Establish and monitor shared success measures with analytics partners, such as time to first visit, pre-visit records capture, forms completion, task completion, timely documentation, and risk adjustment accuracy, and use them to drive continuous optimization.
  • Lead launch readiness and post-launch support for the MVP, including workflow validation with frontline teams, training and job aids, FAQs, decision and issue logs, escalation paths, hypercare, and ongoing refinement of the implementation roadmap.
  • Support the investment and value case for the journey, ensure regulatory alignment, and communicate progress, risks, and decisions to executive sponsors and senior leadership forums.
  • Provide leadership and representation, including mentoring Product Owners, shaping team culture, and participating in cross-enterprise initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Product Management, Health Informatics, Business), including experience leading enterprise-scale digital products.
  • 7+ years of product management (or related) experience, including 3+ years in a senior or lead role, ideally in digital health or virtual care.
  • Proven ability to define and deliver product roadmaps using Agile methodologies, including backlog management, sprint planning, and leading agile ceremonies.
  • Strong understanding of value-based care models, clinical workflows, and healthcare regulations.
  • Demonstrated success using data, user research, and clinical insights to guide product decisions, improve outcomes, and track key KPIs (e.g., roadmap delivery, feature adoption, NPS, care gap closure).
  • Excellent collaboration skills with clinicians, engineers, designers, and business stakeholders, and strong communication abilities to influence senior leadership and non-technical audiences.
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% within the U.S. to support product initiatives and stakeholder engagement.
  • Remote role; must be available to work normal business hours in Eastern Standard Time (EST).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in business administration, Health Informatics, Public Health, or a related field.
  • Experience in senior-focused or Medicare Advantage care models, especially within virtual or hybrid care delivery systems.
  • Certification in Agile or Product Management, such as Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, or Pragmatic Institute certification.

Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Director, Consumer Pricing and Analytics


Labcorp is seeking a remote-based Director, Consumer Pricing and Analytics to join our team!


Responsibilities:

Pricing & Demand Modeling

  • Lead price elasticity, demand forecasting, and scenario modeling to inform pricing, promotional, subscription, bundling, margin, and portfolio decisions.
  • Evaluate pricing opportunities and risks by balancing consumer demand, competitive dynamics, and business objectives.
  • Establish pricing frameworks and governance that support profitable, data-driven decision making.

Customer Economics & Growth Performance

  • Develop customer lifetime value (LTV), cohort, and retention frameworks.
  • Analyze customer, transaction, and product performance to identify opportunities to improve conversion, average order value (AOV), and long-term customer value.
  • Partner with Marketing, Finance, Product, and Merchandising leaders to align growth strategies with financial outcomes.

Experimentation, Measurement & Performance Insights

  • Partner on testing and experimentation strategies for pricing, promotions, subscriptions, bundles, and customer offers.
  • Establish measurement methodologies and success metrics that quantify initiative performance and business impact.
  • Develop executive reporting and performance insights that provide visibility into pricing effectiveness, customer economics, and growth initiatives.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that enable continuous optimization and informed decision making.

Competitive & Market Intelligence

  • Lead competitive intelligence efforts across pricing, product assortment, promotions, industry trends, and competitors.
  • Monitor consumer and market trends to identify opportunities, risks, and shifts in competitive positioning.
  • Translate market intelligence into strategic insights that inform portfolio, pricing, and growth strategies.
  • Leverage AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics to scale competitive intelligence, identify emerging trends, and enhance predictive insights.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, or Mathematics.
  • 7 or more years of experience in pricing analytics, revenue management, customer economics, commercial analytics or business intelligence.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA).

Additional Job Standards:

  • Experience in healthcare, diagnostics, consumer health, or other highly regulated industries where pricing decisions must balance customer value, compliance, and business objectives.
  • Demonstrated success building pricing and analytics management capabilities from the ground up, including frameworks, governance, tools, and measurement approaches.
  • Experience leveraging AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics to improve forecasting, pricing decisions, competitive intelligence, and business performance.
  • Strong quantitative skills — comfort building pricing models, running elasticity analysis, and translating data into clear recommendations.
  • Experience supporting direct-to-consumer (DTC), ecommerce, marketplace, retail, and/or consumer-focused digital health businesses.
  • Experience supporting subscription-based products, membership programs, or recurring revenue businesses.
  • Demonstrated experience building and maintaining pricing optimization, price elasticity, demand forecasting, customer lifetime value, and scenario-planning models.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills with experience translating large datasets into actionable business recommendations.
  • Experience pricing products sold directly to consumers (as opposed to purely B2B or payer-negotiated pricing)
  • Track record of partnering cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Merchandising, and Finance
  • Advanced Excel/modeling skills; experience with pricing or BI tools (e.g., SQL, Looker, Tableau)
  • Excellent communication skills — able to present pricing recommendations to executives and translate strategy into simple, actionable guidance for go-to-market teams


About the Role

Labcorp OnDemand is a DTC consumer testing business growing rapidly within the expanding consumer health market.

As Director, Consumer Pricing & Analytics, you will play a foundational role in developing the models and insights that inform pricing decisions for direct-to-consumer diagnostic products in a market shaped by payer dynamics, out-of-pocket consumer spend, regulatory considerations, and competitive lab/testing offerings.

You'll build the pricing frameworks and governance that let the business grow profitably while staying accessible to the consumers we serve. This role is directly responsible for tying pricing decisions to business outcomes — including revenue growth targets, margin goals, customer acquisition cost (CAC) and lifetime value (LTV) improvement, and subscription growth.

The ideal candidate brings experience from a direct-to-consumer, e-commerce, subscription, marketplace, retail, and/or digital health consumer business and has a proven track record of translating complex data into actionable commercial recommendations.

This role is remote-based in the US.

Acid Recovery Application Engineer(chemical process engineer)

Location:Rochester, NY (Remote Work Potential)
Travel: Approximately 20-30%

Join a Global Leader in Process Systems Engineering

GMM Pfaudler is a leading supplier of highly engineered equipment and process systems serving the chemical, pharmaceutical, energy, and industrial markets. Our Systems Group designs and delivers custom process solutions including Acid Recovery, Evaporation, Distillation, Reactor, and Wiped Film Evaporation (WFE) systems for customers around the world.

GMM Pfaudler designs and builds Acid Recovery process systems which, through evaporation and distillation process steps, purify spent/waste acid from various chemical processes enabling customers to re-use the acids to reduce operating costs. As part of our strategic growth, we are expanding our Acid Recovery business in the United States. This role offers a unique opportunity to become a technical leader in a specialized and growing technology area while working closely with our global Acid Recovery Center of Excellence in Hofheim, Germany.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Chemical Process Engineer to support business development through the sale of Acid Recovery Systems throughout North America.

This role combines process engineering, customer engagement, and commercial sales. You will work directly with customers to understand their process requirements, develop preliminary process designs to meet customer needs, prepare project costs estimates and proposals, and negotiate contracts to secure new business.

The ideal candidate enjoys working directly with customers to understand their process needs, solving complex process challenges and transforming process data into practical, commercial-scale solutions, and securing contracts.

What You'll Do

Process Design & Application Engineering

  • Develop preliminary process designs for acid recovery systems based on customer requirements, pilot testing data, and historical system performance.
  • Collaborate with pilot test engineers to develop and execute testing programs and then utilize pilot plant and laboratory data to scale processes to commercial production systems.
  • Perform engineering calculations and complete mass and energy balances for system equipment sizing and select instrumentation necessary for process monitoring and control.

Customer & Sales Support

  • Review customer inquiries and identify technical and commercial requirements.
  • Serve as the customer’s technical resource throughout the sales cycle.
  • Present process solutions and system recommendations to customers.
  • Travel to customer sites to support business development through technical discussions, proposal reviews, and contract negotiations.

Proposal Development

  • Utilize in-house cost data and vendor quotations to develop system cost estimates.
  • Prepare budgetary and firm-price proposals that present GMM Pfaudler solutions and their technical and commercial value to customers.

Project Support

  • Review customer purchase orders and ensure alignment with proposal scope.
  • Support project handoff activities with project execution teams.
  • Provide technical guidance during early project execution phases.
  • Participate in post-project reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering (preferred) or Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry with sufficient system design/engineering experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of strong chemical process engineering experience; 8 – 15 years experience preferred.
  • Experience designing chemical process systems.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 20-30%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with evaporation and distillation systems.
  • Customer-facing technical sales experience.
  • Additional skills which are not required but considered a plus for a candidate
    • Acid recovery systems design or operation experience
    • Experience conducting or utilizing pilot plant testing.
    • Aspen Plus, Aspen Exchanger Design, or similar process simulation and equipment sizing software.

Why Join GMM Pfaudler?

  • Unique opportunity to become a U.S.-based expert in Acid Recovery technology.
  • Exposure to diverse process applications across chemical and industrial markets.
  • Direct interaction with customers and leadership throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Flexible work arrangements including remote work potential.
  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.

Benefits

Full-time employees are eligible for:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Life and Disability Insurance
  • 401(k) with Company Match and Safe Harbor Contribution
  • Paid Vacation and Holidays
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Professional Development Opportunities

It’s More Than a Career, It’s a Mission.

Our people are the foundation of our success. By joining our growing team at Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI), a subsidiary of McKesson, you will have the opportunity to become part of one of the largest community-based cancer programs to advance oncology treatments and improve outcomes for cancer patients across the globe. We look for mission-driven candidates who have a desire to advance the fight against cancer and make a difference in the lives of patients diagnosed with cancer every day.

Our Mission

People who live with cancer – those who work to prevent it, fight it, and survive it – are at the heart of every decision we make. Bringing the most innovative medical minds together with the most passionate caregivers in their communities, we are transforming care and personalizing treatment. Through clinical excellence and cutting-edge research, SCRI is redefining cancer care around the world.

Job Summary


Our Accounts Receivable Analyst is responsible for the reconciliation of client receivables in accordance with contractual agreements. Includes review of all Clinical Trial revenues and expenses, as well as interaction with various departments in order to determine the validity of charges and payments received from sponsors.


This is a remote position based in the US; relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not available.


Duties include and are not limited to:

  • Reconcile in detail clinical trial receivables to ensure final billing to pharmaceutical companies is accurate and timely
  • Reconcile Sarah Cannon financial study data across multiple sources.
  • Review and interpret contracts and budgets
  • Work with operations and other departments to resolve variances
  • Respond to requests for information from Corporate, Internal Audit, Operations and Management
  • Perform Analysis of contracted revenue triggers to determine eligibility for reimbursement.
  • Ensure that all processing and reporting deadlines are consistently achieved.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications include:

  • Bachelor's Degree required
  • 1-2 years' work experience in Accounting or Finance in a medical, clinical trial research or healthcare-related environment
  • Experience with Microsoft products including above average use of Excel and financial accounting systems such as Quickbooks.
  • Knowledge of research techniques to analyze and evaluate financial data and information.



About Sarah Cannon Research Institute

Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI) is one of the world’s leading oncology research organizations conducting community-based clinical trials. Focused on advancing therapies for patients over the last three decades, SCRI is a leader in drug development. In 2022, SCRI formed a joint venture with former US Oncology Research to expand clinical trial access across the country. It has conducted more than 850 first-in-human clinical trials since its inception and contributed to pivotal research that has led to the majority of new cancer therapies approved by the FDA in the past decade. SCRI’s research network brings together more than 1,300 physicians who are enrolling patients into clinical trials at more than 200 locations in 20+ states across the U.S. Please click here to learn more about our research offerings.

We care about the well-being of the patients and communities we serve, and that starts with caring for our people. That’s why we have a Total Rewards package that includes comprehensive benefits to support physical, mental, and financial well-being. Our Total Rewards offerings serve the different needs of our diverse colleague population and ensure they are the healthiest versions of themselves. For more information regarding benefits through our parent company, McKesson, please click here.

As part of Total Rewards, we are proud to offer a competitive compensation package. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered.

Job Description Summary

Job Title: Senior Clinical Research Associate (Sr. CRA)

(Field Based)

Primary Location: Southeast United States

Drive clinical trials forward where it matters most - at the site level and with patients at the center. As a Senior CRA at Novartis, you will manage trusted site relationships and perform on-site and remote monitoring activities to support the initiation, conduct, and timely completion of Phase I – IV trials in compliance with International Council for Harmonization / Good Clinical Practices (ICH/GCP), local regulations, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and monitoring procedures. Serving as a key point of contact for investigational sites, you will proactively manage site performance, recruitment, quality, risks, and issue resolution to ensure sustainable trial execution and high-quality data delivery. Assigned to complex trials and/or less experienced sites, you may also act as a Subject Matter Expert, support audit and inspection readiness activities, ensure timely implementation of corrective actions, and collaborate with local and global cross-functional teams to drive process improvements that help bring innovative therapies to patients faster.

This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager. This position will require 80% travel.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead assigned sites as the primary point of contact throughout study delivery
  • Build strong relationships to ensure site performance, quality, and milestone achievement
  • Manage Phase I to Phase IV trials per monitoring plans and company procedures
  • Conduct site initiation visits and deliver ongoing training for site personnel
  • Perform remote and on-site monitoring to ensure compliance and patient safety
  • Maintain accurate documentation and update all clinical systems in a timely manner
  • Identify risks, resolve issues, and escalate concerns as needed
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive efficient study execution
  • Support timely data query resolution and ensure data accuracy
  • Act as a subject matter expert across study activities when required

Essential Requirements

  • Minimum of three years of clinical site monitoring experience
  • Minimum of Bachelor’s degree in science, healthcare, or a related field
  • Strong understanding of clinical research and drug development processes
  • Knowledge of ICH/GCP and 21 CFR regulatory requirements
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently
  • Strong site management, communication, and problem-solving skills
  • Fluency in English, written and spoken, Spanish highly desired
  • Ability to drive and travel extensively, up to 80%, in a company vehicle

Desirable Requirements

  • Experience in multiple therapeutic areas and Veeva Vault CTMS is a plus
  • Advanced knowledge and use of AI

The salary for this position is expected to range between $108,500 and $201,500 per year.

The final salary offered is determined based on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. Novartis may change the published salary range based on company and market factors.

Your compensation will include a performance-based cash incentive and, depending on the level of the role, eligibility to be considered for annual equity awards.

US-based eligible employees will receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, life and disability benefits, a 401(k) with company contribution and match, and a variety of other benefits. In addition, employees are eligible for a generous time off package including vacation, personal days, holidays and other leaves.

Please include the job requisition number in your message.

Do you want a job with a purpose?

And do you want to make healthcare safer, better and more reliable?

Join our Team!

Rejoignez-nous en tant que PRODUCT OWNER chez Dedalus, l'un des leaders mondiaux de l’édition de logiciel de santé, idéalement à Bordeaux ou en remote.

Ce que vous accomplirez

En tant que Product Owner AddOn, vous travaillerez au sein de l’équipe AddOn, sur le projet Transition U.

Le/la Product Owner AddOn contribue à la conception et à l'évolution des contenus fonctionnels standardisés de Care4U, adaptés aux spécificités du marché français. Il accompagne la transformation des pratiques métier et la transition vers la nouvelle génération de DPI Dedalus, en étroite collaboration avec les professionnels de santé, les équipes UX, les développeurs et les équipes produit.

Rejoignez-vous pour avoir un impact profond sur l’ensemble du secteur de la santé.

Vous aurez la responsabilité de :

  • Recueillir, analyser et formaliser les besoins métier des établissements de santé français, dans une logique de standardisation et de réutilisabilité des contenus.
  • Animer ou co-animer les ateliers de cadrage fonctionnel avec les professionnels de santé et les équipes internes.
  • Contribuer à la définition de la roadmap fonctionnelle et à la priorisation des développements AddOn, en cohérence avec la stratégie produit et les enjeux de la Transition U.
  • Concevoir les solutions fonctionnelles en collaboration avec les équipes UX et les développeurs, en privilégiant l'ergonomie, la simplicité d'utilisation et la pertinence métier.
  • Rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles, user stories et critères d'acceptation nécessaires aux développements.
  • Piloter et prioriser le backlog en lien avec le Manager AddOn, en tenant compte de la valeur métier, des besoins du marché, des contraintes techniques et de la capacité de l'équipe.
  • Participer activement aux cérémonies agiles et accompagner les développeurs tout au long du cycle de développement.
  • Assurer la validation fonctionnelle des développements et contribuer à la qualité des contenus livrés.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes R&D et Produit pour garantir la cohérence et la bonne intégration des contenus AddOn dans Care4U.
  • Recueillir et analyser les retours utilisateurs afin d'alimenter l'amélioration continue des solutions.

Faites un pas de plus vers la carrière de vos rêves

Chez Dedalus, la vie passe par nos logiciels. Chaque jour, nos actes contribuent à faciliter le quotidien des soignants et professionnels de la santé à fournir de meilleurs soins aux citoyens. Faites en sorte que la prochaine étape de votre carrière ait un impact profond. Voici ce dont vous aurez besoin pour réussir.

Exigences essentielles

  • Expérience significative dans le secteur de la santé et bonne compréhension des processus métier hospitaliers.
  • Expérience en analyse fonctionnelle, gestion de produit, conception de solutions logicielles ou projets informatiques en santé.
  • Bonne connaissance des systèmes d'information hospitaliers, idéalement des DPI.
  • Capacité à analyser, structurer et traduire des besoins métier en spécifications fonctionnelles.
  • Maîtrise des principes et pratiques de la méthodologie Agile.
  • Excellentes capacités de communication, de collaboration et de synthèse.
  • Autonomie, rigueur, sens de l'organisation et orientation utilisateur.

Exigences souhaitables

  • Formation initiale dans les métiers du soin (IDE, cadre de santé ou équivalent).
  • Expérience chez un éditeur de logiciels de santé ou dans un établissement hospitalier.
  • Connaissance des enjeux réglementaires et organisationnels du système de santé français.
  • Sensibilité aux enjeux d'ergonomie, d'expérience utilisateur et de conception de parcours de soins.
  • Connaissance des outils de gestion de backlog et de suivi des développements, notamment Jira.
  • Anglais professionnel.

Nous sommes Dedalus, rejoignez-nous

Dedalus s'engage à offrir une expérience de travail motivante et enrichissante qui reflète la passion de nos employés pour notre mission : faciliter le quotidien des soignants.

Notre entreprise favorise une culture où les employés sont encouragés à apprendre et innover, rendre possible et améliorer la coopération dans la santé, afin d’apporter des améliorations significatives pour des millions de personnes dans le monde.

Chaque collaborateur est le point de départ des activités du groupe, ainsi que le bénéficiaire final. C'est pour cela que nous sommes si fiers d'accomplir chaque jour notre travail.


Date de clôture des candidatures : 8 décembre 2026


Dedalus s’engage en matière de diversité et d'inclusion, afin de garantir le respect, l'inclusion et la réussite de tous nos collègues et des différentes communautés avec qui nous collaborons. Il est impératif pour nous de partager notre engagement et notre dévouement pour garantir un lieu de travail inclusif et varié. Nous reconnaissons que nous avons des progrès à faire, et pour ce futur, nous devons rester authentiques, réalistes, mais aussi ambitieux.


Our diversity & inclusion commitment – Dedalus Global

WHO WE ARE:

Quartile, the world's largest retail media optimization platform, is a trusted partner for multichannel e-commerce success. Through unmatched expertise and patented AI technology, we fuel growth for 5,300+ brands and sellers worldwide and manage an annual ad spend exceeding $2 billion. The award-winning platform covers major marketplaces and ad channels for optimal reach. The result is unprecedented granularity, smarter budgeting, and bespoke solutions for retailers.

Quartile is proud to be an equal opportunity employer with employees stemming from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences. As a business, we value the enrichment that diversity brings to our organization and are committed to a culture that creates a sense of inclusion and belonging. We welcome new perspectives and affirm that all employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, age, familial or marital status, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law.

OVERVIEW:
We're looking for an Operations Analyst, Governance, to keep the data, processes, and approvals of Customer Strategy under control. You coordinate the migration of Salesforce tools to a new platform for BizOps and CS, and you coordinate the Quartile HUB with the dashboard and internal control needs of all teams. You are also the bridge between the Tech team, Sciene, and Operations.

This role is for someone who brings structure to a fast-moving organization. You keep things documented, owned, and on schedule, and you make sure decisions are traceable.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 2+ years in a business operations, project management, or data governance role
  • Experience leading a system or tool migration, from requirements through cutover and adoption
  • Strong project management: running cadences, tracking status, and managing priorities across multi-stakeholder programs
  • Process and control mindset: documented approvals, audit trails, and clear ownership
  • Strong communicator who translates between technical and business audiences
  • Strong stakeholder discovery skills, with the ability to independently conduct interviews, surveys, and feedback sessions to identify operational pain points and improvement opportunities.
  • Analytical and problem-solving mindset: able to translate qualitative and quantitative feedback into hypotheses, actionable improvement plans, and implementation roadmaps.
  • Comfortable with data: reads dashboards and SQL outputs, and checks numbers before they are used
  • Stakeholder management with Directors, managers, and CSMs; holds priority under pressure
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, both written and spoken

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Salesforce Tools Migration

  • Coordinate the migration of Salesforce tools to a new platform for BizOps and CS: scope, sequencing, data mapping, testing, and cutover
  • Ensure business processes and approvals are preserved or improved during the migration, and that teams are trained and adopting the new platform

Quartile HUB & Internal Controls

  • Coordinate the Quartile HUB with the dashboard and internal control needs of all teams, and prioritize requests against a single backlog
  • Define and maintain internal controls for dashboards and data, including ownership, access, and change management

Database & Information Control

  • Own the CS database and the CS and channel solution information in the system: accuracy, completeness, and definitions
  • Set and enforce data entry standards with CS and channel teams

Project Cadence & Portfolio Management

  • Run the cadence across all CS and BizOps projects: intake, prioritization, status, and sponsor alignment
  • Maintain a single source of truth for the project portfolio, kept live and visible to leadership

Bridge Between Tech, Sciene & Operations

  • Translate operational needs into clear requirements for the Tech team and Sciene
  • Align data definitions across teams before anything is built
  • Coordinate the execution of AI projects from scoping through rollout, removing blockers as they come up

CS Team Discounts & Approvals

  • Own the approval process for CS team discounts: request, review, approval, and record
  • Maintain the approval policy and audit trail, and flag exceptions and pattern risks to leadership
  • Keep decisions separate from data preparation: the Technical Operations Manager supplies the data, and this role makes and records the approval decisions

Continuous Improvement & Stakeholder Discovery

  • Proactively conduct stakeholder interviews, surveys, and feedback sessions across CS, BizOps, and other teams to identify gaps, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Analyze feedback and operational data to develop hypotheses, validate root causes, and propose practical solutions.
  • Translate findings into structured action plans, defining priorities, owners, timelines, and success metrics.
  • Coordinate the implementation of improvements across the Quartile HUB, dashboards, reports, and operational processes, partnering with Tech, Sciene, and business stakeholders.
  • Establish feedback loops to measure adoption, assess the impact of implemented changes, and drive continuous optimization.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience in CS, RevOps, BizOps, or ad-tech / SaaS environments
  • Experience coordinating AI or technology projects
  • Experience with discount, pricing, or approval governance
  • Familiarity with Salesforce and BI tools
  • Comfort with AI tools (e.g. Claude) and willingness to use them in daily work

WHO YOU ARE:

  • Ownership: you keep items moving from intake to closure
  • Structured: you document decisions and keep them traceable
  • Diplomatic: you align people without losing the thread
  • Detail-oriented: you notice the gap in a process before it becomes a problem

This is a PJ contract based in Brazil.

FICO (NYSE: FICO)is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

The Opportunity

If you're looking for your next opportunity to make a meaningful business impact across the mortgage industry, this is a key role within our Mortgage team. We are seeking someone that will own and grow a territory of top U.S. mortgage lenders, driving adoption and performance of FICO's direct license program. You will bring business expertise to FICO's Scores division, where you will partner with mortgage lenders, helping them grow and serve customers. FICO's Scores unit is home to the world's #1 credit score – the FICO® Score – that powers over 10 billion decisions each year.


What You'll Contribute


  • Own and grow a territory of top U.S. mortgage lenders, driving adoption and performance of FICO's direct license program, including representing FICO at industry networking events and trade shows to build market presence and pipeline.
  • Drive adoption of FICO's leading mortgage analytics, including FICO® Score 10T, UltraFICO®, and FSMS.
  • Build coaches and champions across the client enterprise — articulating the value of FICO analytics to originators, capital markets, risk, analytics, and technology stakeholders.
  • Deliver executive-level presentations and client consultations that demonstrate ROI, competitive advantage, and the positioning of FICO scores across mortgage products and origination cycles.
  • Build comprehensive account plans that maximize revenue opportunities and identify cross-sell/up-sell initiatives in partnership with sales executives.

  • Leverage FICO subject-matter experts — across mortgage credit risk, GSE credit score requirements, investor buy guides, and origination operations — as part of a matrix sales engagement model.
  • Lead regular business reviews to assess performance against client objectives, review transactional activity, and flag material account changes to internal teams.
  • Track lender origination volumes, market position, strategic initiatives, and contractual levers to surface revenue growth opportunities.
  • Identify new opportunities for FICO scores across stages of the mortgage origination cycle and present findings directly to clients.

What We're Seeking

  • Deep mortgage subject matter expertise gained from proven experience across the mortgage industry, including strong understanding of mortgage origination, secondary market execution and servicing .
  • Proven mortgage sales experience at large national lenders and money-center banks, ideally gained in go to market sales or business development roles covering the mortgage industry.
  • Outstanding executive presence, with superior communication, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
  • Proven track record winning and growing mortgage relationships at a top tier lender or bank, with demonstrated ability to manage relationships across multiple lending institutions simultaneously.
  • Experience building relationships and selling to bank, credit union and IMB sellers at the executive level, including experience influencing internal executive stakeholders to advance key initiatives.
  • Established network of relationships with mortgage executives spanning the ecosystem — production, capital markets, risk, servicing, and beyond.
  • Proven ability to operate as a trusted strategic advisor, supporting client initiatives and navigating complex decision-making processes.
  • Strategic thinker and strong cross-functional collaborator, effective with executives and stakeholder groups across Product, Risk, Analytics, and Capital Markets.
  • Willingness to travel 25–35% for client meetings, industry conferences, and strategic planning sessions.

Our Offer to You

  • An inclusive culture that strongly reflects our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.

  • Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
  • An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

Why Make a Move to FICO?

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.

FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:

• Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.

• Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

raw.description:
Join Our Team and Make a Difference!

Are you looking for an impactful role where you finish the workday knowing you helped someone? Whether you are part of our care coordination team or play a supporting role, the work our colleagues do every day enables us to collectively reach our mission of getting people the care they need when they need it. By staying committed to our core values of Think Big, Go Fast, Deliver Awe, Win Together and Care Deeply,we can positively impact the lives of the injured workers we serve and get them back to the things that matter most in life.

Salary Range:

This compensation range considers a wide range of factors, including, but not limited to, skill set, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate is not adjusted for geographic differential associated with the location where the position may be filled. At One Call, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

What We Provide in Return for Your Commitment to Our Mission
We offer a vast array of benefits to help support the whole you, including:

  • Remote Work: We are a remote-first company, and almost all positions receive the flexibility of working from home.
  • Generous Time Off: Besides 8 company holidays and 2 personal days every year, all colleagues receive a minimum of 18 days of paid time off.
  • Comprehensive Benefits Package: Including medical, dental, vision, and pet insurance; 401(k) matching program; and company-paid life insurance and short and long-term disability coverage.
  • Supportive Services: Just like our colleagues get injured workers the care they need when they need it, we want to do the same for our colleagues in their time of need. We offer a Colleague Assistance Program that provides free counseling and financial services, and our One Call Foundation, a non-profit arm of our company, provides colleagues financial assistance during times of unexpected hardships.

JOB SUMMARY:

AI engineering org at One Call is leading a major transformation on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization. In short, this org is leading a lot of green field opportunities, and we are looking for like-minded leaders who are excited about building 0->1 products.

Our AI engineering team is at the heart of delivering scalable, intelligent, AI-powered solutions that transform the very core of workers' compensation experience. We are seeking a Principal AI Engineer to join the team and help build the next generation of agentic AI services that will improve patient outcomes. You will take product specifications and turn them into production-ready, scalable AI services, working with LLM for orchestration, multi-agent coordination, and RAG-based systems. You will ship production services that directly impact adjusters, patients, and internal operations.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Translate product specifications into AI service architectures – decompose business intent into agent workflows, data source integrations, and scalable service designs.
  • Build agentic AI workflows using Azure AI Foundry Agent Service and Microsoft Agent Framework, including multi-agent coordination, tool integrations. And agent lifecycle management.
  • Develop and iterate on LLM-based solutions including prompt engineering, model selection, cost/token optimization, and RAG pipline design.
  • Build evaluation systems including rubrics, goeldn datasets, and judge agents to validate agent correctness and safety before production deployment.
  • Build and contribute to agentic systems applying sound engineering principles around separation of concerns, memory architecture, and tool integration.
  • Contribute across the full stack: model experimentation, evaluation design, and production system deployment
  • Build and maintain APIs, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments with attention to observability and reliability
  • Support and help build GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
  • Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
  • Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows.
  • Partner with legal/ethics teams to ensure alignment with OneCall’s Responsible AO standards and work in ahighly governed PHI space.
  • Buid automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates.
  • Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
  • Hallucination rate and factual consistency.
  • Relevance and precision/recall
  • Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
  • Cost tracking and efficiency
  • Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, security ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
  • Contribute technical insights and communicate findings clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and, where relevant, clients
  • Share knowledge with peers and support a culture of technical learning around RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety.

EDUCATIONAL AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • 5+ years in software engineering, traditional ML engineering, or applied AI roles with hands-on building responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated experience shipping generative AI features or systems end-to-end, from prototyping though production.
  • Working knowledge of evaluation, design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM applications.
  • Experience with:
  • RAG architectures (vector-based retrieval; exposure to hybrid or graph-based approaches is a plus).
  • Agentic patterns (tool use, routing, memory management; muulti-agent systems experience is a plus)
  • ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
  • AI-specific Tools & Frameworks- Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model +API ecosystems.
  • Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
  • Familiarity with Azure cloud services, logging, monitoring, and observability patterns.
  • Experience in healthcare, workers compensation, claims processing, or regulated industries, preferred.

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

  • Solid prompt engineering and context engineering skills; familiarity with conversation design principles
  • Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical collaborators and stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and data science teams; some experience supporting or informally mentoring peers is a plus
  • Familiarity with cost and latency tradeoffs when working with LLM workloads
  • Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
  • Eagerness to grow into a technical leadership role and support junior team members
  • Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus
  • Ability to work in an environment that aligns with the company's diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging standards.
  • Ability to work both independently and in a team environment.
  • Demonstrate our core values of Think Big, Go Fast, Deliver Awe, Win Together and Care Deeply.

PHYSICAL/MENTAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • This position will be performed in the colleague’s home. Work-from-home requirements include the colleague’s ability to set up computer equipment within their home office. Occasional in-person team meetings may be required depending on the position.
  • This job is primarily sedentary and may involve repetitive motions; the colleague must be able to remain in a stationary position for extended periods of time, operate a computer and other office equipment, assess information and files stored electronically, and converse/exchange accurate information with others, simultaneously.
  • The colleague must be able to discern text displayed on a monitor, input data into specific fields using a keyboard, and adjust focus to distances of up to three feet.
  • The colleague must have the ability to learn new tasks, follow established processes, maintain focus, complete tasks independently, complete multiple tasks simultaneously, communicate professionally with colleagues and customers, and complete tasks in situations that have a speed or productivity requirement.
  • The colleague must be able to manage moderate to significant mental stress as a result of, but not limited to, a dynamic and heavy workload.

Please be advised that job descriptions typically change over time as business needs, job requirements, and employee skill levels change. As such, One Call retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position at any time.
