raw.description:
Senior SQL Developer
Finance Data & Systems Migration
Full-time / Remote

About the role

We are looking for a Senior SQL Developer to be a part of PROVE Partner's parent company Allira’s team (remote). We are making SQL the single source of truth for all of our data. Every report, reconciliation and financial statement will run from SQL, while Salesforce and Pulse remain our working systems and feed SQL, until better systems are identified. You will be the hands-on technical owner of the SQL platform. You will also scope the system migration across our Salesforce orgs, build integrations that write from SQL back to Salesforce and other systems, and manage the project day to day, working closely with Finance, Operations and our Salesforce team.

What you'll do

  • Scope the system migration across our Salesforce orgs: data mapping, sequencing, effort, risks and cutover approach
  • Design and build the SQL data model: staging, cleansed core tables and reporting marts
  • Build and schedule data loads from Salesforce, Pulse, the general ledger, loans and the loan ledger, and other sources
  • Rebuild our Salesforce reports in SQL, including accruals, repayments, settlements, clearing reports and weekly journal entries
  • Write tie-out logic that reconciles SQL to the general ledger on every load and every close
  • Turn manual exception reports into automated data-quality checks and alerts
  • Produce credit facility, lender and investor reporting by entity and funding vehicle
  • Build integrations that write from SQL back to Salesforce and other systems, with clear system-of-record and reconciliation rules
  • Manage the project: plan, timeline, status reporting, risks and coordination with Finance, Operations and the Salesforce team
  • Work with our Salesforce team on data mapping and on changes that affect SQL
  • Tune performance, manage code in source control, and document everything you build
  • Partner with the Controller and accounting team during month-end close

What you bring

  • Completed at least one project of similar scope from start to finish, such as a Salesforce-to-SQL migration that included reporting and finance close
  • Hands-on two-way integration experience: writing data from SQL to Salesforce and other systems (Salesforce APIs, Bulk API or middleware)
  • Project management skills: scoping, planning, running timelines and status, managing risks and stakeholders
  • 5+ years writing production SQL (T-SQL / SQL Server preferred): stored procedures, views, functions, indexing and query tuning
  • Experience building ETL / ELT pipelines (SSIS, Azure Data Factory, Fivetran or similar)
  • Dimensional modeling: fact and dimension tables, history tracking
  • Hands-on experience extracting and modeling Salesforce data
  • Strong understanding of accounting data: journal entries, accruals, trial balance, subledger-to-GL reconciliation
  • Experience supporting a financial close or building finance reporting
  • Clear communicator who can work directly with accountants and operations staff

Nice to have

  • Specialty finance, lending or asset management experience (advances, receivables, payoffs, fee accruals)
  • Credit facility, borrowing-base or static pool reporting
  • Power BI or SSRS report development
  • Salesforce administration or development experience
  • Git, CI/CD for database deployments
  • Project management certification (PMP or similar)

Why join

You'll build the data platform from the ground up and own it, with direct visibility to Finance leadership and a clear impact on how the firm closes its books.

Solve Industrial Motion Group strives to be the trusted source for engineered bearings and power transmission solutions. Supported by a diverse range of products within Solve’s brand portfolio and our unmatched technical expertise, we have over 100,000 ready-to-ship components. At Solve we innovate with ambition, offering custom solutions in a wide range of applications. We obsess over our customers, leveraging our nationwide network for industry leading product availability, and best-in-class customer service. Our engaged team leads with integrity, and unites with purpose, driving toward innovation and continuous improvement every day.

POSITION DESCRIPTION: Reporting to the VP of Field Sales, the Regional Sales Manager will be responsible for achieving regional business goals by expanding sales through new and existing customers within our West Territory (CO, WY, CA, OR, WA, NV, ID, AZ, UT and MT). To thrive in this role the RSM will leverage their solutions-selling skills and channel partner management experience, in tandem with their industry and customer knowledge within the territory to implement innovative and progressive strategies to yield new business opportunities. The RSM will be responsible for expanding our customer’s understanding of Solve’s portfolio of products by leveraging and developing our independent manufacturer sales representative’s relationships, as well as flexing their product knowledge through their own sales efforts. **This position is fully remote, and can sit in Denver, CO, Salt Lake City, UT or Phoenix, AZ metro areas.**

RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Accountable for the region’s sales growth and profitability
  • Use sales and market data to forecast regional goals, market and industry trends, and opportunities for growth to create the regional sales strategy
  • Stay abreast of evolving industry and market trends, as well as potential gaps in current Solve product offerings, and subsequently make strategic recommendations to company leadership for future product development
  • Foster independent manufacturer sales representative’s relationships, to leverage their buy-in and ability to best champion for Solve products
  • Conduct onsite meetings and presentations and consult with current clients to identify opportunities to promote and upsell new products, as well as troubleshoot and problem-solve any customer issues
  • Consult with current clients to identify opportunities to promote and upsell new products, as well as troubleshoot and problem-solve any customer issues
  • Manage pricing solutions for the region, and make recommendations for price adjustments accordingly
  • Partner with the Product Management, Marketing and Engineering Teams to create strategy around promoting the organization’s “best-in-class” product lines through company communication, trade show and networking events
  • 60+% travel is required to attend key customer meetings, prospecting new leads, trade shows and industry events
QUALIFICATIONS:
  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Ability to travel up to 60% and an active/valid driver’s license
  • 5+ years of industrial sales experience
  • 3+ years of industrial sales management experience
  • Intermediate Microsoft Office Skills; specifically Excel
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Bearings and power transmission industry experience
  • Experience working with a CRM
OUR EMPLOYEE VALUE PROPOSITION:
  • Market competitive benefits package, including company-sponsored health coverage, life insurance, 401(k) plan with company match, paid parental leave and paid time off
  • Work in a collaborative environment with passionate and innovative teammates
